examples.en: The research team had to abandon the survey when the river flooded the only road.
examples.zh: 河水淹没唯一道路后，研究团队不得不放弃这次调查。

examples.en: A government should not abandon a plan simply because early results are slow.
examples.zh: 政府不应仅仅因为早期结果缓慢就放弃一项计划。

examples.en: Communities may abandon a settlement when water sources disappear.
examples.zh: 当水源消失时，社区可能会放弃定居点。

examples.en: Families rarely abandon their homes unless war or drought leaves no safe choice.
examples.zh: 除非战争或干旱让人别无安全选择，否则家庭很少会遗弃家园。

cards.head: abandoner
cards.cutMeaning: 离开/控制；命令/动作/人；物

cards.head: abandonment
cards.cutMeaning: 离开/控制；命令/动作/名词

examples.en: The abandonment of the canal forced traders to use longer roads.
examples.zh: 运河的废弃迫使商人使用更长的道路。

examples.en: Animal shelters often deal with abandonment after owners move away.
examples.zh: 主人搬走后，动物收容所常常要处理遗弃问题。

examples.en: The storm did not abate until late afternoon, so the boats stayed in the harbour.
examples.zh: 暴风雨直到下午晚些时候才减弱，所以船只留在港口。

examples.en: Editors often abbreviate long titles so they fit neatly in a catalogue.
examples.zh: 编辑常常缩短长标题，使它们能整齐地放进目录。

examples.en: Scientific writers abbreviate common terms after spelling them out the first time.
examples.zh: 科学写作者在第一次完整写出常用术语后，会把它们缩写。

examples.en: The report describes how armed groups abduct civilians to gain political pressure.
examples.zh: 报告描述了武装组织如何绑架平民以获得政治压力。

examples.en: Certain shoulder muscles abduct the arm away from the side of the body.
examples.zh: 某些肩部肌肉会使手臂从身体侧面外展。

phrases.zh: 与异常；偏差相关的证据

examples.en: Citizens are more likely to abide by rules when authorities explain them clearly.
examples.zh: 当当局清楚解释规则时，市民更可能遵守规则。

examples.en: The scientist could not abide careless data because one error might spoil years of work.
examples.zh: 这位科学家无法容忍粗心数据，因为一个错误就可能毁掉多年的工作。

examples.en: A sense of fear may abide in a community long after the disaster has ended.
examples.zh: 灾难结束很久之后，恐惧感仍可能留存在一个社区中。

examples.en: She kept an abiding interest in astronomy throughout her life.
examples.zh: 她一生都保持着对天文学的持久热情。

examples.en: Children develop the ability to compare shapes before they can explain the rule in words.
examples.zh: 儿童在能用语言解释规则之前，就已经发展出比较形状的能力。

senses.zh: 能够做到的条件；可能性

examples.en: The new bridge improved the village's ability to reach markets during the rainy season.
examples.zh: 新桥提高了这个村庄在雨季抵达市场的能力。

examples.en: The wooden roof was ablaze within minutes.
examples.zh: 木屋顶几分钟内就着火燃烧。

examples.en: The sky was ablaze with orange light at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时天空闪耀着橙色光。

examples.en: A trained nurse is able to notice small changes in a patient's breathing.
examples.zh: 训练有素的护士能够注意到病人呼吸中的细微变化。

examples.en: Abnormal rainfall damaged crops that usually grow well in the dry season.
examples.zh: 异常降雨破坏了通常在旱季长势良好的作物。

examples.en: The passengers went aboard before the storm reached the harbour.
examples.zh: 风暴到达港口前，乘客登上了船。

examples.en: The new law abolished fees that had kept poor children out of school.
examples.zh: 新法律废除了曾阻止贫困儿童入学的费用。

examples.en: Governments may abolish outdated rules when older policies block fair education and efficient public services.
examples.zh: 当旧政策阻碍教育公平和公共服务效率时，政府可能会废除过时规则。

examples.en: Reformers may abolish outdated rules when they block equal access to education.
examples.zh: 当旧规则阻碍教育公平可及时，改革者可能会废除它们。

cards.head: abolishment
cards.cutMeaning: 离开/投掷；抛掉/动词/名词

examples.en: The abolition of slavery changed law, labour, and moral debate.
examples.zh: 废除奴隶制改变了法律、劳动和道德争论。

cards.head: abolitionary
cards.cutMeaning: 离开/投掷；抛掉/名词/形容词

cards.head: abolitionism
cards.cutMeaning: 离开/投掷；抛掉/名词/主义；学说

cards.head: abolitionist
cards.cutMeaning: 离开/投掷；抛掉/名词/人；从业者

examples.en: Environmental policies should respect aboriginal communities when protecting forests, rivers, and traditional farming areas.
examples.zh: 环境政策在保护森林、河流和传统农耕区时，应尊重原住民社区。

phrases.zh: 原住民最初居住的土地
原住民最初居住的土地
原住民最初居住的土地

cards.head: aborigine
cards.cutMeaning: 离开/升起，开始/形容词；名词

examples.en: Aborigine communities preserved cultural knowledge through oral tradition and land-based memory.
examples.zh: 原住民社区通过口传传统和土地记忆保存文化知识。

examples.en: Engineers chose to abort the launch after a warning light appeared.
examples.zh: 警示灯亮起后，工程师决定中止发射。

examples.en: Doctors monitored the patient carefully because the pregnancy might abort naturally.
examples.zh: 医生仔细监测病人，因为妊娠可能自然流产。

cards.head: abortion
cards.cutMeaning: 离开/升起；出生；产生/名词

examples.en: The abortion debate often involves health, autonomy, religion, and law.
examples.zh: 堕胎争论通常涉及健康、自主权、宗教和法律。

cards.head: abortive
cards.cutMeaning: 离开/升起；出生；产生/形容词

examples.en: Wildflowers abound in the valley after spring rain.
examples.zh: 春雨后，山谷里野花繁盛。

examples.en: Stories of hidden caves abound among local children.
examples.zh: 当地孩子中大量流传着隐藏洞穴的故事。

examples.en: The old market abounds with colour, noise, and movement.
examples.zh: 旧市场充满色彩、噪音和活动。

cards.head: abrasion
cards.cutMeaning: 离去/＝rad摩擦/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: Abrasion on the stone showed where ropes had rubbed against it.
examples.zh: 石头表面的磨损显示出绳索曾摩擦的位置。

examples.en: The two boats moved abreast through the narrow channel.
examples.zh: 两艘船并排穿过狭窄水道。

examples.en: Many students study abroad to experience another academic culture.
examples.zh: 许多学生出国学习，以体验另一种学术文化。

examples.en: An abrupt fall in temperature damaged flowers that had opened early.
examples.zh: 气温突然下降损坏了提前开放的花朵。

examples.en: An abrupt policy change can disrupt food supply chains and make local markets unstable.
examples.zh: 突然的政策变化可能扰乱食品供应链，并使本地市场变得不稳定。

examples.en: An abrupt change in policy can confuse citizens and weaken trust.
examples.zh: 政策突然变化会让公民困惑并削弱信任。

examples.en: His abrupt reply ended the discussion before anyone could ask a second question.
examples.zh: 他唐突的回答让讨论在任何人提出第二个问题前就结束了。

examples.en: In the absence of evidence, a confident explanation is only a guess.
examples.zh: 在缺乏证据的情况下，自信的解释也只是猜测。

examples.en: In the absence of regulation, online medical advice may mislead anxious patients.
examples.zh: 在缺乏监管的情况下，线上医疗建议可能误导焦虑患者。

examples.en: Several students were absent because heavy snow blocked the mountain road.
examples.zh: 由于大雪堵住山路，几名学生缺席了。

examples.en: Trust was absent from the negotiations, so every promise sounded weak.
examples.zh: 谈判中缺乏信任，所以每个承诺听起来都很无力。

cards.head: absenteeism
cards.cutMeaning: 离开/感觉/人；受事者/主义；学说

examples.en: The ruler claimed absolute power, but local courts still resisted some orders.
examples.zh: 统治者宣称拥有绝对权力，但地方法院仍抵制一些命令。

examples.en: Absolute freedom is impossible when individual choices harm public safety seriously today.
examples.zh: 如今当个人选择严重损害公共安全时，绝对自由是不可能的。

examples.en: Claims of absolute certainty are dangerous when evidence is incomplete.
examples.zh: 当证据不完整时，声称绝对确定是危险的。

examples.en: Moral absolutes are difficult to apply when two duties conflict.
examples.zh: 当两种义务发生冲突时，道德绝对原则很难适用。

examples.en: The room was absolutely silent after the alarm stopped.
examples.zh: 警报停止后，房间里完全安静。

examples.en: The treaty forbids the practice absolutely, even during emergencies.
examples.zh: 该条约绝对禁止这种做法，即使在紧急情况下也是如此。

cards.head: absolutism
cards.cutMeaning: 离开；完全/松开；解除/主义

senses.zh: 绝对主义者；专制主义者

examples.en: A signed form does not absolve the company of responsibility for unsafe equipment.
examples.zh: 一份签字表格并不能免除公司对不安全设备的责任。

examples.en: The court did not absolve him until new evidence proved he was elsewhere.
examples.zh: 直到新证据证明他当时在别处，法院才宣告他无罪。

examples.en: Dark soil can absorb more heat than pale sand on a sunny day.
examples.zh: 在晴天，深色土壤比浅色沙子能吸收更多热量。

examples.en: Students need time to absorb information before they can use it in writing.
examples.zh: 学生需要时间吸收信息，才能在写作中使用它。

examples.en: Forests absorb carbon dioxide and reduce the speed of climate change.
examples.zh: 森林吸收二氧化碳并减缓气候变化速度。

examples.en: Students absorb new ideas more easily when examples connect with daily life.
examples.zh: 当例子与日常生活相关时，学生更容易理解新想法。

cards.head: absorbent
cards.cutMeaning: 进入；加强/吸收/形容词；名词

examples.en: The absorption of water makes dry seeds swell before they grow.
examples.zh: 水分吸收会让干种子在生长前膨胀。

examples.en: Her absorption in the experiment made her forget the time.
examples.zh: 她全神贯注于实验，以至于忘了时间。

cards.head: abstention
cards.cutMeaning: 离开/拿住；保持/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: Abstract ideas become easier to learn when teachers connect them with visible examples.
examples.zh: 当老师把抽象概念和可见例子联系起来时，它们会更容易学习。

examples.en: Abstract concepts become easier when teachers connect them with everyday examples clearly.
examples.zh: 当教师把抽象概念与日常例子清楚联系起来时，它们会变得更容易。

examples.en: The abstract explains the method and main result before the full paper begins.
examples.zh: 摘要在全文开始前说明研究方法和主要结果。

examples.en: The software can abstract key dates from thousands of scanned letters.
examples.zh: 这个软件可以从数千封扫描信件中提取关键日期。

examples.en: A useful abstraction makes complexity easier to handle without erasing reality.
examples.zh: 有用的抽象会让复杂性更容易处理，同时不抹掉现实。

examples.en: It is absurd to blame a single farmer for a drought across the whole region.
examples.zh: 把整个地区的干旱归咎于一个农民是荒谬的。

examples.en: It is absurd to build empty stadiums while hospitals lack basic equipment.
examples.zh: 在医院缺乏基本设备时建设空置体育场是荒谬的。

examples.en: An absurd claim can still spread quickly if it fits public fear.
examples.zh: 荒谬主张如果契合公众恐惧，仍可能迅速传播。

cards.head: absurdism
cards.cutMeaning: 偏离/聋；不协调/主义；学说

phrases.zh: 现代戏剧中的荒诞主义

cards.head: absurdist
cards.cutMeaning: 偏离/聋；不协调/人；从业者

cards.head: absurdity
cards.cutMeaning: 离开；不/在上；超过/二；分开/性质；状态

senses.gloss: state or quality of being absurd

phrases.zh: 存在主义文学中的荒诞

examples.en: An abundance of resources does not guarantee fair distribution.
examples.zh: 资源丰富并不保证分配公平。

examples.en: An abundance of nutrients can support large marine food chains.
examples.zh: 丰富的营养物质可以支撑大型海洋食物链。

examples.en: Abundant rainfall allowed farmers to grow a second crop that year.
examples.zh: 充足降雨使农民那一年能够种第二季作物。

examples.en: The abuse of power can destroy public trust in government institutions quickly.
examples.zh: 权力滥用会迅速摧毁公众对政府机构的信任。

examples.en: The new building will abut the old city wall.
examples.zh: 新建筑将毗邻旧城墙。

examples.en: The climbers stopped when fog hid the edge of the abyss below them.
examples.zh: 雾遮住脚下深渊边缘时，登山者停了下来。

examples.en: Past glaciation changed sea levels, leaving evidence even in the deep ocean abyss where sediment accumulated slowly.
examples.zh: 过去的冰川作用改变了海平面，即使在沉积缓慢积累的深海深渊中也留下证据。

examples.en: Past glaciation left evidence even in the ocean abyss where sediment accumulated slowly.
examples.zh: 过去的冰川作用甚至在沉积缓慢积累的海洋深处留下证据。

examples.en: An abyssal plain may contain hydrothermal vents where heat and minerals support unusual deep-sea life.
examples.zh: 深海平原可能含有热液喷口，其中热量和矿物质支持特殊深海生命。

examples.en: Acacia trees provide food and shelter for many dryland animals.
examples.zh: 金合欢树为许多旱地动物提供食物和庇护。

examples.en: Academic writing requires evidence, clear definitions, and careful use of sources.
examples.zh: 学术写作需要证据、清楚的定义和谨慎使用资料来源。

examples.en: The question became academic once the company had already cancelled the project.
examples.zh: 公司已经取消项目后，这个问题就变得不切实际了。

cards.head: academically
cards.cutMeaning: 学院；学术/形容词/形容词/副词

examples.en: The academician advised the museum on how to protect fragile manuscripts.
examples.zh: 这位院士就如何保护脆弱手稿向博物馆提供建议。

examples.en: The military academy trained engineers as well as officers for public service.
examples.zh: 这所军事学院既培养军官，也培养公共服务所需的工程师。

examples.en: The academy of sciences published a report on water use in dry regions.
examples.zh: 科学院发表了一份关于干旱地区用水的报告。

cards.head: accelerant
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/快，速度/形容词；名词

examples.en: Warmer water can accelerate the growth of some harmful algae.
examples.zh: 较温暖的水会加速某些有害藻类的生长。

examples.en: Automation can accelerate economic growth while displacing some routine jobs in factories.
examples.zh: 自动化可以加速经济增长，同时取代工厂中的一些常规岗位。

examples.en: Digital platforms can accelerate change faster than institutions can respond.
examples.zh: 数字平台可以以快于制度回应速度的方式加速变化。

examples.en: A car's velocity changes when acceleration increases, which allows it to move faster within a shorter time.
examples.zh: 当加速度增加时，汽车速度会改变，使它能在更短时间内移动得更快。

examples.en: The particle accelerator allowed physicists to observe tiny collisions.
examples.zh: 粒子加速器使物理学家能够观察微小碰撞。

examples.en: Cheap transport became an accelerator of urban growth.
examples.zh: 廉价交通成为城市增长的促进因素。

phrases.zh: 智能手机加速度计数据

examples.en: Her accent showed that she had grown up near the coast.
examples.zh: 她的口音表明她在海边长大。

examples.en: The accent falls on the first syllable of this word.
examples.zh: 这个词的重音落在第一个音节。

examples.en: The museum agreed to accept the donated fossils after checking their origin.
examples.zh: 博物馆在核查化石来源后同意接受这批捐赠。

examples.en: A serious thinker must accept evidence even when it damages a preferred story.
examples.zh: 严肃思考者必须接受证据，即使它损害自己偏爱的叙事。

examples.en: Societies must accept cultural difference if they want peaceful coexistence.
examples.zh: 社会若想和平共处，就必须接受文化差异。

examples.en: Scientists did not accept the claim until independent teams repeated the experiment.
examples.zh: 直到独立团队重复实验后，科学家才认可这一说法。

examples.en: An acceptable risk still needs to be clearly explained to the people affected by it.
examples.zh: 可接受风险仍需要向受影响的人清楚解释。

cards.head: acceptance
cards.cutMeaning: 加强；朝向/拿取；接受/状态；名词

examples.en: The new road gave farmers easier access to the regional market.
examples.zh: 新道路让农民更容易进入区域市场。

examples.en: Equal access to education can reduce inequality between rich and poor families.
examples.zh: 平等的受教育机会可以减少贫富家庭之间的不平等。

examples.en: Access to clean water changed health conditions in the village within a year.
examples.zh: 获得清洁用水的机会在一年内改变了村里的健康状况。

examples.en: Students can access the archive only after registering with the library.
examples.zh: 学生只有在图书馆登记后才能访问档案库。

examples.en: The access-route to the auditorium was closed during repairs.
examples.zh: 维修期间，通往礼堂的路线被关闭。

examples.en: Online tools can make education more accessible if cost and language barriers are reduced.
examples.zh: 如果成本和语言障碍降低，线上工具可以让教育更可及。

examples.en: The online archive made rare documents accessible to rural students.
examples.zh: 在线档案使农村学生能够获取稀有文件。

examples.en: Clear examples make difficult grammar accessible to beginners.
examples.zh: 清楚的例句使困难语法对初学者更容易理解。

examples.en: A phone case is an accessory, but a charger is essential.
examples.zh: 手机壳是附件，但充电器是必需品。

examples.en: The railway accident forced engineers to review every bridge on the route.
examples.zh: 这起铁路事故迫使工程师重新检查沿线每一座桥。

examples.en: The discovery happened by accident when a student cleaned the museum drawer.
examples.zh: 这项发现是在一名学生清理博物馆抽屉时偶然发生的。

cards.head: accidental
cards.cutMeaning: 加强/落下；发生/名词/形容词

cards.head: accidentally
cards.cutMeaning: 加强/落下；发生/名词/形容词/副词

phrases.zh: 以 accidentally 方式呈现的重要证据

examples.en: The crowd acclaimed the rescue team as heroes.
examples.zh: 人群向救援队喝彩，称他们为英雄。

examples.en: Critics acclaimed the film for its honest portrait of poverty.
examples.zh: 评论家称赞这部电影真实描绘贫困。

examples.en: The proposal passed by acclamation because no one demanded a formal vote.
examples.zh: 由于没有人要求正式投票，该提案以鼓掌方式通过。

examples.en: The new dormitory can accommodate three hundred students during the winter term.
examples.zh: 新宿舍楼在冬季学期可以容纳三百名学生。

examples.en: Companies should accommodate older workers by offering flexible hours and safer working conditions.
examples.zh: 公司应通过提供弹性工时和更安全的工作条件来适应老年员工。

examples.en: Schools should accommodate different needs without lowering intellectual standards.
examples.zh: 学校应适应不同需求，同时不降低智力标准。

examples.en: An accommodating policy can reduce exclusion without abandoning rules.
examples.zh: 灵活政策可以减少排斥，同时不放弃规则。

examples.en: Schools should accommodate different needs without lowering intellectual standards.
examples.zh: 学校应顾及不同需求，同时不降低学术标准。

examples.en: Affordable accommodation near universities can reduce commuting pressure and improve student well-being.
examples.zh: 大学附近的可负担住宿可以减少通勤压力，并改善学生幸福感。

examples.en: Reasonable accommodation allows disabled students to participate fairly.
examples.zh: 合理便利安排使残障学生能够公平参与。

examples.en: A local guide accompanied the scientists into the forest.
examples.zh: 当地向导陪伴科学家进入森林。

examples.en: A violin accompanied the singer during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 仪式中，小提琴为歌手伴奏。

cards.head: accompanying
cards.cutMeaning: 加强/公司；陪伴/名词；形容词

examples.en: 经济增长可能伴随环境压力。
examples.zh: 经济增长可能伴随环境压力。

examples.en: The team accomplished the survey before heavy snow closed the mountain pass.
examples.zh: 团队在大雪封闭山口前完成了调查。

examples.en: Public transport reform can accomplish long-term goals if cities invest consistently.
examples.zh: 如果城市持续投资，公共交通改革可以实现长期目标。

examples.en: An accomplished writer usually hides effort behind a clear sentence.
examples.zh: 有成就的写作者通常把努力隐藏在清晰句子背后。

examples.en: Public health campaigns can accomplish real change when they earn local trust.
examples.zh: 公共卫生活动获得当地信任时，能够取得真正改变。

cards.head: accomplishable
cards.cutMeaning: 加强/填满；完成/动词/能够；可

examples.en: The accomplished engineer could design bridges and teach mathematics.
examples.zh: 这位多才多艺的工程师能设计桥梁，也能教授数学。

examples.en: The accomplished repairs made the road safe again.
examples.zh: 完成的维修使道路重新安全。

cards.head: accomplisher
cards.cutMeaning: 加强/填满；完成/动词/人；物

cards.head: accomplishment
cards.cutMeaning: 加强/填满；完成/动词/名词

examples.en: Transport policy should accord with public interest rather than serve short-term political goals.
examples.zh: 交通政策应符合公共利益，而不是服务于短期政治目标。

cards.head: accordingly
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/心；一致/状态/副词

phrases.zh: 以 accordingly 方式呈现的重要证据

examples.en: The accordion filled the street with music during the festival.
examples.zh: 节日期间，手风琴声充满街道。

examples.en: The charity opened a separate account to track donations for flood relief.
examples.zh: 慈善机构开设了一个单独账户，用来追踪洪灾救助捐款。

examples.en: Her account of the journey included details that were missing from the official report.
examples.zh: 她对这次旅程的叙述包含官方报告中缺失的细节。

examples.en: The old theory could not give a convincing account of the sudden climate shift.
examples.zh: 旧理论无法对突然的气候变化给出有说服力的解释。

examples.en: Soil conditions account for much of the difference in crop growth between the two fields.
examples.zh: 土壤条件解释了两块田作物生长差异的大部分原因。

cards.head: accountability
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/计算；说明/能够/名词

examples.en: Public accountability requires officials to explain how money is spent.
examples.zh: 公共问责要求官员解释资金如何使用。

cards.head: accountable
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/计算；叙述/能够；可

cards.head: accountant
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/计算；叙述/形容词；名词

examples.en: Careful accounting revealed that the project had overspent.
examples.zh: 细致的会计核算显示该项目已经超支。

examples.en: The agency can accredit schools that meet national standards.
examples.zh: 该机构可以认证符合国家标准的学校。

cards.head: acculturate
cards.cutMeaning: 适应异文化/动词；使成为

cards.head: acculturation
cards.cutMeaning: 适应异文化/动词；使成为/名词

examples.en: Immigrant acculturation can create a new urban subculture when young people combine old traditions with local styles.
examples.zh: 移民文化适应会在年轻人把旧传统与本地风格结合时创造新的城市亚文化。

examples.en: Credit cards can make young consumers accumulate debt before they understand long-term interest costs.
examples.zh: 信用卡可能让年轻消费者在理解长期利息成本前就积累债务。

examples.en: Small decisions can accumulate pressure until a system suddenly changes.
examples.zh: 小决定会积累压力，直到系统突然变化。

examples.en: The accumulation of evidence can slowly change a once-dominant view.
examples.zh: 证据积累会逐渐改变曾经占主导地位的观点。

examples.en: The accumulation of evidence can turn a weak suspicion into a strong argument.
examples.zh: 证据的积累可以把薄弱怀疑变成有力论证。

examples.en: Accurate maps helped rescue teams reach villages cut off by the flood.
examples.zh: 准确地图帮助救援队到达被洪水隔绝的村庄。

cards.head: accurately
cards.cutMeaning: 加强/关心；注意/形容词/副词

examples.en: The accusation was serious, so investigators asked for written evidence.
examples.zh: 这项指控很严重，因此调查人员要求书面证据。

examples.en: Her accusation that the report was biased led to a public review.
examples.zh: 她指责报告有偏见，这引发了公开审查。

examples.en: Prosecutors accused the company of hiding safety reports from inspectors.
examples.zh: 检察官指控这家公司向检查员隐瞒安全报告。

examples.en: People may accuse institutions when official explanations sound too convenient.
examples.zh: 当官方解释显得过于方便时，人们可能指责机构。

examples.en: Citizens may accuse companies of negligence when pollution damages local health.
examples.zh: 当污染损害当地健康时，公民可能指控公司疏忽。

examples.en: New workers need time to accustom themselves to night shifts.
examples.zh: 新工人需要时间让自己习惯夜班。

examples.en: The city achieved cleaner air after factories changed their fuel systems.
examples.zh: 工厂改变燃料系统后，这座城市实现了更清洁的空气。

examples.en: Governments cannot achieve educational equality unless rural schools receive stable funding and qualified teachers.
examples.zh: 除非农村学校获得稳定经费和合格教师，否则政府无法实现教育公平。

examples.en: A policy may achieve a goal while creating new problems elsewhere.
examples.zh: 一项政策可能实现一个目标，同时在别处制造新问题。

examples.en: Academic achievement should not be measured only by exam scores and rankings.
examples.zh: 学业成就不应只由考试分数和排名来衡量。

examples.en: Rain becomes more damaging when acid from pollution mixes with water in the air.
examples.zh: 污染产生的酸与空气中的水混合后，雨水会变得更具破坏性。

examples.en: Her acid criticism made the committee examine the proposal more carefully.
examples.zh: 她尖刻的批评让委员会更仔细地审查了这项提案。

examples.en: Rising ocean acidity can damage coral reefs and marine food chains.
examples.zh: 海洋酸度上升会损害珊瑚礁和海洋食物链。

examples.en: Increased ocean acidity can damage coral reefs and marine food chains.
examples.zh: 海洋酸度升高会损害珊瑚礁和海洋食物链。

examples.en: The mayor acknowledged that the old drainage system had failed during heavy rain.
examples.zh: 市长承认旧排水系统在暴雨中失效了。

examples.en: Institutions lose trust when they refuse to acknowledge clear evidence.
examples.zh: 当机构拒绝承认清楚证据时，它们会失去信任。

examples.en: The author acknowledged the local guides who helped collect oral histories.
examples.zh: 作者感谢了帮助收集口述历史的当地向导。

examples.en: The cafe used acoustic guitars instead of electric instruments.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆使用非电声吉他而不是电声乐器。

examples.en: Acoustic signals help whales communicate underwater.
examples.zh: 听觉信号帮助鲸在水下交流。

examples.en: The notice acquainted residents with the new safety rules.
examples.zh: 通知使居民认识到新的安全规则。

examples.en: The course acquaints students with basic laboratory methods.
examples.zh: 这门课使学生熟悉基础实验方法。

examples.en: A limited acquaintance with history can still change how people judge the present.
examples.zh: 对历史的有限了解仍能改变人们判断当下的方式。

cards.head: acquirable
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/寻找；取得/能够；可

examples.en: The museum acquired several rare maps from a private collection.
examples.zh: 博物馆从一个私人收藏中获得了几幅稀有地图。

examples.en: Workers need to acquire practical skills when robots replace routine jobs in factories.
examples.zh: 当机器人取代工厂中的常规工作时，工人需要获得实用技能。

examples.en: Students acquire skills faster when practice is meaningful.
examples.zh: 当练习有意义时，学生习得技能更快。

examples.en: Children acquire language by listening, repeating, and testing patterns in speech.
examples.zh: 儿童通过倾听、重复和试探语言模式来习得语言。

examples.en: Children exposed to more than one dialect may show flexible language acquisition when adults support communication rather than correction.
examples.zh: 接触不止一种方言的儿童，如果成年人支持交流而不是只纠错，可能表现出灵活的语言习得。

cards.head: acquisitive
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/寻求；询问/形容词

examples.en: NASA is an acronym formed from the first letters of a longer official name.
examples.zh: NASA 是由较长官方名称首字母组成的缩写词。

examples.en: The child ran across before the gate closed.
examples.zh: 大门关闭前，孩子横跑过去。

examples.en: The library stands across from the old school.
examples.zh: 图书馆在旧学校对面。

examples.en: The bridge carries traffic across the river.
examples.zh: 桥梁承载交通越过河流。

examples.en: Institutions act slowly when evidence is fragmented across agencies.
examples.zh: 当证据分散在各机构之间时，制度行动往往较慢。

examples.en: A single act of kindness changed the mood of the whole room.
examples.zh: 一个善意行为改变了整个房间的气氛。

examples.en: The acting director signed the order while the minister was ill.
examples.zh: 部长生病期间，代理主管签署了命令。

examples.en: Good acting can make a simple story feel real.
examples.zh: 好的表演能让简单故事显得真实。

examples.en: Quick action prevented the fire from spreading to nearby houses.
examples.zh: 迅速行动阻止了火势蔓延到附近房屋。

examples.en: The drug's action becomes weaker when it is stored in heat.
examples.zh: 这种药物受热储存时作用会变弱。

examples.en: The residents brought a legal action against the company.
examples.zh: 居民对这家公司提起了法律诉讼。

examples.en: Heat activates the chemical reaction in the container.
examples.zh: 热量刺激容器中的化学反应。

examples.en: The sensor activates the alarm when smoke appears.
examples.zh: 传感器在出现烟雾时使警报活动起来。

examples.en: Active participation makes learning more durable than passive listening.
examples.zh: 积极参与比被动听讲更能让学习持久。

examples.en: A climate activist can turn scientific warnings into public pressure.
examples.zh: 气候行动者可以把科学警告转化为公共压力。

cards.head: activity
cards.cutMeaning: 行动；做/形容词成分/名词

examples.en: Outdoor activity improved the children's sleep and attention.
examples.zh: 户外活动改善了孩子们的睡眠和注意力。

examples.en: Volcanic activity increased after several small earthquakes.
examples.zh: 几次小地震后，火山活动增强了。

examples.en: The enzyme loses activity when the temperature is too high.
examples.zh: 温度过高时，这种酶会失去活性。

cards.head: actual
cards.cutMeaning: 行动；事实/连接音/形容词

examples.en: The actual cost of the bridge was much higher than the early estimate.
examples.zh: 这座桥的实际成本比早期估算高得多。

examples.en: The actual rules differ from the version printed in the old handbook.
examples.zh: 现行规则与旧手册中印刷的版本不同。

cards.head: actually
cards.cutMeaning: 行动；事实/连接音/形容词/副词

examples.en: The village looked isolated, but it was actually connected by a seasonal road.
examples.zh: 这个村庄看起来很孤立，但实际上有一条季节性道路与外界相连。

examples.en: A small actuator opened the valve when the sensor detected rising pressure.
examples.zh: 传感器检测到压力上升时，一个小型执行器打开了阀门。

examples.en: Her business acumen helped the small company survive the recession.
examples.zh: 她的商业敏锐帮助小公司熬过经济衰退。

examples.en: The hospital faced an acute shortage of nurses after the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴过后，医院面临严重的护士短缺。

examples.en: An acute observer noticed that the figures did not match.
examples.zh: 敏锐观察者注意到这些数字不一致。

examples.en: Coastal communities must adapt to rising seas and stronger storms.
examples.zh: 沿海社区必须适应海平面上升和更强风暴。

examples.en: Teachers must adapt teaching methods when mixed-ability classes include students with different needs.
examples.zh: 当混合能力班包含需求不同的学生时，教师必须调整教学方法。

examples.en: The director adapted the novel into a film set in a modern city.
examples.zh: 导演把这部小说改编成一部以现代城市为背景的电影。

examples.en: An adaptable workforce is crucial when automation changes job requirements faster than schools respond.
examples.zh: 当自动化改变岗位要求的速度快于学校响应速度时，适应力强的劳动力很关键。

cards.head: adaptably
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/适合/能够；可/副词

examples.en: A genetic mutation may create a trait that becomes an adaptation if it helps organisms survive local conditions.
examples.zh: 基因突变可能产生一种性状，如果它帮助生物适应当地条件，就会成为一种适应。

examples.en: Climate adaptation requires planning before disaster becomes normal.
examples.zh: 气候适应需要在灾难变成常态之前进行规划。

senses.zh: 适应性的；有适应能力的

examples.en: A collective response becomes adaptive when shared rules help the whole group survive environmental pressure.
examples.zh: 当共享规则帮助整个群体承受环境压力时，集体反应会变成适应性反应。

examples.en: Add the two measurements before calculating the average.
examples.zh: 计算平均值前，先把两个测量值相加。

examples.en: Designers can addict users to feedback loops that reward constant attention.
examples.zh: 设计者可能使用户对奖励持续注意的反馈循环成瘾。

examples.en: Digital addiction becomes harder to discuss when platforms profit from attention.
examples.zh: 当平台从注意力中获利时，数字成瘾变得更难讨论。

examples.en: Screen addiction can reduce sleep quality and weaken students' concentration.
examples.zh: 屏幕成瘾会降低睡眠质量并削弱学生注意力。

cards.head: addictive
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/说话；断言/形容词

examples.en: Addictive games use rewards to keep players returning.
examples.zh: 令人上瘾的游戏利用奖励让玩家不断回来。

examples.en: Additional evidence can change a conclusion that once seemed obvious.
examples.zh: 额外证据可以改变曾经看似显然的结论。

examples.en: Additional funding can improve rural schools if it reaches classrooms directly.
examples.zh: 额外资金如果直接到达课堂，可以改善农村学校。

examples.en: A food additive may improve colour or texture, while a preservative extends shelf life by slowing decay.
examples.zh: 食品添加剂可能改善颜色或质地，而防腐剂通过减缓腐败来延长保质期。

examples.en: The package was returned because the address was wrong.
examples.zh: 包裹因地址错误被退回。

examples.en: The president's address focused on public health.
examples.zh: 总统讲话集中于公共卫生。

examples.en: The policy must address the causes of debt, not only the symptoms.
examples.zh: 这项政策必须处理债务的原因，而不只是处理表面症状。

examples.en: The mayor addressed the crowd after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水后，市长向人群讲话。

examples.en: She became adept at repairing old radios with simple tools.
examples.zh: 她变得擅长用简单工具修理旧收音机。

senses.gloss: state or quality of being adept

cards.head: adequacy
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/相等，平均/性质；状态

cards.head: adequate
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/相等；合适/形容词

examples.en: The shelter had adequate food, but it lacked warm clothing for children.
examples.zh: 避难所有足够食物，但缺少儿童保暖衣物。

examples.en: Wet clay can adhere to stone tools and preserve tiny marks.
examples.zh: 湿黏土会附着在石器上，并保存细小痕迹。

examples.en: The committee adhered to the original safety standard.
examples.zh: 委员会坚持并遵守原来的安全标准。

examples.en: Good adhesion keeps the paint from peeling in wet weather.
examples.zh: 良好附着力能防止油漆在潮湿天气脱落。

cards.head: adhesive
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/黏附/形容词；名词

examples.en: An adhesive strip kept the sensor attached to the patient's skin.
examples.zh: 一条黏性贴片让传感器固定在病人皮肤上。

examples.en: The repair failed because the adhesive could not hold in wet air.
examples.zh: 修理失败了，因为这种胶合剂在潮湿空气中粘不住。

examples.en: The school built a garden on the adjacent plot so children could study plants directly.
examples.zh: 学校在邻近地块建了花园，让孩子们可以直接研究植物。

examples.en: Adjacent cities can share public transport systems to reduce congestion and housing pressure.
examples.zh: 邻近城市可以共享公共交通系统，以减少拥堵和住房压力。

cards.head: adjacently
cards.cutMeaning: 向；靠近/躺；放置/形容词/副词

cards.head: adjoining
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/结合，连接/名词；形容词

examples.en: The adjoining room was used for storing laboratory equipment.
examples.zh: 相邻房间用于存放实验室设备。

cards.head: adjudicate
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/判断/动词；使成为

examples.en: A court must adjudicate a dispute according to evidence rather than public anger.
examples.zh: 法庭必须依据证据而非公众愤怒裁决争端。

cards.head: adjudicator
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/判断/动词；使成为/人；物

examples.en: The diagram is an adjunct to the explanation, not a replacement for it.
examples.zh: 图表是解释的辅助，而不是解释的替代品。

examples.en: Farmers adjusted planting dates after spring floods became more common.
examples.zh: 春季洪水变得更常见后，农民调整了播种日期。

examples.en: Families may adjust spending habits when credit card interest becomes difficult to manage.
examples.zh: 当信用卡利息变得难以管理时，家庭可能会调整消费习惯。

examples.en: New students need time to adjust to a different language environment.
examples.zh: 新生需要时间适应不同的语言环境。

cards.head: adjustable
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/正确；合适/能够；可

examples.en: Local governments must administer public funds carefully during expensive events.
examples.zh: 地方政府在举办昂贵活动时必须谨慎管理公共资金。

examples.en: Local governments must administer public funds carefully when hosting expensive international events.
examples.zh: 地方政府在举办昂贵的国际赛事时，必须谨慎管理公共资金。

examples.en: Researchers trained local volunteers to administer the survey in several languages.
examples.zh: 研究者培训当地志愿者用多种语言实施调查。

examples.en: Only trained nurses should administer the vaccine in remote clinics.
examples.zh: 只有受过训练的护士才应在偏远诊所施用疫苗。

examples.en: Public administration fails when rules are clear only to officials.
examples.zh: 当规则只有官员能看懂时，公共行政就会失败。

cards.head: administrative
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/服务；管理/形容词

examples.en: An administrative burden can stop people from using services they legally deserve.
examples.zh: 行政负担会阻止人们使用他们依法应得的服务。

cards.head: administratively
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/服务；管理/形容词/副词

cards.head: admirable
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/惊奇；敬佩/能够；可

examples.en: A naval admiral must make decisions under uncertainty and pressure.
examples.zh: 海军上将必须在不确定性和压力下作出决策。

cards.head: admiralship
cards.cutMeaning: 指挥；海军将领/名词/身份；关系

phrases.zh: 战时指挥中的海军上将职位

examples.en: The rescue team's courage earned public admiration.
examples.zh: 救援队的勇气赢得了公众钦佩。

examples.en: Many young scientists admire researchers who share data openly.
examples.zh: 许多年轻科学家钦佩那些公开分享数据的研究者。

examples.en: Admission to the program depends on test scores, interviews, and previous study.
examples.zh: 这个项目的录取取决于考试成绩、面试和先前学习经历。

examples.en: His admission of error helped the team correct the report before publication.
examples.zh: 他承认错误帮助团队在发表前修正了报告。

examples.en: Officials admitted that the warning system had failed during the storm.
examples.zh: 官员承认预警系统在风暴中失效了。

examples.en: The hospital admitted patients from nearby towns after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震后，医院接收了来自附近城镇的病人。

cards.head: admitted
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/送入；承认/形容词

senses.zh: 被承认的；被准许进入的

cards.head: admitting
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/送入；承认/名词；形容词

examples.en: The teacher's admonition was calm, but every student understood the risk.
examples.zh: 老师的告诫很平静，但每个学生都明白其中的风险。

phrases.zh: 政策指导中的告诫语气

examples.en: Adobe walls keep houses cool in dry regions.
examples.zh: 土坯墙能让干旱地区的房屋保持凉爽。

cards.head: adolescent
cards.cutMeaning: 向成熟/成长/名词；形容词

examples.en: An adolescent may need privacy while still depending on adults for safety.
examples.zh: 青少年可能需要隐私，同时仍依赖成年人提供安全保障。

examples.en: Adolescent development is shaped by family pressure, school culture, and online life.
examples.zh: 青少年发展受家庭压力、学校文化和网络生活的影响。

examples.en: Adolescent development is shaped by family pressure, school culture, and online life.
examples.zh: 青少年发展受家庭压力、学校文化和网络生活的影响。

examples.en: The school adopted a new reading program after test scores fell.
examples.zh: 考试成绩下降后，学校采用了新的阅读项目。

examples.en: The couple decided to adopt a child after years of working with foster families.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇与寄养家庭合作多年后决定收养一个孩子。

examples.en: The shelter listed adoptable animals on its website.
examples.zh: 收容所在网站上列出可收养动物。

phrases.zh: 与采用；收养相关的证据

examples.en: Local artists adorn the temple gate with painted flowers.
examples.zh: 当地艺术家用彩绘花朵装饰寺庙大门。

examples.en: The rescue team advanced slowly through the flooded street.
examples.zh: 救援队在被洪水淹没的街道上缓慢前进。

examples.en: Governments should advance public interests rather than protect narrow commercial gains today.
examples.zh: 如今政府应促进公共利益，而不是保护狭隘的商业收益。

examples.en: Advanced technology can widen inequality if access remains unequal.
examples.zh: 如果获取机会仍不平等，先进技术会扩大不平等。

examples.en: Governments should advance public interests rather than protect narrow commercial gains.
examples.zh: 政府应促进公共利益，而不是保护狭隘的商业收益。

examples.en: The advance in vaccine storage made rural health programs more reliable.
examples.zh: 疫苗储存方面的进步让农村卫生项目更加可靠。

examples.en: Advance notice gave residents time to move animals away from the river.
examples.zh: 提前通知让居民有时间把动物转移到远离河流的地方。

examples.en: Advanced sensors detect pollution before it becomes visible.
examples.zh: 先进传感器能在污染变得可见前探测到它。

examples.en: Advanced students worked with original research papers.
examples.zh: 高级学生使用原始研究论文学习。

examples.en: Early access gave the research team an advantage over later applicants.
examples.zh: 提前获得权限使研究团队比后来的申请者有优势。

examples.en: The advent of cheap printing changed education and politics.
examples.zh: 廉价印刷的出现改变了教育和政治。

examples.en: The journey became an adventure when the map proved wrong.
examples.zh: 地图被证明错误后，这趟旅程成了奇遇。

examples.en: Climbing the glacier was a dangerous adventure.
examples.zh: 攀登冰川是一项危险冒险活动。

examples.en: An adverb can show how, when, or where an action happens.
examples.zh: 副词可以表示动作如何、何时或在哪里发生。

examples.en: A skilled negotiator tries to understand an adversary before making an offer.
examples.zh: 熟练的谈判者会先理解对手，再提出条件。

examples.en: Adverse comments in the press damaged the project.
examples.zh: 媒体的负面评论损害了项目。

examples.en: Adverse weather delayed the rescue flight.
examples.zh: 不利天气推迟了救援航班。

examples.en: Companies advertise online because attention can be measured and sold.
examples.zh: 公司在线打广告，因为注意力可以被衡量和出售。

examples.en: Companies advertise products more aggressively when consumer attention becomes scarce.
examples.zh: 当消费者注意力变得稀缺时，公司会更激进地宣传产品。

cards.head: advertising
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/转/动词/名词；形容词

examples.en: Advertising can shape demand before consumers compare real quality.
examples.zh: 广告会在消费者比较真实质量之前影响需求。

examples.en: The advertising budget was larger than the budget for product testing.
examples.zh: 广告预算比产品测试预算更大。

examples.en: It is advisable to test the water before reopening the well.
examples.zh: 重新开放水井前检测水质是可取的。

examples.en: The advisory group warned that the schedule was unrealistic.
examples.zh: 顾问小组警告说这个时间表不现实。

examples.en: Rights advocacy groups may oppose policies that harm civilians or silence criticism.
examples.zh: 权利倡导团体可能反对伤害平民或压制批评的政策。

examples.en: Rights advocacy groups may oppose trade sanction if they threaten national sovereignty or harm civilians.
examples.zh: 如果贸易制裁威胁国家主权或伤害平民，权利倡导团体可能反对它们。

examples.en: Legal advocacy can help poor families challenge unfair housing decisions.
examples.zh: 法律辩护工作可以帮助贫困家庭挑战不公平的住房决定。

cards.head: advocate
cards.cutMeaning: 朝向；加强/叫喊，声音/动词；使成为

examples.en: Many educators advocate mixed education because it reduces labeling and encourages peer support.
examples.zh: 许多教育者提倡混合教育，因为它减少标签化并鼓励同伴互助。

examples.en: Researchers may advocate reform when evidence shows repeated harm.
examples.zh: 当证据显示反复伤害时，研究者可能会倡导改革。

examples.en: Over aeons, small climatic shifts can reshape entire ecosystems.
examples.zh: 历经万古，微小的气候变化也能重塑整个生态系统。

examples.en: Aerial photographs revealed old field boundaries hidden beneath modern crops.
examples.zh: 航拍照片揭示了隐藏在现代作物下的旧田界。

examples.en: The radio aerial had to be raised above the roof to receive a clear signal.
examples.zh: 无线电天线必须升到屋顶以上，才能接收到清晰信号。

senses.zh: 增氧健身法的 ] n. 有氧运动
空气动力学的；流线型的

examples.en: Aerodynamic design can reduce energy use by lowering resistance.
examples.zh: 空气动力学设计可以通过降低阻力来减少能源使用。

examples.en: Aeronautic research improved wing shapes long before commercial flights became common.
examples.zh: 早在商业飞行普及之前，航空研究就改进了机翼形状。

examples.en: A public sculpture is judged not only by material cost but also by its aesthetic value in the surrounding space.
examples.zh: 公共雕塑的评价不只取决于材料成本，也取决于它在周围空间中的审美价值。

examples.en: The bridge had aesthetic value as well as practical strength.
examples.zh: 这座桥既有实用强度，也有审美价值。

examples.en: The museum's aesthetic favoured simple shapes and natural materials.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆的审美风格偏好简单形状和天然材料。

cards.head: aestheticism
cards.cutMeaning: 加强/感觉/形容词/主义；学说

phrases.zh: 维多利亚时期唯美主义

examples.en: Noise pollution can affect health even when residents adapt to it gradually.
examples.zh: 即使居民逐渐适应了噪音污染，它仍会影响健康。

examples.en: The story affected many readers who had lost homes.
examples.zh: 这个故事感动了许多失去家园的读者。

examples.en: The disease affected children more severely than adults.
examples.zh: 这种疾病感染儿童比成年人更严重。

examples.en: The old teacher spoke with affection about former students.
examples.zh: 老教师带着喜爱谈起以前的学生。

examples.en: Early affection can influence a child's confidence.
examples.zh: 早期关爱会影响孩子的信心。

cards.head: affinity
cards.cutMeaning: 朝向；加强/范围/名词；形容词

examples.en: The two languages show an affinity in grammar and sound.
examples.zh: 这两种语言在语法和声音上显示出密切关系。

senses.gloss: state or quality of being affinity, attraction

examples.en: The chemical has an affinity for water.
examples.zh: 这种化学物质对水有吸引力。

senses.gloss: state or quality of being affinity, liking

examples.en: She felt an affinity for music from early childhood.
examples.zh: 她从幼年起就喜爱音乐。

examples.en: The witness affirmed that the door was locked.
examples.zh: 证人断言门是锁着的。

examples.en: The court affirmed the right to public access.
examples.zh: 法院坚持声称公众有进入权。

cards.head: affirmative
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/稳固；确认/形容词

examples.en: The judge gave an affirmative answer after checking the document.
examples.zh: 法官检查文件后给出了肯定回答。

examples.en: Affirmative policies aimed to correct long-term exclusion from universities.
examples.zh: 积极支持性政策旨在纠正大学长期排斥某些群体的问题。

cards.head: affirmatively
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/稳固；确认/形容词/副词

examples.en: The committee responded affirmatively after reviewing the safety evidence.
examples.zh: 委员会审查安全证据后作出了肯定回应。

examples.en: Poor sanitation can afflict a whole community with disease.
examples.zh: 卫生条件差会使整个社区受疾病折磨。

cards.head: affluent
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/流动/形容词；名词

examples.en: Affluent districts often have better schools and quieter streets.
examples.zh: 富裕地区通常有更好的学校和更安静的街道。

examples.en: Many families cannot afford basic services when transport and rent rise together.
examples.zh: 当交通和房租同时上涨时，许多家庭负担不起基本服务。

examples.en: Small clinics cannot afford to lose trained nurses during a health emergency.
examples.zh: 在卫生紧急情况下，小诊所承受不起失去受训护士的后果。

examples.en: The hilltop affords a clear view of the river valley and old field walls.
examples.zh: 山顶提供了俯瞰河谷和旧田墙的清晰视野。

cards.head: affordability
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/供给；拿出/能够/名词

examples.en: Housing affordability affects where young workers can live and study.
examples.zh: 住房可负担性影响年轻劳动者能在哪里生活和学习。

cards.head: affordable
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/供给；拿出/能够的

senses.zh: 负担得起的；价格合理的

examples.en: Affordable housing affects health, mobility, and family stability.
examples.zh: 可负担住房影响健康、流动性和家庭稳定。

cards.head: affordably
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/供给；拿出/能够；可/副词

phrases.zh: 以可负担方式扩大医疗
以可负担方式改造旧建筑

cards.head: afforest
cards.cutMeaning: 朝向；加强/叶；草/休息；剩余

examples.en: Careful afforestation can stabilize a river catchment because tree roots slow runoff and reduce erosion.
examples.zh: 谨慎造林可以稳定河流集水区，因为树根减缓径流并减少侵蚀。

examples.en: People may feel afraid to return home when aftershock risk remains high.
examples.zh: 当余震风险仍然很高时，人们可能害怕回家。

phrases.zh: 年龄队列读写能力差异

examples.en: A travel agency arranged boats, guides, and permits for the research team.
examples.zh: 旅行社为研究团队安排了船只、向导和许可证。

examples.en: Human agency matters, but social structure limits which choices are realistically available.
examples.zh: 人的能动性很重要，但社会结构限制了哪些选择在现实中可行。

examples.en: The environmental agency tested river water after residents reported dead fish.
examples.zh: 居民报告死鱼后，环境机构检测了河水。

examples.en: Human agency matters, but social structure limits which choices are realistically available.
examples.zh: 人的能动性很重要，但社会结构限制了哪些选择在现实中可行。

examples.en: A travel agent helped the group avoid unsafe roads during the rainy season.
examples.zh: 旅行代理帮助这个团队避开雨季中不安全的道路。

examples.en: Mosquitoes can act as an agent that spreads disease between communities.
examples.zh: 蚊子可以作为在社区之间传播疾病的致因因素。

senses.zh: 行动者的；具有能动性的

cards.head: agentic
cards.cutMeaning: 做；行动/人或物/形容词；名词

examples.en: Urban agglomeration can benefit an elite by concentrating jobs, schools, and political influence in one region.
examples.zh: 城市集聚可以通过把工作、学校和政治影响集中在一个地区而使精英受益。

examples.en: More private cars will aggravate urban congestion unless cities expand reliable public transport.
examples.zh: 除非城市扩建可靠的公共交通，否则更多私家车会加剧城市拥堵。

examples.en: Poor communication can aggravate inequality by confusing the people who need help most.
examples.zh: 糟糕沟通会让最需要帮助的人感到困惑，从而加剧不平等。

cards.head: aggravation
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/重/动词；使成为/名词

cards.head: aggregate
cards.cutMeaning: 做；驱动/团体/动词；使成为

examples.en: The geologist described the sample as a dark aggregate rock.
examples.zh: 地质学家把样本描述为深色聚成岩。

examples.en: The survey reports the aggregate of all household responses.
examples.zh: 调查报告了所有家庭回答的聚集结果。

examples.en: A state may aggress when institutions fail to restrain military power.
examples.zh: 当制度无法约束军事力量时，一个国家可能会发动侵略。

phrases.zh: 在领土争端中挑起冲突

examples.en: Social behaviour may shift from altruism to narcissism when insecurity turns self-focus into defensive aggression.
examples.zh: 当不安全感把自我关注转化为防御性攻击时，社会行为可能从利他主义转向自恋。

examples.en: Aggressive behaviour made other animals leave the feeding area.
examples.zh: 攻击性行为使其他动物离开了进食区。

examples.en: The company used an aggressive strategy to enter the foreign market.
examples.zh: 这家公司采用强势策略进入外国市场。

examples.en: An aggressive infection can spread before patients notice clear symptoms.
examples.zh: 强烈的感染可能在病人注意到明显症状前扩散。

cards.head: aggressively
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/走；进攻/形容词/副词

examples.en: The campaign attacked its opponents aggressively instead of explaining its own plan.
examples.zh: 这场竞选强硬攻击对手，而不是解释自己的计划。

phrases.zh: 以 aggressively 方式呈现的重要证据
与使受委屈相关的证据

examples.en: An agile animal can escape predators in dense forest.
examples.zh: 敏捷动物能在密林中逃离捕食者。

examples.en: Agitation spread through the crowd after the alarm.
examples.zh: 警报后，人群中蔓延出激动情绪。

examples.en: Political agitation increased before the election.
examples.zh: 选举前，政治煽动增加。

senses.zh: 集市广场；公共议事空间

examples.en: People may agree on a solution only after the real conflict is named.
examples.zh: 人们可能只有在真正冲突被说清后，才能就解决方案达成一致。

examples.en: The two maps agree on the river's path but differ on village names.
examples.zh: 两张地图在河流路径上相符，但村名不同。

cards.head: agreeable
cards.cutMeaning: 同意；令人愉快/能够；形容词

examples.en: An international agreement can help countries manage food imports during climate-related supply shocks.
examples.zh: 国际协议可以帮助各国在气候相关供应冲击期间管理食品进口。

cards.head: agricultural
cards.cutMeaning: 田地；农业/耕种/名词/形容词

examples.en: Agricultural production increased when irrigation became reliable.
examples.zh: 灌溉变得可靠后，农业产量增加了。

examples.en: Modern agriculture depends on soil, water, machinery, and reliable markets.
examples.zh: 现代农业依赖土壤、水、机械和可靠市场。

examples.en: Modern agronomy improves crop production, while sustainable aquaculture manages fish growth without destroying water quality.
examples.zh: 现代农学改善作物生产，而可持续水产养殖在不破坏水质的情况下管理鱼类生长。

cards.head: aids
cards.cutMeaning: 获得性免疫缺陷综合征

senses.zh: 艾滋病；获得性免疫缺陷综合征

examples.en: Public health campaigns reduced AIDS-related stigma by explaining how the disease is transmitted.
examples.zh: 公共卫生宣传通过解释疾病传播方式，减少了与艾滋病相关的污名。

examples.en: A minor ailment can become serious without clean water or rest.
examples.zh: 没有清洁水源或休息时，小病也可能变严重。

examples.en: Fresh air entered through the open window.
examples.zh: 新鲜空气从开着的窗户进入。

examples.en: The upper air was too dry for cloud formation.
examples.zh: 高层大气太干，不利于成云。

examples.en: Smoke rose into the air above the town.
examples.zh: 烟升入城镇上方的天空。

examples.en: He spoke with the air of a man who expected obedience.
examples.zh: 他说话带着一种期待服从的架子。

examples.en: Airborne particles can travel far beyond the factory gate.
examples.zh: 空气传播颗粒可以飘到工厂大门之外很远。

examples.en: An air bubble trapped in the glass changed the way light passed through it.
examples.zh: 困在玻璃里的气泡改变了光线穿过它的方式。

examples.en: The aircraft landed safely despite strong crosswinds.
examples.zh: 尽管有强侧风，飞机仍安全着陆。

examples.en: Strategic airpower can change a war without controlling every road on the ground.
examples.zh: 战略空中力量可以在不控制地面每条道路的情况下改变战争。

examples.en: The metronome was stored in the cabinet beside the central aisle.
examples.zh: 节拍器存放在中央过道旁的柜子里。

examples.en: The alarm rang before dawn and woke the whole building.
examples.zh: 闹钟黎明前响起，吵醒了整栋楼。

examples.en: A fire alarm sent workers out of the factory.
examples.zh: 火警警报让工人离开工厂。

examples.en: The sudden drop in oxygen alarmed the doctors.
examples.zh: 氧气突然下降使医生惊恐。

cards.head: alchemical
cards.cutMeaning: 炼金术/化学/形容词/形容词

examples.en: Alchemical texts mixed practical experiments with symbolic language.
examples.zh: 炼金术文本把实际实验和象征语言混在一起。

examples.en: A medieval alchemist might heat metals while searching for hidden principles of change.
examples.zh: 中世纪炼金术士可能一边加热金属，一边寻找变化的隐藏原则。

examples.en: An alert guard noticed movement near the gate.
examples.zh: 机警警卫注意到大门附近有动静。

examples.en: The message alerted residents to possible flooding.
examples.zh: 这条消息提醒居民可能发生洪水。

examples.en: Driver alertness falls quickly after midnight, especially on long empty roads.
examples.zh: 午夜之后，司机的警觉性会迅速下降，尤其是在漫长空旷的道路上。

examples.en: Alga grows quickly when warm water contains too many nutrients.
examples.zh: 温暖水体营养过多时，藻类会迅速生长。

examples.en: Photosynthetic algae support many aquatic food chains.
examples.zh: 光合藻类支撑许多水生食物链。

examples.en: Learning linear algebra helps students understand data, models, and algorithms.
examples.zh: 学习线性代数帮助学生理解数据、模型和算法。

cards.head: algebraic
cards.cutMeaning: 还原；合并/数学规则/形容词；名词

examples.en: An algorithm may adjust a variable repeatedly until a model produces reliable predictions.
examples.zh: 算法可能反复调整变量，直到模型产生可靠预测。

examples.en: An algorithmic platform can still fail if poor interoperability prevents data from moving between public systems.
examples.zh: 算法平台若互操作性差，导致数据无法在公共系统间流动，仍可能失败。

examples.en: Algorithmic bias can become invisible when users cannot inspect the system.
examples.zh: 当用户无法检查系统时，算法偏见可能变得不可见。

cards.head: alien
cards.cutMeaning: 其他的，改变状态/动词；使成为

cards.head: alienable
cards.cutMeaning: 其他的，改变状态/动词；使成为/能够；可

cards.head: alienate
cards.cutMeaning: 其他的，改变状态/动词；使成为/动词；使成为

examples.en: Harsh rules may alienate the very people the policy is meant to help.
examples.zh: 严苛规则可能疏远政策本想帮助的人。

cards.head: alienation
cards.cutMeaning: 其他的，改变状态/动词；使成为/动词；使成为/名词

examples.en: Workplace alienation may decrease when employees build solidarity through shared goals and mutual support.
examples.zh: 当员工通过共同目标和相互支持建立团结时，职场疏离可能减少。

cards.head: alienist
cards.cutMeaning: 其他的，改变状态/动词；使成为/人；从业者

phrases.zh: 法律史中的精神病学家

examples.en: Engineers aligned the satellite instruments before collecting images.
examples.zh: 工程师在收集图像前对齐了卫星仪器。

examples.en: Governments should align policy goals before expanding transport networks around overcrowded cities.
examples.zh: 政府在扩建拥挤城市周边交通网络前，应先协调政策目标。

examples.en: Institutions work better when they align interests instead of hiding conflict.
examples.zh: 当机构协调利益而不是掩盖冲突时，它们运作得更好。

examples.en: Governments should align policy goals before expanding transport networks.
examples.zh: 政府在扩建交通网络前，应先协调政策目标。

examples.en: The alignment of the stones suggests that builders followed the path of the sun.
examples.zh: 这些石块的排列说明建造者可能遵循了太阳的路径。

examples.en: Better alignment between schools and employers helped students find practical training.
examples.zh: 学校和雇主之间更好的一致性帮助学生找到实践培训。

examples.en: The small states formed an alignment to protect trade across the region.
examples.zh: 这些小国组成联盟以保护该地区的贸易。

examples.en: The two fossils look alike, but they belong to different species.
examples.zh: 这两块化石看起来相似，但属于不同物种。

examples.en: A solvent can dissolve a substance, but an alkaline solution may change the result of the reaction.
examples.zh: 溶剂可以溶解物质，但碱性溶液可能改变反应结果。

examples.en: Clear test results helped allay fears about the water supply.
examples.zh: 清楚的检测结果帮助减轻了对供水的担忧。

examples.en: The allegation of bribery forced the minister to release financial records.
examples.zh: 受贿指控迫使部长公开财务记录。

examples.en: Soldiers swore allegiance to the new government.
examples.zh: 士兵宣誓效忠新政府。

examples.en: Her allegiance to the old school remained strong.
examples.zh: 她对旧学校的忠贞依然强烈。

examples.en: The crowd showed allegiance to the reform leader.
examples.zh: 人群表现出对改革领袖的拥戴。

cards.head: allegorical
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/寓言；象征/形容词/形容词

examples.en: An allegorical story can criticise power without naming it directly.
examples.zh: 寓言式故事可以不直接点名地批判权力。

examples.en: An allegorical story can criticise power without naming real rulers.
examples.zh: 寓言故事可以在不点名真实统治者的情况下批判权力。

cards.head: allegorically
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/寓言；象征/形容词/形容词/副词

phrases.zh: 与寓言式地相关的证据

cards.head: allegorist
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/法律/人；物/人；从业者

phrases.zh: 与寓言作者；寓意解释者相关的证据

examples.zh: 政治寓言可以把批评藏在虚构中，从而让审查更困难。

examples.zh: 资源分配比口号更清楚地揭示一个系统重视什么。

examples.zh: 旅行津贴覆盖火车费用，但不包括酒店。

examples.zh: 合金结合金属，而复合材料可能结合纤维和树脂，以在不过度增加重量的情况下提高强度。

examples.zh: 制造商把钢与铬制成合金，使其抗锈。

examples.zh: 老师一起带来了额外书籍。

examples.zh: 信用卡可能通过鼓励人们先消费后储蓄来改变消费模式。

examples.zh: 这条路使用石头和沙子的交替层来排水。

examples.zh: 医生建议了一种副作用更少的替代治疗。

examples.zh: 这座旧桥完全无法承受现代交通。

examples.zh: 灾难过后，人们与陌生人分享食物时，人类利他主义就会显现。

examples.zh: 当不安全感把自我关注转化为防御性攻击时，社会行为可能从利他主义转向自恋。

examples.en: Small towns may amalgamate local services when populations decline and budgets become tighter.

examples.zh: 医生可能切除感染组织以防疾病扩散。

examples.zh: 解剖学证据可以显示古代物种如何移动和生存。

examples.zh: 比较解剖学家可以识别揭示进化历史的相似性。

examples.zh: 解剖学家的绘图帮助早期医学理解人体。

examples.zh: 比较解剖学展示了不同物种如何解决相似的身体结构问题。

examples.zh: 这种鸟的身体结构使它能够快速潜水并在水下转向。

examples.zh: 对论证的剖析揭示了证据和结论之间的薄弱联系。

examples.zh: 这些家庭在现代边界出现很久以前，就已从祖先方面与这片山谷相连。

examples.zh: 风变强时，船员放下了锚。

examples.zh: 古代城市常在河流附近发展，因为水支持贸易和农业。

examples.zh: 一棵古老的树可以在年轮中记录数百年的干旱、火灾和恢复。

examples.zh: 被子植物产生包在果实中的种子。

examples.zh: 屋顶以陡角建造，便于雪滑落。

examples.zh: 从另一个角度看，这项政策显得不那么公平。

examples.zh: 早期显微镜让科学家能够观察水中的微生物。

examples.zh: 数字动画可以把抽象知识转化为可见运动。

examples.zh: 帝国在短暂战役后兼并了这座岛。

examples.zh: 核武器可以在数分钟内毁灭城市，并留下长期创伤。

examples.zh: 只有在人们信任机构时，官方公告才能减少恐慌。

examples.en: A public announcement must be clear during a health emergency.
examples.zh: 公共卫生紧急情况下，公开公告必须清晰。

examples.en: The announcement of the discovery brought reporters to the laboratory.
examples.zh: 这一发现的发布把记者带到了实验室。

examples.en: A notice on the door served as an announcement of the schedule change.
examples.zh: 门上的通知起到了宣布日程变更的作用。

examples.en: Residents were annoyed when construction noise began before dawn.
examples.zh: 施工噪声黎明前开始时，居民很生气。

cards.head: annoying
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/伤害；烦扰/名词；形容词

examples.en: An annoying sound can reduce concentration during study.
examples.zh: 令人烦恼的声音会降低学习时的注意力。

cards.head: annoyingly
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/伤害；烦扰/名词；形容词/副词

examples.en: The annual report compares rainfall, crop yields, and household income.
examples.zh: 年度报告比较了降雨量、作物产量和家庭收入。

examples.en: The school annual preserved photographs of students who later became local leaders.
examples.zh: 学校年刊保存了后来成为地方领导者的学生照片。

examples.en: The river is measured annually so engineers can track long-term changes.
examples.zh: 这条河每年都会测量，以便工程师追踪长期变化。

examples.en: The annuity provided a fixed payment every year after retirement.
examples.zh: 年金在退休后每年提供固定付款。

examples.en: Battery anode design affects storage capacity and charging speed.
examples.zh: 电池阳极设计影响储能容量和充电速度。

senses.zh: 奇虾；寒武纪大型捕食动物

examples.en: Anomalocaris was a large Cambrian predator with grasping appendages near its mouth.
examples.zh: 奇虾是一种寒武纪大型捕食动物，口部附近有抓握附肢。

phrases.zh: 形态学中的异常样特征

examples.en: An anomalous result should be investigated rather than ignored.
examples.zh: 异常结果应该被调查，而不是被忽视。

examples.en: A climate anomaly can reveal itself through unusual rainfall, heat, or ocean temperature.
examples.zh: 气候异常可能通过异常降雨、高温或海洋温度表现出来。

examples.en: The small island was an anomaly because its language survived despite centuries of trade.
examples.zh: 这个小岛是一个异常案例，因为它的语言在数百年贸易中仍然保存下来。

examples.en: The survey protected anonymity so workers could answer honestly.
examples.zh: 这项调查保护匿名性，使工人能够诚实回答。

examples.en: An anonymous donor paid for the students' travel costs.
examples.zh: 一位匿名捐赠者支付了学生的旅行费用。

examples.en: Employees could report safety problems anonymously.
examples.zh: 员工可以匿名报告安全问题。

examples.en: In the debate, the scientist's main antagonist questioned every piece of evidence.
examples.zh: 在辩论中，这位科学家的主要对手质疑每一项证据。

examples.en: The novel's antagonist hides his plan until the final chapter.
examples.zh: 小说中的反派直到最后一章才暴露计划。

examples.en: The drug works as an antagonist by blocking the receptor.
examples.zh: 这种药作为拮抗剂，通过阻断受体起作用。

cards.head: antagonistic
cards.cutMeaning: 相对；反/斗争/人/形容词；名词

examples.en: Antagonistic relationships between residents and officials can delay necessary urban reform for years.
examples.zh: 居民和官员之间的对抗关系会让必要的城市改革延误多年。

examples.en: Poor planning can antagonize local residents when stadium construction raises rent and disrupts daily life.
examples.zh: 当场馆建设推高房租并扰乱日常生活时，糟糕规划可能激怒当地居民。

cards.head: antcolony
cards.cutMeaning: 形容词；人；物/共同；一起/名词；形容词

examples.en: The antecedent event helps explain why the conflict began.
examples.zh: 先前事件有助于解释冲突为何开始。

examples.en: Some traditional farming methods antedate modern technology but still protect local ecosystems.
examples.zh: 一些传统农业方法早于现代技术，但仍能保护当地生态系统。

examples.en: An antelope herd may move when water and grass become scarce.
examples.zh: 当水和草变得稀缺时，羚羊群可能会迁移。

examples.en: Antelope migration depends on seasonal rain and available grassland.
examples.zh: 羚羊迁徙取决于季节性降雨和可利用的草原。

phrases.zh: 开阔平原上的羚羊式敏捷

examples.en: The anther releases pollen when the flower is ready for reproduction.
examples.zh: 当花准备繁殖时，花药会释放花粉。

examples.en: An anthrax infection can be deadly without rapid medical treatment.
examples.zh: 如果没有快速医疗处理，炭疽感染可能致命。

examples.en: Anthropic pressure on forests increased as roads opened remote valleys.
examples.zh: 道路打开偏远山谷后，人类对森林的压力增加了。

phrases.zh: 人类中心主义环境伦理

examples.en: Anthropogenesis studies how early humans emerged from earlier primate lineages.
examples.zh: 人类起源研究早期人类如何从更早的灵长类谱系中出现。

examples.en: The study of anthropogenesis must connect biological evidence with social organization, rather than treating humans as isolated bodies.
examples.zh: 人类起源研究必须把生物证据与社会组织联系起来，而不是把人类当作孤立身体。

senses.zh: 人为的；人类活动造成的

cards.head: anthropological
cards.cutMeaning: 人类/学科/形容词/形容词

examples.en: A prehistoric campsite provides anthropological evidence when tools, bones, and hearths appear in the same layer.
examples.zh: 当工具、骨骼和炉灶出现在同一地层中时，史前营地提供人类学证据。

phrases.zh: 人类学家对仪式的研究

examples.en: Cultural anthropology examines how rituals, language, and objects shape social life.
examples.zh: 文化人类学研究仪式、语言和物品如何塑造社会生活。

examples.en: Antibiotic resistance can spread when patients stop treatment too early.
examples.zh: 当患者过早停止治疗时，抗生素耐药性可能扩散。

examples.en: An antibiotic substance may kill bacteria without harming the host.
examples.zh: 抗菌物质可能杀死细菌而不伤害宿主。

examples.en: When a pathogen enters the body, an antibody may bind to it and support immune defence.
examples.zh: 当病原体进入身体时，抗体可能与其结合并支持免疫防御。

examples.en: Farmers anticipated a dry summer and planted crops that needed less water.
examples.zh: 农民预料夏季会干旱，于是种植需水较少的作物。

examples.en: Urban planners should anticipate future demand before expanding roads, housing, and public transport.
examples.zh: 城市规划者在扩建道路、住房和公共交通前，应预判未来需求。

examples.en: Good policy should anticipate risk rather than simply react to disaster.
examples.zh: 好的政策应预判风险，而不是只对灾难作出反应。

examples.en: The city built extra drains to anticipate flooding in newly developed districts.
examples.zh: 这座城市修建了额外排水设施，以提前应对新区洪水。

cards.head: antifascist
cards.cutMeaning: 反对；抵抗/法西斯主义者

examples.en: Antifreeze in the engine prevents water from freezing and damaging the pipes.
examples.zh: 发动机里的防冻剂能防止水结冰并损坏管道。

examples.en: An antifreeze protein can help organisms survive extremely cold conditions.
examples.zh: 抗冻蛋白可以帮助生物在极寒条件下生存。

examples.en: Antifreeze proteins allow some insects to survive extremely low temperatures.
examples.zh: 抗冻蛋白让一些昆虫能够在极低温度中存活。

examples.en: An antifreeze protein can help organisms survive extremely cold conditions.
examples.zh: 抗冻蛋白可以帮助生物在极寒条件下生存。

cards.head: antiquated
cards.cutMeaning: 古老；古董/动词；使成为/形容词

examples.en: Antiquated teaching methods cannot prepare students for digital jobs or rapidly changing workplaces.
examples.zh: 过时的教学方法无法让学生为数字化岗位或快速变化的职场做好准备。

cards.head: antiquatedness
cards.cutMeaning: 古老；古董/动词；使成为/形容词/名词

examples.en: The antique chair was repaired without changing its original wood.
examples.zh: 这把古董椅在不更换原木的情况下被修复。

examples.en: In antiquity, coastal cities often grew rich through trade and shipbuilding.
examples.zh: 在古代，沿海城市常常通过贸易和造船致富。

examples.en: The museum returned the stolen antiquity to the country where it was found.
examples.zh: 博物馆把被盗古物归还给发现它的国家。

cards.head: antiretroviral
cards.cutMeaning: 反对；抵抗/逆转录病毒的

examples.en: Antislavery newspapers helped spread testimony from people who had escaped bondage.
examples.zh: 反奴隶制报纸帮助传播逃离奴役者的证词。

cards.head: antistatic
cards.cutMeaning: 反对；抵抗/站立；状态/形容词；名词

examples.en: Antistatic materials reduce the risk of damage during electronic manufacturing.
examples.zh: 抗静电材料降低了电子制造过程中的损坏风险。

examples.en: For many reformers, censorship is the antithesis of education.
examples.zh: 对许多改革者来说，审查制度是教育的对立面。

examples.en: The speech used antithesis to contrast private wealth with public poverty.
examples.zh: 演讲使用对照法来对比私人财富和公共贫困。

examples.en: A male deer grows new antlers each year before the breeding season.
examples.zh: 雄鹿每年在繁殖季前长出新的鹿角。

phrases.zh: 词汇学习中的反义词教学

examples.en: Exam anxiety can reduce memory even when students have studied carefully.
examples.zh: 考试焦虑会降低记忆表现，即使学生已经认真复习。

examples.en: Parents became anxious when the school failed to explain the new safety rules.
examples.zh: 学校未能解释新的安全规则时，家长变得焦虑。

examples.en: Anxious patients may easily misread online symptoms and delay professional diagnosis during treatment.
examples.zh: 焦虑患者在治疗期间可能容易误读线上症状，并延误专业诊断。

examples.en: The students were anxious to see whether their experiment had worked.
examples.zh: 学生们急切地想知道他们的实验是否成功。

examples.en: The two villages are only five kilometres apart but use different water systems.
examples.zh: 这两个村庄相距只有五公里，却使用不同的供水系统。

examples.en: The island's language developed apart from the mainland dialects.
examples.zh: 这个岛上的语言与大陆方言分开发展。

cards.head: apathic
cards.cutMeaning: 离开；使；无/痛苦，病，感情/形容词；名词

examples.en: Public apathy can allow wasteful projects to continue without serious criticism or debate.
examples.zh: 公众冷漠可能让浪费性的项目在缺乏严肃批评和讨论的情况下继续推进。

cards.head: api
cards.cutMeaning: application programming interface 的缩写；程序接口

examples.en: The API lets one program request data from another program.
examples.zh: API 让一个程序可以向另一个程序请求数据。

examples.en: Leaders should apologise publicly when their decisions cause avoidable harm.
examples.zh: 当领导者的决定造成可避免的伤害时，他们应公开道歉。

examples.en: Leaders should apologise publicly when policy failures harm ordinary citizens.
examples.zh: 当政策失败伤害普通公民时，领导者应公开道歉。

examples.en: Officials should apologize when a preventable error harms residents.
examples.zh: 可避免错误伤害居民时，官员应道歉。

examples.en: A sincere apology must admit harm instead of hiding behind excuses.
examples.zh: 真诚道歉必须承认伤害，而不是躲在借口后面。

examples.en: The app stores each entry before sending it to the server.
examples.zh: 这个应用程序会先保存每条记录，再把它发送到服务器。

examples.en: The laboratory apparatus measured pressure changes inside the sealed chamber.
examples.zh: 实验室设备测量密封舱内的压力变化。

examples.en: A large administrative apparatus was needed to collect taxes across the empire.
examples.zh: 这个帝国需要庞大的行政机构来征收税款。

phrases.zh: 媒体研究中的装置理论
与装置理论相关的证据

examples.en: The cause of the fish deaths became apparent after the factory records were released.
examples.zh: 工厂记录公布后，鱼类死亡的原因变得明显。

examples.en: An apparent improvement in test scores may hide growing pressure on students.
examples.zh: 考试分数的表面改善可能掩盖学生压力增加。

examples.en: An apparent contradiction may disappear when the context is understood.
examples.zh: 当语境被理解后，表面矛盾可能会消失。

examples.en: The apparent success of the policy hid serious problems in rural areas.
examples.zh: 这项政策表面上的成功掩盖了农村地区的严重问题。

cards.head: apparently
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/出现/形容词/副词

examples.en: The disease apparently spread through water rather than direct contact.
examples.zh: 这种疾病显然是通过水传播，而不是直接接触传播。

examples.en: Apparently, the old map was copied from an even earlier drawing.
examples.zh: 据说，这张旧地图是从一幅更早的图复制来的。

examples.en: The charity made an appeal for blankets after the mountain villages lost power.
examples.zh: 山村断电后，慈善机构呼吁捐赠毯子。

examples.en: The old market has strong appeal because visitors can still watch craftspeople at work.
examples.zh: 这个老市场很有吸引力，因为游客仍能看到手工艺人工作。

examples.en: The family decided to appeal after the court rejected their land claim.
examples.zh: 法院驳回土地主张后，这家人决定上诉。

examples.en: The design appealed to younger buyers because it was simple and easy to repair.
examples.zh: 这种设计吸引年轻买家，因为它简单且易于维修。

cards.head: appealing
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/呼吁；吸引/形容词

examples.en: New cracks appeared in the wall after several days of heavy rain.
examples.zh: 连续几天暴雨后，墙上出现了新的裂缝。

examples.en: The policy appeared fair at first, but it affected poor families more severely.
examples.zh: 这项政策起初似乎公平，但它对贫困家庭影响更严重。

examples.en: The sudden appearance of smoke forced the miners to leave the tunnel.
examples.zh: 烟雾突然出现，迫使矿工离开隧道。

examples.en: The building's appearance changed after workers removed the modern paint.
examples.zh: 工人去除现代油漆后，这座建筑的外观发生了变化。

examples.en: The researcher appended field notes to the report so readers could check the source.
examples.zh: 研究者把实地笔记附在报告后，让读者可以核查来源。

examples.en: The conversation became tense before the appetiser reached the table.
examples.zh: 前菜还没上桌，谈话就变得紧张起来。

cards.head: appetising
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/追求；寻找/动词/形容词

examples.en: The soup looked appetising, but nobody at the table felt relaxed.
examples.zh: 这碗汤看起来很开胃，但桌边没人感到放松。

examples.en: A loss of appetite can be an early sign of illness.
examples.zh: 食欲下降可能是疾病的早期迹象。

phrases.zh: 与食欲；欲望相关的证据

examples.en: The audience applauded when the young singer finished.
examples.zh: 年轻歌手唱完后，观众鼓掌喝彩。

examples.en: Teachers applauded the decision to reduce exam pressure.
examples.zh: 教师称赞减少考试压力的决定。

examples.en: A broken appliance can waste electricity even when it still works.
examples.zh: 损坏的电器即使还能运行，也可能浪费电。

examples.en: The rule is applicable to all public hospitals.
examples.zh: 这条规则可应用于所有公立医院。

examples.en: The plan is applicable only if local roads are repaired.
examples.zh: 只有地方道路得到修复，这个计划才可实施。

examples.en: Each applicant submitted a form before joining the expedition society.
examples.zh: 每名申请者在加入探险社团前提交了一张表格。

examples.en: Her application for the scholarship included a recommendation from her supervisor.
examples.zh: 她的奖学金申请包括导师的一封推荐信。

examples.en: The practical application of the theory changed how doctors treated pain.
examples.zh: 这一理论的实际应用改变了医生治疗疼痛的方式。

examples.en: The application of oil keeps the wooden surface from drying out.
examples.zh: 涂油可以防止木质表面变干。

cards.head: applied
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/折叠；应用/形容词

examples.en: She applied for a scholarship before the deadline.
examples.zh: 她在截止日期前申请奖学金。

examples.en: The same method applies to smaller rivers.
examples.zh: 同一方法适用于较小河流。

examples.en: Governments should appoint independent experts before making decisions about online healthcare regulation.
examples.zh: 政府在制定线上医疗监管决策之前，应任命独立专家。

examples.en: Institutions should appoint a committee transparently when public trust is low.
examples.zh: 当公共信任较低时，机构应透明地任命委员会。

cards.head: appointee
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/点，变尖/人；受事者

examples.en: The committee must apportion funds among schools fairly.
examples.zh: 委员会必须在各学校之间公平分配资金。

examples.en: Surgeons may appose tissue edges to support healing.
examples.zh: 外科医生可能会使组织边缘对合以促进愈合。

examples.en: Close apposition between cells can affect how signals move through tissue.
examples.zh: 细胞之间的紧密并置会影响信号在组织中的传递。

cards.head: appraisal
cards.cutMeaning: 加强/价值，赞扬/形容词；名词

phrases.zh: 与评估；估价相关的证据

examples.en: Experts appraise the painting before the museum decides to buy it.
examples.zh: 博物馆决定购买前，专家会评估这幅画。

cards.head: appreciate
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/价值/动词；使成为

examples.en: Visitors appreciate the old temple's quiet design.
examples.zh: 游客赏识这座古庙安静的设计。

phrases.zh: 与升值；欣赏相关的证据

examples.en: The family appreciated the help after the fire.
examples.zh: 火灾后，这家人感激所得到的帮助。

examples.en: The course gave students an appreciation of local history.
examples.zh: 这门课让学生学会欣赏地方历史。

examples.en: Her appreciation for folk music grew after travelling inland.
examples.zh: 内陆旅行后，她对民间音乐的兴趣增长了。

examples.en: Consumers often fail to apprehend complex risks when online medical information sounds confident.
examples.zh: 当线上医疗信息听起来很自信时，消费者常常无法理解复杂风险。

cards.head: apprehensive
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/预先/抓住/形容词

examples.en: Apprehensive parents may strongly oppose ability grouping if it damages children's confidence.
examples.zh: 如果按能力分班会伤害孩子自信，忧虑的父母可能强烈反对它。

examples.en: People may feel apprehensive about change when they do not understand its purpose.
examples.zh: 当人们不理解变化的目的时，可能会对变化感到忧虑。

cards.head: apprehensively
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/预先/抓住/形容词/副词

cards.head: apprehensiveness
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/预先/抓住/形容词/名词

examples.en: His apprenticeship in carpentry began at sixteen.
examples.zh: 他的木工学徒工作十六岁开始。

examples.en: The apprenticeship lasted four years and included evening classes.
examples.zh: 学徒年限为四年，并包括夜校课程。

phrases.zh: 与通知；告知相关的证据

examples.en: The rescue boat approached the island at low speed.
examples.zh: 救援船低速接近岛屿。

examples.en: A patient approach works better with nervous beginners.
examples.zh: 耐心方法对紧张的初学者更有效。

cards.head: appropriate
cards.cutMeaning: 朝向；加强/自己的/动词；使成为

examples.en: An appropriate response to ageing requires healthcare reform, pension support, and flexible employment.
examples.zh: 应对老龄化的适当回应需要医疗改革、养老金支持和灵活就业。

cards.head: appropriately
cards.cutMeaning: 朝向；加强/自己的/动词；使成为/副词

cards.head: appropriateness
cards.cutMeaning: 朝向；加强/自己的/动词；使成为/名词

cards.head: appropriation
cards.cutMeaning: 朝向；加强/自己的/动词；使成为/名词

examples.en: Official approval was required before the trial could enter its next phase.
examples.zh: 试验进入下一阶段前需要官方批准。

examples.en: The council approved the new housing plan.
examples.zh: 委员会批准了新的住房计划。

examples.en: Most residents approved of the cleaner bus system.
examples.zh: 大多数居民赞成更清洁的公交系统。

cards.head: approximate
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/接近/动词；形容词

examples.en: Early figures may only approximate the cost of large transport projects.
examples.zh: 早期数字可能只能粗略估算大型交通项目的成本。

examples.en: Early figures may only approximate the cost of transport projects and stadiums.
examples.zh: 早期数字可能只能粗略估算交通项目和体育场的成本。

examples.en: An approximate value is useful when exact data are not yet available.
examples.zh: 当精确数据尚不可得时，近似值很有用。

examples.en: The approximate value is useful for planning, but not for final payment.
examples.zh: 近似值对规划有用，但不能用于最终付款。

cards.head: approximately
cards.cutMeaning: 向；加强/接近/形容词/副词

examples.en: The wall was approximately two metres thick.
examples.zh: 这堵墙大约两米厚。

examples.en: Statistical significance should not be confused with practical importance, especially when an approximation is based on limited data.
