examples.zh: 研究的开放获取可以减少富裕大学和贫困大学之间的不平等。

phrases.zh: 以 openly 方式呈现的重要证据

examples.en: Hospitals must operate under pressure during epidemics and natural disasters.
examples.zh: 在流行病和自然灾害期间，医院必须在压力下运作。

senses.zh: 动手术，开刀，（对…）施行手术

examples.en: The surgeon operated on the patient early the next morning.
examples.zh: 外科医生第二天一早给病人做了手术。

examples.en: His operatic voice filled the hall without a microphone.
examples.zh: 他歌剧般的嗓音不用麦克风就充满了大厅。

cards.head: operational
cards.cutMeaning: 工作；操作/动词/名词/形容词

examples.en: The auction system became operational after the supervisor verified every version.
examples.zh: 主管核实每个版本后，拍卖系统开始运行。

examples.en: An ophthalmologist examined the damaged eye after the chemical spill.
examples.zh: 化学品泄漏后，眼科医生检查了受损眼睛。

examples.en: Public opinion changed after residents saw the full cost of the proposal.
examples.zh: 居民看到该提案的全部成本后，公众观点发生了变化。

examples.en: A political opponent may criticize stadium spending to expose hidden public costs.
examples.zh: 政治对手可能批评体育场支出，以揭露隐藏公共成本。

examples.en: A political opponent can reveal weaknesses that supporters prefer to ignore.
examples.zh: 政治对手可以揭示支持者更愿意忽视的弱点。

cards.head: opportunistic
cards.cutMeaning: 朝向/携带；机会/名词/人/形容词

examples.en: Opportunistic firms raised prices when supplies became scarce.
examples.zh: 供应短缺时，机会主义公司提高了价格。

examples.en: Equal opportunity requires more than telling everyone to compete.
examples.zh: 平等机会需要的不只是让所有人竞争。

examples.en: Equal educational opportunity can reduce long-term social inequality.
examples.zh: 平等的教育机会可以减少长期社会不平等。

examples.en: Residents may oppose excessive spending when stadiums bring little long-term benefit.
examples.zh: 当体育场几乎没有长期收益时，居民可能反对过度支出。

examples.en: Several doctors were opposed to the plan because it reduced patient care.
examples.zh: 几位医生反对该计划，因为它削弱了病人护理。

examples.en: The two witnesses gave opposite accounts of the accident.
examples.zh: 两名证人对事故给出了相反说法。

examples.en: Cold is the opposite of heat.
examples.zh: 冷是热的相反事物。

examples.en: Strong opposition can force a policy to become clearer.
examples.zh: 强烈反对可以迫使政策变得更清楚。

examples.en: The regime used fear to oppress critics and silence newspapers.
examples.zh: 该政权用恐惧压迫批评者并使报纸噤声。

examples.en: Persistent oppression can produce political radicalism when ordinary reform no longer appears capable of solving injustice.
examples.zh: 持续压迫可能产生政治激进主义，因为普通改革不再显得能解决不公。

examples.en: The optic nerve carries visual information from the eye to the brain.
examples.zh: 视神经把视觉信息从眼睛传到大脑。

examples.en: Optical instruments expanded what scientists could observe in nature.
examples.zh: 光学仪器扩展了科学家观察自然的能力。

examples.en: The optimal temperature keeps the bacteria alive without letting them grow too fast.
examples.zh: 最佳温度能让细菌存活，又不会让它们生长过快。

examples.en: Optimisation reduced fuel use without slowing the delivery route.
examples.zh: 优化在不减慢配送路线的情况下降低了燃料使用。

examples.en: Engineers optimise the system to reduce wasted energy.
examples.zh: 工程师优化系统以减少能源浪费。

examples.en: The engineer was optimistic after the first test produced stable results.
examples.zh: 第一次测试产生稳定结果后，工程师很乐观。

cards.head: optimization
cards.cutMeaning: 朝向；反对/害怕；评价/动词/名词

examples.en: geothermal energy becomes more viable when process optimization reduces drilling costs and improves heat transfer.
examples.zh: 当地热能源的流程优化降低钻探成本并改善热传递时，它会更可行。

cards.head: optimize
cards.cutMeaning: 朝向；反对/害怕；评价/动词

examples.en: Digital systems can optimize public services if data protection remains strong enough.
examples.zh: 如果数据保护足够有力，数字系统可以优化公共服务。

cards.head: optimized
cards.cutMeaning: 朝向；反对/害怕；评价/动词/形容词

examples.en: The optimized route saved fuel without increasing delivery time.
examples.zh: 优化路线节省了燃料，同时没有增加配送时间。

cards.head: optimizer
cards.cutMeaning: 朝向；反对/害怕；评价/动词/人；物

cards.head: option
cards.cutMeaning: 对着；加强/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: The cheapest option was not always the safest one.
examples.zh: 最便宜的选项并不总是最安全的。

examples.en: Ancient rulers sometimes asked an oracle before making war.
examples.zh: 古代统治者有时在发动战争前请示神谕。

examples.en: Oral instructions are easy to forget without written notes.
examples.zh: 没有书面笔记时，口头指示很容易被忘记。

examples.en: The medicine can be taken orally, so patients do not need injections.
examples.zh: 这种药可以口服，因此病人不需要注射。

examples.en: Orangutan habitat loss is closely linked to land use and trade.
examples.zh: 猩猩栖息地丧失与土地使用和贸易密切相关。

examples.en: An oratorio tells a religious story through music rather than stage action.
examples.zh: 清唱剧通过音乐而不是舞台动作讲述宗教故事。

examples.en: Astronomers track celestial bodies, such as a comet, by calculating their orbit and comparing observations made across different nights.
examples.zh: 天文学家通过计算轨道并比较不同夜晚的观测结果，追踪彗星等天体。

examples.en: A small country may enter the political orbit of a stronger neighbour when it depends on aid.
examples.zh: 当一个小国依赖援助时，它可能进入更强邻国的政治影响范围。

examples.en: Orbital motion follows rules that are invisible in everyday experience.
examples.zh: 轨道运动遵循日常经验中不可见的规则。

senses.gloss: person or thing that orbital, orbit-related

examples.en: The orchestra followed the conductor through a difficult change of tempo.
examples.zh: 管弦乐队跟随指挥完成了一次困难的速度变化。

examples.en: The orchid needs steady humidity and indirect light to flower indoors.
examples.zh: 兰花在室内开花需要稳定湿度和间接光照。

examples.en: Institutions may claim that social hierarchy is ordained by tradition.
examples.zh: 机构可能声称社会等级由传统命定。

examples.en: Written rules created order in a market that had become chaotic.
examples.zh: 书面规则为一个变得混乱的市场建立了秩序。

cards.head: ordinariness
cards.cutMeaning: 人；物/二；分开/名词；形容词/名词

cards.head: ordinary
cards.cutMeaning: 人；物/二；分开/名词；形容词

examples.en: Ordinary people should not pay for projects that mainly benefit wealthy elites.
examples.zh: 普通人不应为主要让富裕精英受益的项目买单。

examples.en: A raw material such as iron ore becomes a traded commodity only after extraction, transport, and pricing.
examples.zh: 铁矿石这种原材料只有经过开采、运输和定价后，才会成为交易商品。

examples.en: Medical imaging allows doctors to examine internal organs without surgery.
examples.zh: 医学影像让医生无需手术就能检查内脏器官。

examples.en: organic food may spoil quickly unless safe preservation methods slow bacterial growth.
examples.zh: 有机食品可能很快变质，除非安全保存方法减缓细菌生长。

examples.en: Organic-farming methods can protect soil but may require more labour.
examples.zh: 有机农业方法可以保护土壤，但可能需要更多劳动力。

examples.en: The organiser changed the schedule after heavy rain.
examples.zh: 组织者在大雨后更改了日程。

examples.en: A living organism adapts through structure, behaviour, and environment.
examples.zh: 活生物体通过结构、行为和环境适应。

cards.head: organismal
cards.cutMeaning: 器官；组织/名词/形容词；名词

examples.en: Good teachers orient students before introducing difficult academic texts.
examples.zh: 好老师会在引入困难学术文本前帮助学生适应。

cards.head: oriental
cards.cutMeaning: 升起，开始/形容词；名词/形容词；名词

cards.head: orientate
cards.cutMeaning: 升起，开始/形容词；名词/动词；使成为

cards.head: orientation
cards.cutMeaning: 升起，开始/形容词；名词/动词；使成为/名词

examples.en: Cultural orientation shapes what people treat as normal.
examples.zh: 文化取向塑造人们把什么视为正常。

examples.en: The original plan was cheaper but less safe.
examples.zh: 最初的方案更便宜但安全性较低。

examples.en: The archive keeps the original beside a digital copy.
examples.zh: 档案馆把原件和数字副本放在一起保存。

phrases.zh: 以 originally 方式呈现的重要证据

cards.head: originate
cards.cutMeaning: 升起，开始/轧棉机/动词；使成为

examples.en: The river originates in a cold lake high in the mountains.
examples.zh: 这条河发源于高山上的寒冷湖泊。

cards.head: originated
cards.cutMeaning: 升起，开始/轧棉机/动词；使成为/形容词

examples.en: The facade of a Gothic cathedral often combines pointed arches, carved ornament, and carefully balanced symmetry.
examples.zh: 哥特式大教堂的正面常结合尖拱、雕刻装饰和精心平衡的对称。

cards.head: ornamental
cards.cutMeaning: 装饰（物/名词/形容词；名词

examples.en: A repeated floral motif can become an ornamental feature when it is carved into doors, windows, or furniture.
examples.zh: 反复出现的花卉母题如果被雕刻在门窗或家具上，就会成为装饰性特征。

examples.en: Ornithology helps scientists track migration, habitat loss, and climate change.
examples.zh: 鸟类学帮助科学家追踪迁徙、栖息地丧失和气候变化。

phrases.zh: 冲突后成为孤儿的儿童
社会史中的孤儿院记录

senses.zh: 罕见病数据库名；孤儿网络

examples.en: An orthodox approach may fail when technology changes work faster than schools respond.
examples.zh: 当技术改变工作的速度快于学校响应速度时，正统方法可能会失效。

cards.head: orthodoxly
cards.cutMeaning: 正确；正直/意见；信念/副词

cards.head: orthodoxy
cards.cutMeaning: 正确；正直/意见；信念/名词

examples.en: Public opinion can oscillate when information is unstable.
examples.zh: 当信息不稳定时，公众意见会摇摆。

examples.en: Regular oscillation in a bridge or machine can reveal hidden structural problems before visible damage appears.
examples.zh: 桥梁或机器中的规则振荡可以在可见损伤出现前揭示隐藏结构问题。

senses.gloss: person or thing that oscillates, swing

examples.en: The road is closed; take the ferry otherwise.
examples.zh: 道路关闭了，另外可乘渡船。

examples.en: The village solved the problem otherwise, by sharing pumps.
examples.zh: 村庄用别的方法解决问题，即共享水泵。

examples.en: The plan was costly but otherwise practical.
examples.zh: 这个计划成本高，但在其他方面可行。

examples.en: Leave early; otherwise, the tide will block the path.
examples.zh: 早点离开，否则潮水会挡住道路。

examples.en: An outbreak of panic spread after the false warning.
examples.zh: 错误警报后，恐慌突然发作并扩散。

examples.en: The outbreak began in a crowded market before reaching nearby towns.
examples.zh: 这次爆发始于拥挤市场，随后传到附近城镇。

examples.en: The outburst revealed public anger over the new rule.
examples.zh: 这次爆发显示出公众对新规则的愤怒。

examples.en: Learning outcomes matter more than whether a class looks technologically advanced today.
examples.zh: 如今学习结果比课堂看起来是否技术先进更重要。

examples.en: The factory closure caused a public outcry in the town.
examples.zh: 工厂关闭在镇上引发了公众抗议。

examples.en: Outdated infrastructure makes large cities less livable even when economic opportunities remain strong.
examples.zh: 即使经济机会仍然很强，过时基础设施也会让大城市更不宜居。

examples.en: Outdoor lessons help children connect plant names with real leaves and soil.
examples.zh: 户外课程帮助孩子把植物名称与真实叶片和土壤联系起来。

examples.en: Outer suburbs need reliable transport if cities want to reduce overcrowding downtown.
examples.zh: 如果城市想减少市中心过度拥挤，外郊需要可靠交通。

senses.zh: 最外面的，离中心最远的 farmost，utmost

examples.en: The outermost layer of a planet can reveal its geological history.
examples.zh: 行星最外层可以揭示它的地质历史。

examples.en: The rescue team prepared a warm outfit for each climber.
examples.zh: 救援队为每位登山者准备了一套保暖服装。

examples.en: New materials may outgas chemicals after they are placed in a sealed cabin.
examples.zh: 新材料放入密封舱后可能释放气体化学物质。

examples.en: Modern law should outlaw discrimination in education and employment.
examples.zh: 现代法律应宣布教育和就业中的歧视非法。

examples.en: The outline of the island appeared through the fog.
examples.zh: 岛屿轮廓在雾中显现。

examples.en: The teacher gave an outline of the next chapter.
examples.zh: 老师给出了下一章概要。

examples.en: The artist outlined the tree before adding colour.
examples.zh: 艺术家先描绘树的轮廓，再上色。

examples.en: The report outlines three possible solutions.
examples.zh: 报告略述了三种可能解决方案。

examples.en: Outlying villages received medical supplies later than towns near the road.
examples.zh: 偏远村庄比道路附近城镇更晚收到医疗物资。

examples.en: The smaller company outmanoeuvred its rivals by entering the market earlier.
examples.zh: 这家较小公司通过更早进入市场智胜竞争对手。

examples.en: An outpatient can return home on the same day after a minor procedure.
examples.zh: 门诊病人在小手术后当天就能回家。

examples.en: Factory output fell when electricity became unreliable.
examples.zh: 电力不稳定后，工厂产量下降。

examples.en: The computer's output was sent to a larger screen.
examples.zh: 电脑输出被送到更大的屏幕上。

examples.en: The workshop's output included tables, doors, and small cabinets.
examples.zh: 作坊的产品包括桌子、门和小柜子。

examples.en: The hotel charged outrageously high prices during the festival.
examples.zh: 节日期间，这家酒店收取高得令人无法接受的价格。

examples.en: The outrigger keeps the narrow canoe steady in rough water.
examples.zh: 舷外浮材让狭窄独木舟在汹涌水面上保持稳定。

examples.en: Outside pressure can force institutions to explain what they prefer to hide.
examples.zh: 外部压力可以迫使机构解释它们更愿意隐藏的东西。

examples.en: Companies may outsource labour to reduce costs while hiding responsibility.
examples.zh: 公司可能外包劳动以降低成本，同时隐藏责任。

examples.en: A firm may use outsourcing to reduce costs, but falling revenue can still force layoffs.
examples.zh: 企业可能用外包降低成本，但收入下降仍可能迫使裁员。

examples.en: Outsourcing reduced costs but weakened local employment.
examples.zh: 外包降低了成本，但削弱了本地就业。

examples.en: The outspoken journalist criticised the policy even after repeated warnings.
examples.zh: 这位直言不讳的记者即使多次被警告，仍批评该政策。

examples.en: Her outstanding research changed how doctors detect the disease early.
examples.zh: 她杰出的研究改变了医生早期发现这种疾病的方式。

examples.en: Outward appearance can hide pressure that is difficult to name.
examples.zh: 外在表现可能隐藏难以命名的压力。

examples.en: The artist drew an oval frame around the portrait.
examples.zh: 画家在肖像周围画了一个椭圆形画框。

phrases.zh: 在标准化考试中超常发挥

senses.zh: 全面的，综合的[ˈoʊvərɔːl] n. （套头）工作服，工装裤

examples.en: The overall result improved, although several small problems remained.
examples.zh: 整体结果有所改善，尽管仍有几个小问题。

examples.en: The repair shop overcharged tourists for simple work.
examples.zh: 修理店对游客的简单维修索价过高。

examples.en: Overcharging the battery can shorten its life.
examples.zh: 使电池过量充电会缩短其寿命。

examples.en: The speaker overcharged the story with dramatic details.
examples.zh: 演讲者用戏剧性细节过度渲染了故事。

examples.en: The bill included an overcharge for services never provided.
examples.zh: 账单中包含一项从未提供服务的过高要价。

examples.en: The team had to overcome poor weather before reaching the research station.
examples.zh: 团队必须克服恶劣天气才能到达研究站。

examples.en: Overcrowded classrooms make it difficult for teachers to support weaker students effectively.
examples.zh: 过度拥挤的教室让教师难以有效支持较弱学生。

phrases.zh: 与超速运转；过度工作相关的证据

examples.en: The overdue rent worried the family.
examples.zh: 过期未付的租金让这家人担心。

examples.en: The library sent a notice about overdue books.
examples.zh: 图书馆发出逾期图书通知。

examples.en: The punishment was overdue and harsher than necessary.
examples.zh: 惩罚过度，且比必要程度更严厉。

examples.en: The overdue train finally arrived after midnight.
examples.zh: 延误的火车终于在午夜后到达。

examples.en: Farmers may overgraze land when short-term survival leaves no better option.
examples.zh: 当短期生存没有更好选择时，农民可能会过度放牧土地。

examples.en: Crop monoculture and severe overgrazing both reduce biodiversity because one species or one feeding pressure dominates the land.
examples.zh: 作物单一种植和严重过度放牧都会降低生物多样性，因为单一物种或单一取食压力支配土地。

examples.en: Overgrazing left the hillside bare and increased soil erosion.
examples.zh: 过度放牧使山坡裸露，并加剧了土壤侵蚀。

senses.zh: 杂草丛生的；长得过大的

examples.en: The overgrown garden hid the path that once led to the old house.
examples.zh: 杂草丛生的花园遮住了曾通往老房子的小路。

examples.en: The railway system needs an overhaul after years of underinvestment.
examples.zh: 多年投资不足后，铁路系统需要全面检修。

phrases.zh: 全面检修老化基础设施

senses.zh: 头顶上的；在头顶上；经费开销

phrases.zh: 过于热切的投资者行为

examples.en: Overlapping responsibilities can make urban governance slow, confusing, and inefficient today locally.
examples.zh: 如今地方上的重叠职责会让城市治理缓慢、混乱且低效。

examples.en: Heavy trucks overloaded the old bridge.
examples.zh: 重型卡车使旧桥超载。

phrases.zh: 学习中的认知负荷过重

examples.en: Too many devices overloaded the circuit.
examples.zh: 太多设备使电路超过负荷。

examples.en: Workers overloaded the boat with supplies.
examples.zh: 工人把船装填得过满。

senses.zh: 使负担过重[ˈoʊvərloʊd] n. 超载

examples.en: The extra paperwork overloaded the small office.
examples.zh: 额外文书工作使小办公室负担过重。

examples.en: The balcony overlooks the harbour.
examples.zh: 阳台俯瞰港口。

examples.en: The report overlooked several important villages.
examples.zh: 报告忽略了几个重要村庄。

examples.en: Inspectors overlooked the building before it reopened.
examples.zh: 检查员在建筑重新开放前检查了它。

examples.en: Overnight frost damaged the seedlings before farmers could cover them.
examples.zh: 夜间霜冻在农民来得及覆盖幼苗前损坏了它们。

cards.head: overqualified
cards.cutMeaning: 过度；超过/资格；性质/形容词

senses.zh: 资历过高的；条件过好的

examples.en: She seemed overqualified for the assistant position but still wanted the work.
examples.zh: 她对助理职位来说似乎资历过高，但仍想要这份工作。

phrases.zh: 给特权学校过度配置资源
与过度供给资源相关的证据

examples.en: Emergency power can override normal procedure, but it should not become permanent.
examples.zh: 紧急权力可以覆盖正常程序，但不应变成永久状态。

examples.en: Economic interests should not override safety warnings in public planning.
examples.zh: 公共规划中，经济利益不应压过安全警告。

examples.en: Overseas students arrived before the autumn term.
examples.zh: 海外学生在秋季学期前抵达。

examples.en: The company sells its products overseas.
examples.zh: 公司在国外销售产品。

examples.en: The glamour of international events can overshadow local needs for housing and healthcare.
examples.zh: 国际赛事的光环可能掩盖本地对住房和医疗的需求。

examples.en: He overslept and missed the morning bus.
examples.zh: 他睡过头，错过了早班车。

examples.en: The exhausted hikers overslept after two days on the trail.
examples.zh: 疲惫徒步者在路上走了两天后睡得过久。

examples.en: Companies often overstate the benefits of products in advertisements targeting young children.
examples.zh: 公司常常在针对幼儿的广告中夸大产品好处。

examples.en: The runner was overtaken just before the final bend of the race.
examples.zh: 这名跑者在比赛最后一个弯道前被超过了。

examples.en: The rebels tried to overthrow the old regime.
examples.zh: 叛军试图推翻旧政权。

examples.en: A damaged pavement can make a city unsafe for elderly people and children.
examples.zh: 破损人行道会让城市对老人和儿童不安全。

examples.zh: 典当商保管手表直到贷款还清。

examples.zh: 这家人用几个月时间支付维修费。

examples.zh: 最后一笔付款被推迟，因为交付记录不完整。

examples.zh: 农民家庭用粮食而不是金钱支付租金。

examples.zh: 改革前，农民阶层承担了大部分税负。

examples.zh: 鞋里卡着一颗小石子，使每一步都疼。

examples.zh: 设计良好的课程应体现可靠教学法和认知研究，而不只是列出要考试的话题。

examples.zh: 步行化让购物街更安静也更安全。

phrases.zh: 城市规划中的步行主义

examples.en: Street pedestrianization can improve walking conditions, but poor sanitation may still make public space unsafe.
examples.zh: 街道步行化可以改善步行条件，但糟糕卫生设施仍可能让公共空间不安全。

examples.zh: 当移动网络变得可靠时，新技术可以进入农村市场。

examples.zh: 细心读者能洞察论证中隐藏的假设。

examples.en: Penicillin transformed medicine by making many infections treatable.
examples.zh: 青霉素让许多感染变得可治疗，从而改变了医学。

examples.zh: 半岛三面环水。

examples.zh: 旧信显示出优雅书法。

examples.zh: 几个月练习后，她的书写技巧变得更清楚。

examples.zh: 养老金让退休工人能支付房租并购买食物。

examples.zh: 这个沉思的孩子望着河水，一言不发。

examples.zh: 当食品标签不清楚或具有误导性时，消费者可能会以不同方式感知风险。

examples.zh: 亲身经历灾难后，人们可能会以不同方式察觉风险。

examples.zh: 起初这种变化可能几乎难以察觉，但随着时间推移会变得明显。

examples.zh: 公众看法变化的速度可能快于实际情况。

examples.zh: 打击乐器能在仪式和表演中协调动作。

examples.zh: 满分很少见，因为最后一题被故意设置得很难。

examples.zh: 追求完美使发布推迟了数月。

examples.zh: 暴风雪后，山路变得危险。

examples.zh: 周期性洪水会在河边沉积新土壤。

examples.en: Periodic inspection keeps bridges safer than emergency repair alone.
examples.zh: 定期检查比单靠紧急维修更能保障桥梁安全。

examples.zh: 传感器必须定期检查，以保持测量准确。

examples.zh: 城市外围的小农场正在慢慢消失。

phrases.zh: 越过障碍的潜望镜视野

examples.en: Ideas perish when no institution preserves or repeats them.
examples.zh: 当没有制度保存或重复观念时，观念会消亡。

examples.en: Explorers can perish quickly when preparation fails in extreme climates.
examples.zh: 在极端气候中，如果准备失败，探险者可能很快死亡。

examples.zh: 宣誓后撒谎的证人可能被控伪证罪。

examples.en: Melting permafrost can release greenhouse gases and damage infrastructure.
examples.zh: 永久冻土融化会释放温室气体并损害基础设施。

cards.head: permanence
cards.cutMeaning: 完全；贯穿/停留；保持/名词

examples.en: Stone gives a monument a sense of permanence that paper cannot provide.
examples.zh: 石头赋予纪念碑一种纸张无法提供的永久感。

examples.en: A permanent record prevents officials from quietly changing past decisions.
examples.zh: 永久记录能防止官员悄悄改变过去的决定。

examples.en: 当制度依赖某项临时措施时，它可能变成永久安排。
examples.zh: 当制度依赖某项临时措施时，它可能变成永久安排。

examples.en: Permanent ice has begun to melt in some high mountain regions.
examples.zh: 一些高山地区的永久冰层已经开始融化。

examples.zh: 当制度依赖某项临时措施时，它可能变成永久安排。

examples.zh: 低土壤渗透性会增加径流，从而在暴雨后加速河流沉积。

examples.en: A permeable surface allows rain to enter soil, which may help restore a falling water-table.
examples.zh: 可渗透表面允许雨水进入土壤，这可能帮助恢复下降的地下水位。

examples.zh: 隐性规范可以在不被公开说出的情况下渗入日常生活。

examples.zh: 数字技术如今渗透进教育、医疗和娱乐。

examples.zh: 研究人员在私人土地上采集样本前需要许可。

examples.zh: 许可证允许研究者在保护区采集样本。

examples.zh: 墙与地面垂直。

examples.zh: 尽管风很强，塔仍直立。

examples.zh: 强势行动者可以造成伤害，同时把自己呈现为保护者。

examples.zh: 当政治机构崩溃时，武装团体可能实施暴力。

examples.zh: 交通持续不断的噪声让附近居民难以入睡。

cards.head: perpetually

examples.zh: 洞穴一直凉爽，因为阳光从未照到最深处。

examples.en: Unfair rules can perpetuate poverty across several generations.
examples.zh: 不公平规则可能让贫困延续数代。

examples.en: Perplexed students need clearer explanations when technology replaces traditional classroom routines too quickly.
examples.zh: 当技术过快取代传统课堂流程时，困惑学生需要更清楚的解释。

examples.zh: 相互矛盾的结果让团队困惑，直到他们发现一个故障传感器。

examples.zh: 当领导者害怕公开批评时，国家可能迫害异见者。

examples.zh: 宗教迫害会迫使身份进入隐秘和流亡。

examples.zh: 宗教迫害会迫使社区迁徙并在别处重建。

examples.zh: 如果资源在全国范围内分配不公平，即使经济增长，贫困也可能持续存在。

examples.zh: 化学品被移除很久后，气味仍持续存在。

examples.zh: 不平等的延续表明，形式改革还不够。

examples.zh: 即使规则在形式上变得平等，持续性不平等仍可能存在。

examples.zh: 应急人员十分钟内到达。

examples.zh: 更广视角帮助政策制定者看到简单统计可能隐藏的成本。

examples.en: From the mountain, the perspective opens across the whole valley.
examples.zh: 从山上看，远景展开到整个山谷。

examples.en: A historical perspective can make present conflicts easier to understand.
examples.zh: 历史观点能让当前冲突更容易理解。

examples.zh: 运输成本下降后，小农户的前途有所改善。

examples.zh: 只有信任仍存在时，证据才能说服公众。

examples.en: Clear evidence can persuade voters more effectively than empty slogans.
examples.zh: 清晰证据比空洞口号更能说服选民。

examples.zh: 有效说服既依赖证据，也依赖情感。

examples.zh: 最后一节包含只适用于外国申请者的规则。

examples.zh: 法官要求提供与事故原因相关的信息。

examples.zh: 一股弥漫的烟味在建筑里持续了数日。

examples.zh: 农民发现前，害虫毁掉了一半作物。

examples.zh: 这台吵闹机器成了附近所有人的讨厌东西。

examples.zh: 在植物学中，研究者研究农药如何影响昆虫、杂草和更广泛的植物群落。

examples.zh: 这个理论解释了几个曾经看似无关的现象。

examples.zh: 一次录制演出后，这位年轻钢琴家成了非凡人物。

examples.zh: 临床病理学可能识别严重恐惧症，随后行为疗法帮助患者逐步面对害怕情境。

examples.en: A polyphase system can deliver electricity more smoothly than a single phase.
examples.zh: 多相系统能比单相系统更平稳地输送电力。

examples.en: Polyphonic music reflects a complex interaction of independent voices.
examples.zh: 复调音乐体现了独立声部之间复杂的互动。

examples.en: The machine was too ponderous to move without a crane.
examples.zh: 这台机器太笨重，没有起重机无法移动。

phrases.zh: 文艺复兴戏剧中的短剑
谋杀审判中的匕首证据
化石哺乳动物中的小马步态
岛屿物种中的小马体型

examples.en: A poorly designed survey can hide the answer it is meant to find.
examples.zh: 设计糟糕的调查可能掩盖它本应寻找的答案。

examples.en: Popular science books can explain difficult ideas without heavy jargon.
examples.zh: 通俗科学书能不用大量术语解释困难概念。

examples.en: The new library became popular because it stayed open late.
examples.zh: 新图书馆因开放到很晚而受到欢迎。

examples.en: Popular music often spreads faster through short videos than radio.
examples.zh: 流行音乐通过短视频传播往往比通过广播更快。

examples.en: The disease is popularly known by a shorter local name.
examples.zh: 这种疾病通常以一个更短的地方名称为人所知。

examples.en: Several fishing families populated the island before the port was built.
examples.zh: 港口建成前，几个渔民家庭居住在这座岛上。

examples.en: The government encouraged skilled workers to populate the new industrial zone.
examples.zh: 政府鼓励技术工人移居到新的工业区。

examples.en: A representative sample allows researchers to infer patterns in a larger population without surveying everyone.
examples.zh: 代表性样本使研究者无需调查每个人也能推断更大总体中的模式。

phrases.zh: 选举政治中的民粹主义
人口众多的发展中国家

examples.en: Chinese porcelain became valuable because technology, taste, and trade met in one object.
examples.zh: 中国瓷器因技术、品味和贸易在同一物品中交汇而变得珍贵。

examples.en: Porcelain production became an important part of global trade and cultural exchange.
examples.zh: 瓷器生产成为全球贸易和文化交流的重要部分。

examples.en: Water entered the stone through a tiny pore.
examples.zh: 水通过一个细小孔隙进入石头。

examples.en: High porosity can let water enter a material, while oxidation may weaken metal surfaces over time.
examples.zh: 高孔隙率会让水进入材料，而氧化可能随着时间削弱金属表面。

examples.en: Porous borders can make disease control and migration policy more difficult.
examples.zh: 可渗透边界会让疾病控制和移民政策更加困难。

examples.en: The port handles grain, fuel, and passengers from nearby islands.
examples.zh: 这个港口处理来自附近岛屿的粮食、燃料和旅客。

examples.en: During the renaissance, a painted portrait could express political power, family status, and changing ideas about individuality.
examples.zh: 文艺复兴时期，一幅绘制肖像可以表达政治权力、家族地位和关于个体性的新观念。

examples.en: Portraiture in the palace reflected both fashion and political power.
examples.zh: 宫廷肖像画既反映时尚，也反映政治权力。

examples.en: Media can portray resistance as disorder when power feels threatened.
examples.zh: 当权力感到受威胁时，媒体可以把抵抗描绘成混乱。

cards.head: portrayal
cards.cutMeaning: 搬运/名词；形容词/形容词；名词

examples.en: The model held the same pose for twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 模特保持同一姿势二十分钟。

examples.en: Flooded roads pose a danger to drivers.
examples.zh: 被淹道路对司机造成危险。

examples.en: The study poses a question about language change.
examples.zh: 研究提出了一个关于语言变化的问题。

examples.en: The theory posits three stages of social change.
examples.zh: 该理论安排并提出社会变化的三个阶段。

examples.en: Scientists posit that the lake formed after an earthquake.
examples.zh: 科学家假定这座湖形成于地震之后。

examples.en: Social position affects how people experience the same rule.
examples.zh: 社会位置会影响人们如何体验同一规则。

examples.en: Market segmentation identifies different consumer groups, while brand positioning explains why one product fits a chosen group.
examples.zh: 市场细分识别不同消费者群体，而品牌定位解释为什么某产品适合选定群体。

examples.en: She accepted a position at the museum after finishing her degree.
examples.zh: 完成学位后，她接受了博物馆的一个职位。

examples.en: The committee changed its position after reading the new evidence.
examples.zh: 委员会阅读新证据后改变了立场。

examples.en: Engineers positioned the camera above the entrance to record foot traffic.
examples.zh: 工程师把摄像机安置在入口上方以记录人流。

examples.en: Careful positioning of sensors improved the accuracy of the data.
examples.zh: 传感器的谨慎定位提高了数据准确性。

examples.en: A positive result showed that the water contained harmful bacteria.
examples.zh: 阳性结果显示水中含有有害细菌。

examples.en: Positive feedback from residents encouraged the team to expand the project.
examples.zh: 居民的积极反馈鼓励团队扩大项目。

examples.en: The report offered positive proof that the document was not original.
examples.zh: 报告提供了确凿证据，证明该文件不是原件。

examples.en: A museum may possess rare objects but still lack enough space to display them.
examples.zh: 博物馆可能拥有稀有物品，却仍缺少足够空间展示它们。

cards.head: possessive
cards.cutMeaning: 放置；拥有/坐；占有/形容词

phrases.zh: 反对决定论的可能主义

senses.zh: 可能主义者；强调可能性者

phrases.zh: 规划中的可能主义方法
社会变化可能主义观点

examples.en: A possible explanation should not be treated as proof.
examples.zh: 可能解释不应被当作证明。

examples.en: Policymakers should consider possible consequences before changing education systems.
examples.zh: 政策制定者在改变教育制度前应考虑可能后果。

examples.en: Postage rose when fuel prices increased across the country.
examples.zh: 全国燃料价格上涨后，邮资也上涨了。

examples.en: The postcard showed a harbour crowded with fishing boats.
examples.zh: 明信片上是一座挤满渔船的港口。

examples.en: Postcolonial writers often examine how language carries political memory.
examples.zh: 后殖民作家常探讨语言如何承载政治记忆。

examples.en: A poster on the wall announced the meeting.
examples.zh: 墙上的招贴宣布了会议。

examples.en: Students made a poster about water safety.
examples.zh: 学生制作了一张关于饮水安全的海报。

examples.en: The writer received a posthumous award for the novel published after her death.
examples.zh: 这位作家因去世后出版的小说获得身后奖。

examples.en: The organisers had to postpone the race because of dangerous winds.
examples.zh: 组织者因危险大风不得不推迟比赛。

phrases.zh: 文学研究中的后结构主义

examples.en: Scientists may postulate an unseen force when visible causes cannot explain the result.
examples.zh: 当可见原因无法解释结果时，科学家可能假定存在一种看不见的力量。

examples.en: A political posture can signal strength without changing policy.
examples.zh: 政治姿态可以传达强硬，却不改变政策。

examples.en: Political posture can hide a lack of practical solutions.
examples.zh: 政治姿态可能掩盖实际解决方案的缺乏。

examples.en: Potassium helps nerves and muscles function properly.
examples.zh: 钾帮助神经和肌肉正常运作。

examples.en: A potent drug can be dangerous if the dose is not carefully controlled.
examples.zh: 强效药如果剂量控制不仔细，可能会很危险。

examples.en: Human potential grows when systems reduce unnecessary barriers.
examples.zh: 当系统减少不必要障碍时，人的潜力会增长。

examples.en: New technology has economic potential, but it also creates new social risks.
examples.zh: 新技术有经济潜力，但也会制造新的社会风险。

examples.en: The potter shaped the clay bowl before firing it in a kiln.
examples.zh: 陶工先塑造陶碗，再把它放入窑中烧制。

examples.en: Fragments of pottery showed that people lived there long ago.
examples.zh: 陶器碎片显示很久以前有人住在那里。

examples.en: The old pottery employed half the village.
examples.zh: 旧陶器场雇用了半个村庄的人。

examples.en: Pottery requires control of clay, fire, and timing.
examples.zh: 陶器制造术需要控制黏土、火和时间。

examples.en: The animal carries its young in a pouch until they are strong enough to walk.
examples.zh: 这种动物把幼崽放在育儿袋里，直到它们足够强壮可以行走。

examples.en: Waves pounded the harbour wall all night.
examples.zh: 海浪整夜猛击港墙。

examples.en: The cook pounded grain into flour.
examples.zh: 厨师把谷物捣碎成粉。

examples.en: The parcel weighed less than one pound.
examples.zh: 包裹重量不到一磅。

examples.en: The museum ticket cost five pounds.
examples.zh: 博物馆门票五英镑。

examples.en: Education and stable employment can help families escape the poverty cycle gradually.
examples.zh: 教育和稳定就业可以帮助家庭逐渐摆脱贫困循环。

examples.en: The powder dissolved quickly when warm water was added.
examples.zh: 加入温水后，粉末迅速溶解。

examples.en: Political power can shift quickly when public trust collapses.
examples.zh: 公众信任崩塌时，政治权力可能迅速转移。

examples.en: A practical tool should be simple enough to use under pressure.
examples.zh: 实用工具应足够简单，能在压力下使用。

examples.en: A practical leader asks what can be done with available resources.
examples.zh: 现实的领导者会问现有资源能完成什么。

examples.en: Students practise the method before using it in the field.
examples.zh: 学生在实地使用该方法前先练习。

examples.en: A skilled practitioner can adapt general rules to local needs.
examples.zh: 熟练从业者能把通用规则适应本地需求。

examples.en: A pragmatic compromise may satisfy citizens only if stringent safeguards prevent powerful actors from exploiting loopholes.
examples.zh: 务实妥协只有在严格保障防止强势行动者利用漏洞时，才可能让市民满意。

examples.en: pragmatics explains why meaning shifts by context, while register changes when speakers move from casual talk to academic writing.
examples.zh: 语用学解释意义为何随语境变化，而语域会在说话者从闲聊转向学术写作时改变。

examples.en: Pragmatics studies how speakers mean more than their words say.
examples.zh: 语用学研究说话者如何表达超出字面的话。

examples.en: Prairie grass protects soil from wind erosion.
examples.zh: 大草原的草保护土壤免受风蚀。

examples.en: It is praiseworthy when companies train older workers instead of replacing them immediately.
examples.zh: 当公司培训老年员工而不是立刻替换他们时，这是值得赞扬的。

cards.head: precaution
cards.cutMeaning: 预先；在前/原因/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: Reliable evidence should precede major reform, especially when children may be affected.
examples.zh: 可靠证据应先于重大改革，尤其是在儿童可能受影响时。

examples.en: A legal precedent can shape future decisions beyond one case.
examples.zh: 法律先例可以超越单个案件影响未来决定。

examples.en: Clean water becomes a precious resource when drought lasts too long.
examples.zh: 当干旱持续太久时，清洁水会变成珍贵资源。

examples.en: Precious manuscripts can preserve knowledge that survives war and political collapse.
examples.zh: 珍贵手稿可以保存挺过战争和政治崩溃的知识。

examples.en: Precious manuscripts can preserve knowledge that survives war and political collapse.
examples.zh: 珍贵手稿可以保存挺过战争和政治崩溃的知识。

cards.head: preciousness
cards.cutMeaning: 价值；价格/形容词/性质；状态

examples.en: A sudden policy mistake can precipitate a crisis.
examples.zh: 突然的政策错误可能促成危机。

examples.en: Cold air can precipitate moisture as snow.
examples.zh: 冷空气会使水汽降为雪。

examples.en: The crisis precipitated a sudden change in policy.
examples.zh: 危机促使政策猛然改变。

cards.head: precipitately
cards.cutMeaning: 预先/落下/动词；使成为/副词

cards.head: precipitation
cards.cutMeaning: 预先/落下/动词；使成为/名词

examples.en: High humidity and heavy precipitation can make a coastal region feel warmer and increase the risk of mould.
examples.zh: 高湿度和强降水会让沿海地区感觉更热，并增加霉菌风险。

examples.en: Precise data helps researchers compare pollution levels across different urban districts accurately.
examples.zh: 精确数据帮助研究者准确比较不同城区的污染水平。

cards.head: precisely
cards.cutMeaning: 之前；预先/切开，杀/词尾/副词

cards.head: precision
cards.cutMeaning: 价值；价格/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: A technical specification may require high precision and a narrow tolerance when parts must fit together safely.
examples.zh: 当零件必须安全配合时，技术规格可能要求高精度和窄容差。

examples.en: Precision measurement can reveal changes too small for ordinary observation.
examples.zh: 精密测量可以揭示普通观察无法发现的微小变化。

examples.en: The late arrival did not preclude a useful discussion.
examples.zh: 迟到并未阻止一次有用讨论。

examples.en: Small protests can be a precursor to larger political change.
examples.zh: 小规模抗议可能是更大政治变化的前兆。

examples.en: These stone tools predate the settlement by several thousand years.
examples.zh: 这些石器比该聚落早数千年。

cards.head: predation
cards.cutMeaning: 之前；预先/注明…的日期/名词

cards.head: predator
cards.cutMeaning: 之前；预先/注明…的日期/人；物

examples.en: A small crustacean may become prey for a larger fish, while the fish itself may be hunted by a top predator.
examples.zh: 小型甲壳类动物可能成为较大鱼类的猎物，而这条鱼本身也可能被顶级捕食者捕猎。

examples.en: Predatory lending traps vulnerable people in debt rather than offering real help.
examples.zh: 掠夺性贷款让脆弱人群陷入债务，而不是真正帮助他们。

examples.en: The steam engine was a predecessor of later industrial machines.
examples.zh: 蒸汽机是后来工业机器的前身。

examples.en: The new director blamed many problems on her predecessor.
examples.zh: 新主管把许多问题归咎于前任。

examples.en: This early telescope was the predecessor of modern observatory instruments.
examples.zh: 这台早期望远镜是现代天文台仪器的原型。

examples.en: Belief in predestination shaped some debates about freedom and responsibility.
examples.zh: 对宿命的信仰塑造了一些关于自由与责任的争论。

cards.head: predicate
cards.cutMeaning: 预先；在前/二；分开/动词；使成为

phrases.zh: 把政策建立在证据之上

examples.en: Reliable data can help cities predict future demand for housing and transport.
examples.zh: 可靠数据可以帮助城市预测未来的住房和交通需求。

examples.en: Predictable rules help businesses plan investment, hiring, training, and long-term growth.
examples.zh: 可预测规则帮助企业规划投资、招聘、培训和长期增长。

cards.head: predictive
cards.cutMeaning: 在前；预先/说；断言/形容词

examples.en: Rice is the predominant crop in many lowland farming regions.
examples.zh: 水稻是许多低地农业区的主要作物。

cards.head: predominantly
cards.cutMeaning: 在前；预先/支配；主导/形容词/副词

examples.en: The region is predominantly agricultural, with only a few small factories.
examples.zh: 该地区以农业为主，只有少数小工厂。

examples.en: Small farms predominate in the northern valley.
examples.zh: 小农场在北部山谷占优势。

cards.head: preeminent
cards.cutMeaning: 之前；预先/出；向外/小/形容词；名词

examples.en: Many patients prefer treatment at home when the condition is stable.
examples.zh: 病情稳定时，许多病人更喜欢在家治疗。

examples.en: A simple explanation is preferable when readers are new to the subject.
examples.zh: 读者刚接触这个主题时，简单解释更好。

cards.head: preference
cards.cutMeaning: 预先；在前/带来；承载/名词

cards.head: preferentially
cards.cutMeaning: 偏爱；更喜欢/形容词/形容词/副词

examples.en: The filter preferentially removes larger particles from the water.
examples.zh: 过滤器会优先去除水中较大的颗粒。

cards.head: prefiguration
cards.cutMeaning: 之前；预先/做，制作/名词/名词

examples.en: A small conflict can prefigure later debates about power and identity.
examples.zh: 小冲突可以预示后来关于权力和身份的争论。

examples.en: Small protests can prefigure larger social change.
examples.zh: 小规模抗议可能预示更大的社会变化。

examples.en: A prefix can change the meaning of a word before the root begins.
examples.zh: 前缀可以在词根开始前改变一个词的意思。

cards.head: prefixed
cards.cutMeaning: 在前；预先/固定；附加/形容词

examples.en: The prefixed form has a different meaning from the simple root.
examples.zh: 加前缀的形式与简单词根含义不同。

examples.en: The prefrontal cortex helps people plan, choose, and control impulses.
examples.zh: 前额叶皮层帮助人们计划、选择并控制冲动。

cards.head: pregnancy
cards.cutMeaning: 在前；预先/产生；出生/名词

examples.en: A prehistoric tool can reveal migration patterns even when no written records survive.
examples.zh: 史前工具即使在没有书面记录保存下来的情况下，也能揭示迁徙模式。

examples.en: Prehistory must be studied through tools, bones, and traces of settlement.
examples.zh: 史前史必须通过工具、骨骼和聚落痕迹来研究。

examples.en: A fair judge must not prejudge a case before hearing evidence.
examples.zh: 公正法官不能在听取证据前预先判断案件。

examples.en: A repeated stereotype can strengthen prejudice because people start treating a simplified image as evidence.
examples.zh: 反复出现的刻板印象会强化偏见，因为人们开始把简化图像当作证据。

examples.en: Prejudice can survive by disguising itself as common sense.
examples.zh: 偏见可以伪装成常识而存续。

examples.en: Prejudiced hiring can reduce workplace diversity and limit women's career opportunities in companies.
examples.zh: 有偏见的招聘会降低职场多样性，并限制女性在公司的职业机会。

cards.head: preliminarily
cards.cutMeaning: 预先/＝lumin光/名词；形容词/副词

examples.en: Preliminary evidence should guide further research, not final policy decisions nationwide today.
examples.zh: 如今初步证据应指导进一步研究，而不是全国最终政策决定。

examples.en: The premature fruit fell before it ripened.
examples.zh: 早熟果实在成熟前落下。

examples.en: A premature announcement created confusion.
examples.zh: 过早公告造成了混乱。

examples.en: The hospital cared for a premature born after seven months.
examples.zh: 医院照顾一名七个月出生的早产儿。

examples.en: The documentary will premiere at a small film festival next month.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片将在下个月的小型电影节上首映。

examples.en: The argument rests on the premise that education changes voting behaviour.
examples.zh: 这个论证建立在教育会改变投票行为这一前提上。

examples.en: Water supply became the town's main preoccupation.
examples.zh: 供水成了小镇的主要考虑因素。

examples.en: Her preoccupation with the case made sleep difficult.
examples.zh: 她对案件全神贯注，难以入睡。

examples.en: The army's preoccupation of the bridge changed the battle.
examples.zh: 军队抢先占据桥梁改变了战局。

cards.head: preparation
cards.cutMeaning: 预先；在前/旁边；类似/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: Emergency preparation matters before danger becomes visible.
examples.zh: 应急准备在危险变得可见之前就很重要。

examples.en: Careful preparation can decide whether an expedition succeeds or becomes a tragedy.
examples.zh: 认真准备可以决定一次探险是成功还是变成悲剧。

cards.head: prepare
cards.cutMeaning: 之前；预先/准备；平等；生产/词尾

examples.en: Families prepare for floods by storing water, medicine, and important documents.
examples.zh: 家庭通过储备水、药品和重要文件来为洪水做准备。

cards.head: preponderance
cards.cutMeaning: 预先；在前/放置/向下；离开/状态；名词

examples.en: A preponderance of evidence can justify action even when certainty is impossible.
examples.zh: 在无法达到确定性时，证据优势仍可为行动提供理由。

phrases.zh: 通过框架预先影响陪审员

examples.en: The claim sounded preposterous until the documents proved it was true.
examples.zh: 这个说法听起来荒谬，直到文件证明它是真的。

examples.en: The claim sounded preposterous until the hidden data appeared.
examples.zh: 在隐藏数据出现前，这个说法听起来很荒谬。

examples.en: Basic algebra is a prerequisite for the advanced statistics course.
examples.zh: 基础代数是高级统计课程的先修条件。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for the infection.
examples.zh: 医生为感染开了抗生素处方。

examples.en: The rule prescribes how waste must be stored.
examples.zh: 规则规定废物必须如何储存。

examples.en: The instructor prescribed three readings for Friday.
examples.zh: 教师指定星期五前读三篇材料。

examples.en: The doctor wrote a prescription for medicine to reduce the fever.
examples.zh: 医生开了一张退烧药处方。

examples.en: The speaker will present the results after the final test.
examples.zh: 发言人会在最终测试后呈现结果。

cards.head: presenter
cards.cutMeaning: 预先；在前/年老；感觉/人；物

cards.head: presentism
cards.cutMeaning: 预先；在前/感觉/主义；学说

phrases.zh: 历史写作中的当下主义
避免解释中的厚今薄古

cards.head: preservation
cards.cutMeaning: 预先；在前/保存；服务/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: organic food may spoil quickly unless safe preservation methods slow bacterial growth.
examples.zh: 有机食品可能很快变质，除非安全保存方法减缓细菌生长。

examples.en: Cultural preservation should protect living memory, not freeze culture into display.
examples.zh: 文化保存应保护活的记忆，而不是把文化冻结成展示品。

cards.head: preservative
cards.cutMeaning: 预先；在前/保存；服务/形容词

examples.en: A food additive may improve colour or texture, while a preservative extends shelf life by slowing decay.
examples.zh: 食品添加剂可能改善颜色或质地，而防腐剂通过减缓腐败来延长保质期。

examples.en: Cities should preserve cultural heritage while improving housing, transport, and public space.
examples.zh: 城市应在改善住房、交通和公共空间的同时保护文化遗产。

examples.en: A presidency can reshape institutions when informal norms are weak.
examples.zh: 当非正式规范薄弱时，总统任期可以重塑制度。

senses.gloss: state or quality of being presidency, term of office

cards.head: president
cards.cutMeaning: 在前；预先/坐；主持/人；形容词

examples.en: The president announced an emergency plan after the flood damaged major roads.
examples.zh: 洪水破坏主要道路后，总统宣布了一项紧急计划。

examples.en: The university president approved a new scholarship for medical students.
examples.zh: 大学校长批准了一项面向医学生的新奖学金。

cards.head: presidential
cards.cutMeaning: 在前；预先/坐；主持/人；形容词/形容词

examples.en: The local press reported the water shortage for weeks.
examples.zh: 地方报刊连续数周报道缺水问题。

examples.en: The press questioned why the documents had been hidden.
examples.zh: 新闻界质问这些文件为何被隐藏。

examples.en: An international press carried the story to newspapers abroad.
examples.zh: 一家国际通讯社把这个故事传给了国外报纸。

examples.en: The press of heavy ice slowly crushed the wooden boat.
examples.zh: 厚重冰层的挤压慢慢压碎了木船。

senses.zh: 压力；心理压力；社会压力

examples.en: Social pressure can change behaviour without changing belief.
examples.zh: 社会压力可以改变行为，而不改变信念。

examples.en: Air pressure drops as elevation increases.
examples.zh: 海拔升高时，气压会下降。

examples.en: Campaigners pressured officials to release the data.
examples.zh: 活动人士向官员施压，要求公布数据。

examples.en: National prestige can motivate governments to host expensive international events.
examples.zh: 国家威望会促使政府举办昂贵的国际赛事。

examples.en: The award gave the small university new prestige.
examples.zh: 这个奖项给这所小大学带来新声望。

cards.head: prestigious
cards.cutMeaning: 之前；预先/影响力/形容词

examples.en: Researchers should not presume that silence means agreement.
examples.zh: 研究者不应假定沉默就意味着同意。

examples.en: The visit was made under the pretence of checking the equipment.
examples.zh: 这次来访是假借检查设备之名进行的。

examples.en: He tried to pretend that the mistake did not matter.
examples.zh: 他试图假装这个错误无关紧要。

examples.en: The leader's pretension to special wisdom annoyed voters.
examples.zh: 这位领导人对特殊智慧的要求让选民反感。

examples.en: The essay makes a pretension that tradition alone proves truth.
examples.zh: 文章主张传统本身就能证明真理。

examples.en: The pretentious speaker used difficult words to impress people.
examples.zh: 自负的演讲者用难词给人留下印象。

examples.en: The restaurant felt pretentious rather than welcoming.
examples.zh: 这家餐馆显得做作，而不是亲切。

examples.en: The pretty garden attracted visitors in spring.
examples.zh: 漂亮花园在春天吸引游客。

examples.en: The river is pretty shallow in summer.
examples.zh: 这条河夏天相当浅。

examples.en: The prevailing view may change when people see the hidden costs of mega-events.
examples.zh: 当人们看到大型赛事的隐性成本时，主流观点可能改变。

examples.en: The prevailing opinion supported rebuilding the bridge.
examples.zh: 普遍意见支持重建桥梁。

examples.en: Prevailing fashions changed after foreign cloth arrived.
examples.zh: 外国布料到来后，流行风尚发生变化。

examples.en: The prevalence of asthma is higher in cities with heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 交通繁忙城市的哮喘流行率更高。

examples.en: Respiratory illness became more prevalent after the factory opened.
examples.zh: 工厂开业后，呼吸系统疾病变得更普遍。

examples.en: Professional diagnosis can prevent misdiagnosis when patients rely too heavily on online searches.
examples.zh: 当患者过度依赖网络搜索时，专业诊断可以防止误诊。

examples.en: Investigators concluded that the disaster was preventable with better weather data.
examples.zh: 调查人员得出结论，如果有更好的天气数据，这场灾难本可预防。

phrases.zh: 安全系统中的防止装置

cards.head: prevention
cards.cutMeaning: 预先；在前/来/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: Previous research can guide a study without deciding its conclusion.
examples.zh: 先前研究可以指导研究，但不决定其结论。

examples.en: Previous evidence should be reviewed before researchers make stronger claims.
examples.zh: 研究者提出更强主张前，应回顾先前证据。

examples.en: The species had previously been recorded only in warmer seas.
examples.zh: 这个物种以前只在更温暖的海域被记录过。

phrases.zh: 以 previously 方式呈现的重要证据

examples.en: A small crustacean may become prey for a larger fish, while the fish itself may be hunted by a top predator.
examples.zh: 小型甲壳类动物可能成为较大鱼类的猎物，而这条鱼本身也可能被顶级捕食者捕猎。

examples.en: The fraud's prey were elderly people living alone.
examples.zh: 这场骗局的受害者是独居老人。

examples.en: Owls prey on mice at night.
examples.zh: 猫头鹰夜间捕食老鼠。

examples.en: Pirates preyed on merchant ships near the coast.
examples.zh: 海盗在海岸附近掠夺商船。

examples.en: The price of imported grain rose when storms damaged the main port.
examples.zh: 暴风雨损坏主要港口后，进口谷物价格上涨。

examples.en: Pride in local history encouraged residents to restore the old theatre.
examples.zh: 对地方历史的自豪感促使居民修复老剧院。

examples.en: Priests often connected religious ritual with political authority.
examples.zh: 祭司常常把宗教仪式与政治权威连接起来。

phrases.zh: 古代社会中的祭司职位
庙宇经济中的祭司阶层

examples.en: A primary source can challenge a later story that became too convenient.
examples.zh: 一手来源可以挑战后来变得过于方便的叙事。

examples.en: A primate uses vision and flexible hands to explore its environment.
examples.zh: 灵长类动物用视觉和灵活的手探索环境。

phrases.zh: 直立两足灵长类动物（早期人类）

examples.en: The prime cause of the shortage was drought.
examples.zh: 短缺的主要原因是干旱。

examples.en: The prime settlement stood beside the river.
examples.zh: 最初定居点位于河边。

examples.en: The museum keeps its prime collection in a secure room.
examples.zh: 博物馆把最好的藏品保存在安全房间。

examples.en: A primitive tool can reveal sophisticated adaptation to local conditions.
examples.zh: 原始工具可以揭示对地方条件的复杂适应。

examples.en: Primitive tools show how early humans adapted to difficult environments.
examples.zh: 原始工具显示早期人类如何适应艰难环境。

cards.head: primitively
cards.cutMeaning: 主要的；第一/形容词/副词

cards.head: primitivism
cards.cutMeaning: 主要的；第一/形容词/主义；学说

phrases.zh: 贵族家庭中的长子继承制

examples.en: The primordial universe contained the conditions for later structure.
examples.zh: 原始宇宙包含了后来结构形成的条件。

examples.en: Primordial matter gradually formed the first stars after the universe cooled.
examples.zh: 宇宙冷却后，原始物质逐渐形成了最早的恒星。

examples.en: The prince supported the expedition to strengthen his family's influence.
examples.zh: 王子支持这次远征，以增强家族影响力。

examples.en: The principal cause of failure may be structural rather than personal.
examples.zh: 失败的主要原因可能是结构性的，而不是个人性的。

examples.en: The principal cause of urban stress is often a combination of housing and transport pressure.
examples.zh: 城市压力的主要原因常常是住房和交通压力的结合。

cards.head: principality
cards.cutMeaning: 王子；首要/词尾/形容词/名词

examples.en: Medieval principalities competed for land, trade, and dynastic power.
examples.zh: 中世纪诸侯国为土地、贸易和王朝权力竞争。

cards.head: principally
cards.cutMeaning: 首要；王子/词尾/形容词/副词

examples.en: 原则只有在人们承压时运用才有意义。
examples.zh: 原则只有在人们承压时运用才有意义。

examples.en: The ability to print books transformed education and religious debate.
examples.zh: 印刷书籍的能力改变了教育和宗教争论。

examples.en: The printmaker carved fine lines into wood before applying ink.
examples.zh: 版画家在上墨前把细线刻进木板。

cards.head: prioritisation
cards.cutMeaning: 在前；优先/名词/动词/名词

examples.en: Clear prioritisation helped the nurses decide which patients needed help first.
examples.zh: 明确的优先排序帮助护士决定哪些病人最先需要帮助。

senses.zh: 优先处理；确定优先次序

examples.en: The team had to prioritise safety over speed after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后，团队必须把安全置于速度之上。

senses.gloss: state or quality of being priority, precedence

examples.en: Public health should remain a top priority when governments allocate limited budgets.
examples.zh: 当政府分配有限预算时，公共健康应始终是首要任务。

examples.en: A budget shows political priority more honestly than speeches do.
examples.zh: 预算比演讲更诚实地显示政治优先事项。

examples.en: Emergency vehicles have priority when roads are blocked after a storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨后道路受阻时，应急车辆享有优先权。

examples.en: The worker used a metal bar to prise open the jammed door.
examples.zh: 工人用金属杆撬开卡住的门。

examples.en: A prism can split light, and a theory can split complexity into parts.
examples.zh: 棱镜可以分解光，理论也可以把复杂性分解成部分。

examples.en: The old prison was later turned into a museum of legal history.
examples.zh: 旧监狱后来被改建为法律史博物馆。

senses.zh: 原始纯净的；未受破坏的

examples.en: A tributary flowing through a pristine forest may carry fewer pollutants than water passing through farmland.
examples.zh: 流经原始森林的支流携带的污染物可能少于流经农田的水。

examples.en: The new protocol protected patient privacy during the medical review.
examples.zh: 新规程在医疗审查期间保护了病人隐私。

examples.en: Private companies may build roads when public funds are limited.
examples.zh: 公共资金有限时，私营公司可能修建道路。

cards.head: privately
cards.cutMeaning: 个人；私有/动词；使成为/副词

phrases.zh: 以 privately 方式呈现的重要证据

cards.head: privation
cards.cutMeaning: 个人；私有/动词；使成为/名词

cards.head: privative
cards.cutMeaning: 个人；私有/动词；使成为/形容词

cards.head: privatization
cards.cutMeaning: 个人；私有/动词；使成为/动词/名词

examples.en: Service privatization may threaten project viability if profit targets reduce access for poorer communities.
examples.zh: 如果利润目标减少贫困社区的使用机会，服务私有化可能威胁项目可行性。

cards.head: privatize
cards.cutMeaning: 个人；私有/动词；使成为/动词

examples.en: The law should not privilege wealthy firms over smaller competitors.
examples.zh: 法律不应给予富裕公司优于小竞争者的特权。

examples.en: The community prized clean water above short-term profit.
examples.zh: 社区珍视清洁水胜过短期利润。

examples.en: Experts prized the rare manuscript before auction.
examples.zh: 专家在拍卖前给稀有手稿估价。

examples.en: The prize was awarded for work on malaria.
examples.zh: 奖品授予了疟疾研究工作。

examples.en: The prize money paid for her first year of college.
examples.zh: 奖金支付了她大学第一年的费用。

examples.en: The probability of flooding increased after the wetlands were removed.
examples.zh: 湿地被移除后，洪水发生的概率上升了。

examples.en: Rain is probable tomorrow, so the match may be postponed.
examples.zh: 明天可能下雨，因此比赛可能推迟。

examples.en: The road will probably reopen after engineers inspect the bridge.
examples.zh: 工程师检查桥梁后，道路很可能会重新开放。

examples.en: Auditors should probe hidden costs before governments sign stadium contracts publicly today.
examples.zh: 如今审计员应在政府公开签署体育场合同之前调查隐性成本。

examples.en: A space probe can collect data from places humans cannot reach.
examples.zh: 太空探测器可以从人类无法到达的地方收集数据。

examples.en: A space probe can collect data from places humans cannot reach.
examples.zh: 太空探测器可以从人类无法到达的地方收集数据。

examples.en: The corruption probe examined payments made over ten years.
examples.zh: 这项腐败调查审查了十年间的付款。

examples.en: An insect proboscis allows feeding from narrow flowers.
examples.zh: 昆虫口器让昆虫能够从狭窄花朵中取食。

examples.en: Some insects use a proboscis to reach nectar inside deep flowers.
examples.zh: 一些昆虫用长喙够到深花中的花蜜。

cards.head: procedural
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/行走，前进/名词/形容词；名词

examples.en: Procedural justice matters because fair outcomes can lose trust through unfair process.
examples.zh: 程序正义很重要，因为公平结果也可能因程序不公失去信任。

cards.head: procedure
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/行走；前进/名词

examples.en: A clear procedure prevents confusion during an evacuation.
examples.zh: 清晰程序能防止疏散时出现混乱。

examples.en: The visa procedure requires proof of study and financial support.
examples.zh: 签证手续要求提供学习和经济支持证明。

examples.en: The meeting proceeded after the documents arrived.
examples.zh: 文件到达后，会议继续进行。

examples.en: Flooding proceeded after the riverbank broke.
examples.zh: 河岸决口后，洪水发生并继续。

examples.en: The healing process can continue after pain has disappeared.
examples.zh: 疼痛消失后，愈合过程仍可能继续。

examples.en: The application process takes longer when documents are missing.
examples.zh: 文件缺失时，申请程序会花更久。

examples.en: The factory processes waste water before releasing it into the river.
examples.zh: 工厂在把废水排入河流前先进行处理。

cards.head: processe
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/行走，前进/词尾

examples.en: The laboratory process turns raw samples into reliable measurements.
examples.zh: 实验室流程把原始样本转化为可靠测量结果。

cards.head: processing
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/行走，前进/名词；形容词

examples.en: Food processing can extend shelf life but may reduce some nutrients.
examples.zh: 食品加工可以延长保质期，但可能减少某些营养。

cards.head: procession
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/走；让步/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: The mayor proclaimed a day of mourning after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后，市长宣布一天为哀悼日。

examples.en: Empty streets proclaimed the seriousness of the storm warning.
examples.zh: 空荡街道显示了风暴警报的严重性。

examples.en: The king's proclamation was read aloud in the market square.
examples.zh: 国王的公告在集市广场被大声宣读。

cards.head: procrastinate
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；拖延/明天；延迟/动词

examples.en: Students often procrastinate when a task feels too large to start.
examples.zh: 当任务大到让人不知如何开始时，学生常会拖延。

cards.head: procrastination
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；拖延/明天；延迟/名词

examples.en: Procrastination can turn a simple assignment into a stressful emergency.
examples.zh: 拖延会把简单作业变成令人紧张的紧急情况。

cards.head: procreate
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/增长，产生/动词；使成为

examples.en: The species cannot procreate successfully without a stable nesting area.
examples.zh: 没有稳定筑巢区，该物种无法成功繁殖。

cards.head: procurement
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/照料；跑/词尾/名词

examples.en: Poor procurement can disrupt production when managers do not know whether inventory is sufficient.
examples.zh: 当管理者不知道库存是否充足时，糟糕采购会扰乱生产。

senses.gloss: extraordinary in bulk, quantity, or degree

examples.en: The archive contains a prodigious number of letters from the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 档案馆收藏了数量惊人的十九世纪信件。

cards.head: produce
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/引导，带来/词尾

examples.en: Local farms can produce food more reliably when soil and water are protected.
examples.zh: 当土壤和水源受到保护时，本地农场可以更可靠地生产食物。

examples.en: A food producer faces risk from weather, markets, and policy.
examples.zh: 食品生产者面对来自天气、市场和政策的风险。

cards.head: production
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/引导/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: Food production depends on land, labour, water, and technology.
examples.zh: 食品生产依赖土地、劳动、水和技术。

examples.en: Productive farmland can protect communities during disruptions in global food trade networks.
examples.zh: 高产农田可以在全球食品贸易网络中断期间保护社区。

examples.en: A productive discussion clarifies disagreement rather than hiding it.
examples.zh: 有成效的讨论会澄清分歧，而不是隐藏分歧。

cards.head: productively
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/引导/形容词/副词

examples.en: Higher productivity may follow entrepreneurship when new firms introduce better tools, services, or working methods.
examples.zh: 当新企业引入更好的工具、服务或工作方法时，创业精神可能带来更高生产率。

senses.zh: 专业 pupil[ˈpjuːpl] n. 瞳孔

phrases.zh: 专业 pupil[ˈpjuːpl] n. 瞳孔

examples.en: A university professor can guide students through difficult academic debates.
examples.zh: 大学教授可以指导学生理解困难的学术争论。

cards.head: professorial
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/说；承认/人；物/形容词

cards.head: professorship
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/说；承认/人；物/身份；关系

examples.en: Language proficiency depends on memory, attention, and other cognitive processes that develop through repeated use.
examples.zh: 语言熟练度依赖记忆、注意力和其他通过反复使用而发展的认知过程。

cards.head: proficient
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/做；产生效果/形容词

examples.en: A proficient translator notices subtle differences between similar terms.
examples.zh: 熟练译者会注意相似术语之间的细微差别。

examples.en: The clinical profile described the patient's symptoms and treatment history.
examples.zh: 临床概况描述了病人的症状和治疗史。

examples.en: A company may increase profit by cutting waste rather than lowering wages.
examples.zh: 公司可以通过减少浪费而不是降低工资来增加利润。

cards.head: profitability
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/做；适合/能力；名词

examples.en: A shareholder may demand higher profitability, but short-term gains can weaken long-term innovation.
examples.zh: 股东可能要求更高盈利能力，但短期收益会削弱长期创新。

examples.en: A profitable market is not always a fair market.
examples.zh: 有利可图的市场不一定是公平市场。

phrases.zh: 有利可图的可再生能源投资

examples.en: A profound effect should not be dismissed as trivial merely because it is difficult to measure at first.
examples.zh: 深刻影响不应仅因为起初难以测量就被当作微不足道。

examples.en: The professor's profound knowledge shaped the whole field.
examples.zh: 教授渊博知识塑造了整个领域。

examples.en: The text raises profound questions about justice.
examples.zh: 文本提出了关于正义的深奥问题。

cards.head: profundity
cards.cutMeaning: 向前；支持/基础，底部/名词

examples.en: A writer's intellectual progeny may appear centuries after the original text.
examples.zh: 一个作家的思想后代可能在原文数百年后出现。

examples.en: The university programme combines language study with field research.
examples.zh: 这个大学项目把语言学习和实地研究结合起来。

examples.en: 长期项目比单次运动更能改变行为。
examples.zh: 长期项目比单次运动更能改变行为。

examples.en: A skilled programmer can turn a learning idea into a working tool.
examples.zh: 熟练程序员可以把学习想法变成可运行工具。

examples.en: Scientific progress often depends on methods that others can test.
examples.zh: 科学进步往往依赖他人可以检验的方法。

examples.en: Progressive taxation can reduce inequality without banning wealth.
examples.zh: 累进税制可以在不禁止财富的情况下减少不平等。

cards.head: progressively

examples.en: The rider injured his rear after falling from the horse.
examples.zh: 骑手从马上摔下后伤了臀部。

examples.en: Grandparents helped rear the children.
examples.zh: 祖父母帮助养育孩子。

examples.en: The farm reared sheep for wool.
examples.zh: 农场饲养绵羊取毛。

phrases.zh: 与后卫；保守派相关的证据

cards.head: reason
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/离开；使；无/声音

examples.en: The main reason for delay was a shortage of trained workers.
examples.zh: 延误的主要原因是熟练工人短缺。

examples.en: From the evidence, we can reason that the settlement was abandoned gradually.
examples.zh: 根据证据，我们可以推断这个定居点是逐渐被废弃的。

examples.en: Reasonable doubt protects people from punishment based on weak evidence.
examples.zh: 合理怀疑保护人们免受基于薄弱证据的惩罚。

examples.en: Clear reasoning matters more than a dramatic conclusion.
examples.zh: 清晰推理比戏剧性结论更重要。

cards.head: reassigned
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/向；加强/标记；指定/形容词

cards.head: reassure
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/向；加强/确定确信

examples.en: Clear information can reassure parents during a medical emergency.
examples.zh: 清楚的信息能在医疗紧急情况下使父母安心。

phrases.zh: 与重新连接相关的证据

examples.en: A rebel group may challenge authority without offering a stable alternative.
examples.zh: 叛军组织可能挑战权威，却不提供稳定替代方案。

examples.en: A rebellious teenager may reject rules before understanding why they exist.
examples.zh: 叛逆的青少年可能在理解规则原因前就拒绝规则。

examples.en: A rebellious province refused to follow the new tax rule.
examples.zh: 一个反抗的省份拒绝遵守新税规。

phrases.zh: 与反弹；恢复相关的证据

examples.en: The town began to rebuild schools before repairing the old market.
examples.zh: 小镇先开始重建学校，再修复旧市场。

examples.en: The rebuilt bridge reopened after two years of careful engineering work.
examples.zh: 经过两年细致的工程建设，重建后的桥重新开放。

examples.en: A weak regime can survive criticism if no convincing rebuttal shows why its rules fail in practice.
examples.zh: 薄弱制度若没有有力反驳说明其规则为何在实践中失败，仍可能经受住批评。

cards.head: recalibrate
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/刻度；校准/动词

examples.en: After the sensor drifted, engineers had to recalibrate the instrument before collecting new data.
examples.zh: 传感器发生漂移后，工程师必须在采集新数据前重新校准仪器。

examples.en: The instrument needed recalibration after months of heavy use.
examples.zh: 仪器在数月高强度使用后需要重新校准。

examples.en: She recalled the smell of the sea from childhood.
examples.zh: 她回忆起童年时海的气味。

examples.en: His recall of names was excellent even in old age.
examples.zh: 即使年老，他对姓名的记忆也很好。

senses.zh: 公开放弃；撤回信仰/观点

examples.en: A thinker may be forced to recant a belief when authority controls truth.
examples.zh: 当权威控制真理时，思想者可能被迫放弃信仰。

examples.en: Scholars may recant under pressure when authority punishes dissent.
examples.zh: 当权威惩罚异议时，学者可能在压力下撤回观点。

cards.head: recantation
cards.cutMeaning: 公开放弃/形容词；名词/名词

cards.head: recede
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/行走，前进/词尾

examples.en: The floodwater began to recede after three days of clear weather.
examples.zh: 连续三天天晴后，洪水开始退去。

examples.en: The receipt proved that the equipment had been bought before the grant ended.
examples.zh: 收据证明设备是在资助结束前购买的。

examples.en: The clinic will receive new supplies when the road reopens.
examples.zh: 道路重新开放后，诊所将收到新物资。

senses.gloss: receptive, person or thing that receiving

examples.en: The museum recently opened an exhibition on early navigation.
examples.zh: 博物馆最近开放了一个关于早期航海的展览。

examples.en: A sealed receptacle kept the samples dry during transport.
examples.zh: 密封容器在运输过程中保持样本干燥。

cards.head: reception
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/拿取；接受/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: Poor signal reception may shape a subconscious response before a person can explain why they feel uneasy.
examples.zh: 糟糕的信号接收可能在一个人解释自己为何不安之前，就塑造潜意识反应。

examples.en: The hotel improved reception by training staff to answer questions clearly.
examples.zh: 酒店通过培训员工清楚回答问题来改善接待服务。

examples.en: Radio reception became weak when the ship moved behind the cliffs.
examples.zh: 船驶到悬崖后方时，无线电接收效果变弱了。

cards.head: receptive
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/拿取；接受/形容词

examples.en: A receptor on the cell surface can detect a chemical signal.
examples.zh: 细胞表面的受体可以检测化学信号。

examples.en: High inflation reduces purchasing power, but a deep recession may reduce jobs and investment even more quickly.
examples.zh: 高通胀削弱购买力，但深度经济衰退可能更快减少就业和投资。

examples.en: Wetlands can recharge groundwater and reduce flood risk.
examples.zh: 湿地可以补给地下水并降低洪水风险。

examples.en: Soldiers had to recharge their weapons before the next attack.
examples.zh: 士兵必须在下一次进攻前重新装填武器。

examples.en: Rechargeable batteries make portable technology more sustainable but not waste-free.
examples.zh: 可充电电池让便携技术更可持续，但并非无废弃物。

examples.en: The recipe used beans, rice, and dried herbs.
examples.zh: 这份食谱使用豆子、米和干草药。

examples.en: Ignoring safety rules is a recipe for disaster.
examples.zh: 忽视安全规则是导致灾难的方法。

cards.head: recipient
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/接受者/形容词；名词

examples.en: Each recipient signed a form before collecting the scholarship money.
examples.zh: 每位领取者在领取奖学金前都签了表格。

examples.en: The treaty created reciprocal duties between the two states.
examples.zh: 条约在两国之间建立了相互义务。

examples.en: Trade agreements often depend on reciprocity between the two countries.
examples.zh: 贸易协定常取决于两国之间的互惠。

cards.head: recital
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/引用；唤起/形容词；名词

cards.head: recitation
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/引用；唤起/名词

examples.en: Students recite the poem aloud to notice its rhythm.
examples.zh: 学生大声背诵这首诗，以注意它的节奏。

examples.en: Reckless driving near the school put children at risk.
examples.zh: 学校附近的鲁莽驾驶使儿童处于危险之中。

examples.en: The city tried to reclaim abandoned land for public gardens.
examples.zh: 这座城市试图收回废弃土地用于公共花园。

examples.en: Passengers can recline their seats slightly on long flights.
examples.zh: 乘客在长途飞行中可以把座椅稍微后倾。

cards.head: recognisable
cards.cutMeaning: 再次/知道；认识/动词化/能够；形容词

examples.en: A recognisable symbol can communicate belonging before words appear.
examples.zh: 可识别符号可以在语言出现前传达归属。

cards.head: recognise
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/知道；认识/动词

examples.en: A society must recognise rights before people can fully use them.
examples.zh: 社会必须先承认权利，人们才能充分使用它们。

examples.en: Governments should recognise cultural value before developing historic sites.
examples.zh: 政府在开发历史遗址前，应承认其文化价值。

cards.head: recognition
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/知道；认识/名词

examples.en: Official recognition allowed the community to protect its language in schools.
examples.zh: 官方承认使这个社群能够在学校保护自己的语言。

examples.en: Face recognition systems often fail when images are unclear.
examples.zh: 图像不清晰时，人脸识别系统常常失败。

examples.en: The scientist received recognition only after other teams confirmed her results.
examples.zh: 其他团队确认她的结果后，这位科学家才获得认可。

examples.en: The child recognized her grandmother's voice.
examples.zh: 孩子认出了祖母的声音。

examples.en: The law recognized the village's right to the forest.
examples.zh: 法律认可了村庄对森林的权利。

examples.en: The rifle recoiled sharply after the shot.
examples.zh: 开枪后，步枪猛烈反冲。

phrases.zh: 洪水后重新开始田野调查

examples.en: Teachers recommended her for a national science program.
examples.zh: 教师推荐她参加国家科学项目。

examples.en: Doctors recommend rest when the infection is mild.
examples.zh: 感染较轻时，医生建议休息。

examples.en: The committee's recommendation was to monitor the cohort for another month.
examples.zh: 委员会的建议是再监测这个队列一个月。

phrases.zh: 与建议；推荐相关的证据

cards.head: reconceive
cards.cutMeaning: 重新/共同；完全/拿取；构想

examples.en: The architect had to reconceive the building after the budget was cut.
examples.zh: 预算削减后，建筑师不得不重新构想这栋建筑。

examples.en: The committee struggled to reconcile economic growth with river protection.
examples.zh: 委员会努力调和经济增长与河流保护。

examples.en: Reconciliation requires truth before forgiveness can become meaningful.
examples.zh: 和解需要真相，宽恕才会有意义。

examples.en: Education can help people reconnect with history without turning it into nostalgia.
examples.zh: 教育可以帮助人们重新连接历史，而不把历史变成怀旧。

examples.en: Cultural education can help young people reconnect with local traditions.
examples.zh: 文化教育可以帮助年轻人重新连接地方传统。

cards.head: reconnection
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/加强，共同/名词

phrases.zh: 收复失地运动意识形态

cards.head: reconstruct
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/共同；加强/建立

examples.en: Historians reconstruct history from fragments that survive by accident.
examples.zh: 历史学家从偶然保存下来的碎片中重构历史。

examples.en: Archaeologists reconstruct history from fragments of tools, bones, and buildings.
examples.zh: 考古学家从工具、骨骼和建筑碎片中重建历史。

cards.head: reconstruction
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/共同；加强/建立/名词

cards.head: reconstructive
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/共同；加强/建立/形容词

cards.head: reconvey
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/共同；加强/名词；形容词

examples.en: The archive keeps a record of every land transfer.
examples.zh: 档案馆保存每次土地转让的记录。

examples.en: Old records reveal how music sounded before digital recording.
examples.zh: 老唱片揭示了数字录音之前音乐的声音。

phrases.zh: 纪录片中的录音师技术
与求助；依靠相关的证据

examples.en: Wetlands can recover their natural function if pollution is reduced for several years.
examples.zh: 如果污染减少几年，湿地可以恢复其自然功能。

examples.en: Patients recover faster when treatment begins before the infection spreads.
examples.zh: 如果在感染扩散前开始治疗，病人会恢复得更快。

examples.en: Economic recovery was slow because many small businesses had lost their customers.
examples.zh: 经济复苏缓慢，因为许多小企业已经失去了顾客。

cards.head: recreate
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/增长，产生/动词；使成为

cards.head: recreation
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/增长，产生/动词；使成为/名词

examples.en: A study must recruit participants without hiding risk or pressure.
examples.zh: 研究必须招募参与者，而不能隐藏风险或压力。

examples.en: The garden was planned as a simple rectangle to make irrigation easier.
examples.zh: 花园被设计成简单矩形，以便灌溉。

examples.en: The company promised to rectify the error on every invoice.
examples.zh: 公司承诺纠正每张发票上的错误。

examples.en: A village rectory can show how religion once shaped local space.
examples.zh: 村庄牧师住宅可以显示宗教曾如何塑造地方空间。

examples.en: Recurring floods forced the town to redesign its drainage system.
examples.zh: 反复发生的洪水迫使城镇重新设计排水系统。

cards.head: recursion
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/跑；流动/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: A climate simulation may use recursion when the same calculation must be repeated inside nested models.
examples.zh: 当同一计算必须在嵌套模型中重复时，气候模拟可能使用递归。

examples.en: A recursive structure repeats a rule inside itself.
examples.zh: 递归结构会在自身内部重复一条规则。

examples.en: Cities should recycle waste while reducing unnecessary packaging at the source consistently.
examples.zh: 城市应持续回收废物，同时从源头减少不必要包装。

examples.en: A recycling system works only when households, businesses, governments, and schools cooperate.
examples.zh: 只有家庭、企业、政府和学校合作时，回收系统才能发挥作用。

examples.en: The soil looked reddish because it contained iron minerals.
examples.zh: 土壤呈微红色，因为其中含有铁矿物。

cards.head: redeem
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/向下；除去/拿；买

examples.en: He tried to redeem his mistake by helping repair the damage.
examples.zh: 他试图通过帮助修复损害来弥补错误。

cards.head: redeemable
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/向下；除去/拿；买/能够；可

cards.head: redeemer
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/向下；除去/拿；买/人；物

examples.en: Urban redevelopment may cause displacement unless revitalization also protects existing residents and small businesses.
examples.zh: 城市再开发可能导致迁出，除非城市活化也保护原有居民和小企业。

examples.en: Governments can redirect funding from empty stadiums to hospitals, schools, and housing.
examples.zh: 政府可以把资金从空置体育场转移到医院、学校和住房。

cards.head: redirection
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/二；分开/直；正确/名词

cards.head: rediscover
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/分开；否定/共同；一起/真实

phrases.zh: 重新发现被忽视的证据

cards.head: redistribute
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/分开；否定/给予/词尾

examples.en: Tax policy can redistribute wealth without changing ownership directly.
examples.zh: 税收政策可以在不直接改变所有权的情况下重新分配财富。

examples.en: Tax policy can redistribute resources toward schools and healthcare.
examples.zh: 税收政策可以把资源重新分配给学校和医疗。

cards.head: reduce
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/引导，带来/词尾

examples.en: Cities can reduce emissions by improving public transport and limiting private car use.
examples.zh: 城市可以通过改善公共交通并限制私家车使用来减少排放。

cards.head: reduction
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/引导/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: Risk reduction works best when prevention starts early.
examples.zh: 风险降低在预防尽早开始时效果最好。

cards.head: redundant
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/多余的/形容词；名词

examples.en: A redundant system can keep operating after one component fails.
examples.zh: 冗余设计的系统可以在一个部件失效后继续运行。

examples.en: The reef protects the coast by breaking waves before they reach the beach.
examples.zh: 礁石在海浪到达海滩前削弱浪力，从而保护海岸。

cards.head: reexamine
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/出；向外/离开；使；无/小/词尾

phrases.zh: 与重新审查相关的证据

examples.en: Doctors should refer to previous evidence before giving online medical advice to anxious patients.
examples.zh: 医生在给焦虑患者提供线上医疗建议前，应参考先前证据。

examples.en: Students should refer to the map before answering the question.
examples.zh: 学生回答问题前应参考地图。

cards.head: referee
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/带来，拿来/人；受事者

examples.en: The article made a brief reference to earlier climate records.
examples.zh: 这篇文章简短提到了早期气候记录。

examples.en: Students kept the dictionary nearby for reference while reading.
examples.zh: 学生阅读时把词典放在旁边以便参考。

examples.en: A strong reference from a former teacher helped him get the job.
examples.zh: 前任老师的一封有力推荐信帮助他得到这份工作。

cards.head: referral
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/带来；承载/形容词

examples.en: Resource extraction removes materials from the earth, while refining turns crude inputs into usable industrial products.
examples.zh: 资源开采把材料从地下取出，而精炼把粗原料转化为可用工业产品。

examples.en: Several trials helped the designers refine the medical device.
examples.zh: 多次试验帮助设计者完善这台医疗设备。

examples.en: Refined sugar dissolves quickly in hot tea.
examples.zh: 精制糖在热茶中很快溶解。

examples.en: Continuous refinement can turn a rough idea into a usable model.
examples.zh: 持续改进可以把粗糙想法变成可用模型。

examples.en: Gradual refinement of tools allowed early humans to hunt and cooperate more effectively.
examples.zh: 工具的逐步完善让早期人类能够更有效地狩猎和合作。

examples.en: A poorly regulated refinery can despoil nearby land when waste and fumes are released without treatment.
examples.zh: 监管不善的炼油厂如果未经处理就排放废物和烟气，会破坏附近土地。

examples.en: Refining removes impurities before the material enters production.
examples.zh: 提纯会在材料进入生产前去除杂质。

examples.en: Still water can reflect mountains like a mirror.
examples.zh: 静止水面能像镜子一样反射群山。

examples.en: The budget reflects the government's real priorities.
examples.zh: 预算反映了政府真正的优先事项。

examples.en: Critical reflection turns experience into knowledge rather than mere memory.
examples.zh: 批判性反思把经验变成知识，而不只是记忆。

examples.en: A sudden sensory input can trigger a reflex before the brain has fully interpreted the event.
examples.zh: 突然的感官输入会在大脑完全解释事件之前触发反射。

cards.head: reforestation
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/叶；草/休息；剩余/名词

examples.en: Severe desertification can reduce crop yields, while long-term reforestation may restore shade, soil moisture, and local biodiversity.
examples.zh: 严重荒漠化会降低作物产量，而长期再造林可能恢复阴凉、土壤水分和本地生物多样性。

examples.en: Education reform can fail if teachers are not trained for the new system.
examples.zh: 如果教师没有接受新制度培训，教育改革可能失败。

cards.head: reformist
cards.cutMeaning: 重新/形成，形状/人；从业者

examples.en: Reformist ideas often face resistance from groups that benefit from old rules.
examples.zh: 改革思想常常遭到从旧规则获益群体的抵制。

phrases.zh: 通过媒体折射公众意见

examples.en: Refraction bends light as it passes from air into water.
examples.zh: 光从空气进入水中时，折射会使光线弯曲。

phrases.zh: 重新框定公共卫生信息
重新授予交通服务特许权
重新授权地方公用事业

cards.head: refreshing
cards.cutMeaning: 使精神振作/动作；形容词

examples.en: Her honest answer was refreshing after hours of official excuses.
examples.zh: 听了几个小时官方借口后，她诚实的回答使人耳目一新。

examples.en: Cold water was refreshing after the long climb.
examples.zh: 长时间攀爬后，冷水很提神。

examples.en: The clinic refrigerates vaccines during transport.
examples.zh: 诊所在运输中冷藏疫苗。

examples.en: The machine can refrigerate the storage room within an hour.
examples.zh: 机器能在一小时内使储藏室变冷。

cards.head: refugee
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/避难所/人；受事者

examples.en: The store will refund the money if the device fails within a week.
examples.zh: 如果设备一周内坏掉，商店会退款。

examples.en: The city will refurbish the old theatre instead of demolishing it.
examples.zh: 城市将翻新旧剧院，而不是拆除它。

examples.en: A refusal to cooperate can become a form of resistance.
examples.zh: 拒绝合作可以成为一种抵抗形式。

examples.en: Patients may refuse treatment if doctors fail to explain risks clearly enough.
examples.zh: 如果医生未能足够清楚地解释风险，患者可能拒绝治疗。

cards.head: refutable
cards.cutMeaning: 反驳/形容词；动词/能够；可

examples.en: Researchers can refute an argument if evidence shows the policy harms students.
examples.zh: 如果证据表明政策伤害学生，研究者可以反驳该论点。

examples.en: Employers should regard robots as tools rather than replacements for all workers.
examples.zh: 雇主应将机器人视为工具，而不是所有工人的替代品。

phrases.zh: 与不管；无论相关的证据

cards.head: regenerate
cards.cutMeaning: 又/制造，产生/动词；使成为

examples.en: Some animals can regenerate damaged tissue after injury.
examples.zh: 一些动物受伤后能再生受损组织。

examples.en: A weak regime can survive criticism if no convincing rebuttal shows why its rules fail in practice.

examples.zh: 尽管受到公众称赞，这个项目的投资回报率很低。

examples.en: The reunion brought classmates together after twenty years apart.
examples.zh: 这次重聚让分别二十年的同学再次相聚。

examples.en: Consumers can reuse materials, but producers should also reduce wasteful packaging today.
examples.zh: 如今消费者可以再利用材料，但生产者也应减少浪费性包装。

phrases.zh: 免疫力下降后再次接种

examples.en: Survey data can reveal hidden problems in online education and rural healthcare.
examples.zh: 调查数据可以揭示线上教育和农村医疗中的隐藏问题。

examples.en: The new images reveal details of the planet's surface.
examples.zh: 新图像展现了行星表面的细节。

examples.en: A sudden revelation can change how earlier events are understood.
examples.zh: 突然揭示会改变人们对早期事件的理解。

examples.en: A firm may use outsourcing to reduce costs, but falling revenue can still force layoffs.
examples.zh: 企业可能用外包降低成本，但收入下降仍可能迫使裁员。

examples.en: The museum created a new revenue-stream by offering online tours.
examples.zh: 博物馆通过提供线上导览创造了新的收入来源。

examples.en: Many communities revere elders who preserve local memory.
examples.zh: 许多社区尊敬保存地方记忆的长者。

examples.en: The court reversed the decision after new evidence appeared.
examples.zh: 新证据出现后，法院推翻了判决。

examples.en: The reverse side of the coin shows a local bird.
examples.zh: 硬币反面显示的是一种本地鸟。

cards.cutMeaning: 再次；向回/转/能够；可/名词

examples.zh: 可逆性很重要，因为治疗失败时病人可以退出。

examples.en: If the experiment fails, the team will revert to the older method.
examples.zh: 如果实验失败，团队将恢复使用旧方法。

phrases.zh: 在法庭上使幸存者再次受害

examples.en: Experts reviewed the bridge design before construction began.
examples.zh: 施工开始前，专家审查了桥梁设计。

examples.en: Students reviewed old vocabulary before the test.
examples.zh: 学生在考试前复习旧词汇。

examples.en: A short review helped the class remember the main ideas.
examples.zh: 简短复习帮助全班记住主要观点。

examples.en: The newspaper published a review of the new museum.
examples.zh: 报纸发表了对新博物馆的评论。

examples.en: A reviewer should explain why a manuscript needs revision.
examples.zh: 审稿人应解释稿件为什么需要修改。

examples.en: The committee revised the report after experts found errors.
examples.zh: 专家发现错误后，委员会修改了报告。

examples.en: The printer returned the revise for one final check.
examples.zh: 印刷厂把再校样送回做最后检查。

examples.en: The council will revisit the plan after residents submit new evidence.
examples.zh: 居民提交新证据后，委员会将重新考虑该计划。

cards.head: revitalisation

senses.gloss: act or process of revitalization, revival

cards.head: revitalization
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/有活力的/使成为；动词/名词

examples.en: Urban redevelopment may cause displacement unless revitalization also protects existing residents and small businesses.
examples.zh: 城市再开发可能导致迁出，除非城市活化也保护原有居民和小企业。

cards.head: revitalize
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/有活力的/使成为；动词

examples.en: Small businesses helped revitalize a street that had been empty for years.
examples.zh: 小企业帮助一条空置多年的街道恢复生机。

examples.en: Cultural revival can preserve memory while creating new forms.
examples.zh: 文化复兴可以保存记忆，同时创造新形式。

senses.gloss: return to life or popularity, recovery

examples.en: The festival helped revive a local craft that had nearly disappeared.
examples.zh: 这个节日帮助复兴了一种几乎消失的地方手艺。

cards.head: revocable
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；重新/叫喊，声音/能够；可

cards.head: revocation

examples.zh: 多次泄漏后，该机构撤销了工厂许可证。

examples.en: The council revoked the rule when residents protested.
examples.zh: 居民抗议后，委员会取消了这条规则。

examples.en: Workers revolted after wages were cut again.
examples.zh: 工资再次被削减后，工人反叛。

examples.en: The revolt began in the northern towns.
examples.zh: 起义始于北方城镇。

examples.en: The tax caused open revolt in several villages.
examples.zh: 这项税收在几个村庄引发公开反抗。

cards.head: revolution
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/滚；卷/动作；状态；名词

examples.en: Earth's rotation creates day and night, while its revolution around the Sun helps shape the year.
examples.zh: 地球自转产生昼夜，而它围绕太阳的公转帮助形成一年。

cards.head: revolutionary
cards.cutMeaning: 再次；回/滚；卷/动作；状态；名词/形容词

examples.en: A revolutionary idea can become ordinary once institutions adopt it.
examples.zh: 革命性思想一旦被制度吸收，就可能变得普通。

examples.en: Revolutionary change can begin with small technological improvements.
examples.zh: 革命性变化可能始于小的技术改进。

examples.en: The planets revolve around the sun in regular paths.
examples.zh: 行星沿固定轨道绕太阳旋转。

examples.en: The city offered a reward for information about the missing statue.
examples.zh: 城市悬赏寻找失踪雕像的线索。

examples.en: The reward for years of training was a place on the national team.
examples.zh: 多年训练的回报是进入国家队。

examples.en: The school rewarded students who helped younger children read.
examples.zh: 学校奖励帮助低龄儿童阅读的学生。

examples.en: Power can rewrite history by deciding which records become visible.
examples.zh: 权力可以通过决定哪些记录可见来改写历史。

examples.en: The rewritten policy removed several confusing rules from the original draft.
examples.zh: 改写后的政策删去了原草案中几条令人困惑的规则。

examples.en: She rewrote the introduction after the argument became clearer.
examples.zh: 论证变得更清楚后，她重写了引言。

examples.en: A political metaphor may work as rhetoric when it turns a complex policy into a simple image.
examples.zh: 当政治隐喻把复杂政策变成简单图像时，它可能发挥修辞作用。

cards.head: rhetorical
cards.cutMeaning: 修辞/形容词；名词/形容词；名词

examples.en: A rhetorical question can make an argument more memorable.
examples.zh: 反问句可以让论点更容易被记住。

examples.zh: 犀牛用角进行防御和社会展示。

examples.en: The poem uses rhyme to make each line easier to remember.
examples.zh: 这首诗使用押韵让每一行更容易记住。

examples.zh: 英语中，light 可以和 night 押韵。

examples.en: The rhythm of the poem changes when the speaker becomes angry.
examples.zh: 说话者变得愤怒时，诗的节奏发生变化。

examples.en: Rhythmic movement can coordinate bodies before words are spoken.
examples.zh: 有节奏的动作可以在语言出现前协调身体。

examples.en: Rhythmic patterns in music can preserve cultural memory across generations.
examples.zh: 音乐中的节奏模式可以跨代保存文化记忆。

examples.en: The printer needed a new ribbon.
examples.zh: 打印机需要一条新色带。

examples.en: A blue ribbon marked the safe path.
examples.zh: 一条蓝色带状物标出了安全路径。

examples.en: Rice cultivation depends on water control more than many dry crops do.
examples.zh: 水稻种植比许多旱作物更依赖水资源控制。

examples.en: A rich archive can reveal ordinary lives as well as famous events.
examples.zh: 丰富的档案既能揭示普通人的生活，也能揭示著名事件。

examples.en: A rocky ridge protected the settlement from strong coastal winds.
examples.zh: 一道岩石山脊保护这个定居点免受强劲海风影响。

examples.en: The proposal sounded ridiculous because it ignored the basic cost of labour.
examples.zh: 这个提案听起来荒唐，因为它忽略了基本劳动力成本。

examples.en: A social rift grows when groups stop sharing basic facts.
examples.zh: 当群体不再共享基本事实时，社会裂痕会扩大。

senses.gloss: correct, legal claim, opposite of left

examples.en: A right means little when people cannot actually use it.
examples.zh: 当人们无法实际使用权利时，权利意义有限。

examples.en: Rigid rules left teachers no room to help unusual cases.
examples.zh: 严格规则让教师没有空间帮助特殊情况。

examples.en: A rigid metal frame kept the instrument steady.
examples.zh: 刚硬金属框架使仪器保持稳定。

examples.en: Scientific rigor requires careful measurement and honest reporting.
examples.zh: 科学严谨性要求仔细测量和诚实报告。

phrases.zh: 解释中的法律严苛主义

examples.en: A retroactive rule requires especially rigorous justification because it changes the legal meaning of earlier behaviour.
examples.zh: 追溯规则需要格外严谨的正当化，因为它改变了早期行为的法律意义。

examples.en: A ring of power can exclude people who lack informal access.
examples.zh: 权力圈会排斥缺乏非正式渠道的人。

phrases.zh: 头发研究中的卷环模式

examples.en: Rinse the vegetables before cooking them.
examples.zh: 烹饪前用清水冲洗蔬菜。

examples.en: The dentist told the child to rinse after brushing.
examples.zh: 牙医告诉孩子刷牙后漱口。

examples.en: Ripe fruit attracts birds with colour and smell.
examples.zh: 成熟水果用颜色和气味吸引鸟类。

examples.en: Apples ripen faster in warm weather.
examples.zh: 苹果在温暖天气中成熟得更快。

examples.en: Living costs often rise sharply when housing demand exceeds available supply in major cities.
examples.zh: 当大城市住房需求超过可用供应时，生活成本往往会急剧上升。
