examples.zh: 考古学家挖出了埋在旧地板下的工具。

examples.en: An uneasy silence followed the official announcement.
examples.zh: 官方公告后出现了一阵不安的沉默。

examples.en: The unemployed need support that protects dignity as well as income.
examples.zh: 失业者需要既保护收入也保护尊严的支持。

examples.en: Youth unemployment can increase social instability if training opportunities remain limited nationwide.
examples.zh: 如果全国培训机会仍然有限，青年失业会增加社会不稳定。

cards.head: unequal
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/相等，平均/形容词；名词

senses.zh: （在大小、数量等方面）不同的，不相等的

examples.en: Uneven ground made it difficult to move the equipment.
examples.zh: 不平的地面使设备移动变得困难。

cards.head: unexceptional
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/向外；离开/拿取；接受/动作；状态；名词/形容词

cards.head: unfamiliar
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/家庭；熟悉/形容词

cards.head: unflinchingly
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/退缩/形容词/副词

examples.en: She answered the difficult questions unflinchingly during the hearing.
examples.zh: 听证会上，她坚定地回答了那些难题。

cards.head: unfolds
cards.cutMeaning: 打开；展开/折叠/第三人称

cards.head: unforgivable
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/完全；离开/给予/能够；可

examples.en: Destroying evidence in a public inquiry is an unforgivable act.
examples.zh: 在公共调查中销毁证据是不可原谅的行为。

examples.en: An unfortunate delay left the travellers without shelter after dark.
examples.zh: 一次不幸的延误让旅行者天黑后没有住所。

cards.head: unhedged
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/围住；限制；对冲/形容词

examples.en: The investor left the currency risk unhedged and lost money when rates changed.
examples.zh: 投资者没有对冲汇率风险，汇率变化时亏了钱。

phrases.zh: 与取消隐藏相关的证据

examples.en: The unicorn appears in legends as a rare and magical creature.
examples.zh: 独角兽在传说中是一种稀有而神奇的生物。

examples.en: National unification can create a larger market but may also intensify regional tensions.
examples.zh: 国家统一可以创造更大市场，但也可能加剧地区紧张。

examples.en: The nurse wore a clean uniform.
examples.zh: 护士穿着干净制服。

phrases.zh: 穿制服的公共服务人员

examples.en: The school introduced uniform rules for all classes.
examples.zh: 学校为所有班级引入统一规则。

examples.en: Uniform rainfall helped crops grow evenly.
examples.zh: 均匀降雨帮助作物均衡生长。

examples.en: Governments may unify standards to make online healthcare safer and more reliable.
examples.zh: 政府可以统一标准，让线上医疗更安全、更可靠。

examples.en: Once unimaginable change can become normal when technology moves faster than culture.
examples.zh: 当技术变化快于文化时，曾经难以想象的变化可能变得普通。

examples.en: War can cause unimaginable damage to communities, infrastructure, and cultural memory.
examples.zh: 战争会对社区、基础设施和文化记忆造成难以想象的损害。

cards.head: uninhabitable
cards.cutMeaning: 不/在内/居住/能够；形容词

examples.en: Rising heat may make some areas uninhabitable in the future.
examples.zh: 气温上升可能让一些地区在未来变得无法居住。

examples.en: A rule becomes useless when its wording is unintelligible to ordinary people.
examples.zh: 当规则措辞对普通人来说难以理解时，它就会失去作用。

cards.head: uninterested
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/在中间/存在；兴趣/形容词

examples.en: The audience grew uninterested when the speaker repeated the same point.
examples.zh: 演讲者重复同一点时，听众变得不感兴趣。

examples.en: The union negotiated safer hours for factory workers.
examples.zh: 工会为工厂工人争取更安全的工作时间。

examples.en: Workers tried to unionise after wages fell for the third year.
examples.zh: 工资连续第三年下降后，工人试图组织工会。

examples.en: Small countries may have unique advantages in tourism, culture, and local food.
examples.zh: 小国可能在旅游、文化和本地食物方面拥有独特优势。

examples.en: The cave contains a unique species found nowhere else.
examples.zh: 这个洞穴中有一种别处没有的独特物种。

examples.en: A united community can recover faster after a disaster.
examples.zh: 团结的社区能在灾难后更快恢复。

examples.en: A universal rule may still affect different communities unequally.
examples.zh: 一条普遍规则仍可能对不同社群产生不平等影响。

examples.en: Moral universalism argues that basic rights should apply to all humans.
examples.zh: 道德普遍主义认为基本权利应适用于所有人。

examples.en: A distant planet may appear tiny within the observable universe, yet its atmosphere can still reveal signs of water.
examples.zh: 遥远行星在可观测宇宙中可能显得微小，但其大气仍可能揭示水的迹象。

examples.en: The observable universe is larger than ordinary imagination can easily hold.
examples.zh: 可观测宇宙大到普通想象难以容纳。

examples.en: The observable universe is larger than ordinary imagination can easily hold.
examples.zh: 可观测宇宙大到普通想象难以容纳。

examples.en: A research university should protect curiosity as well as credentials.
examples.zh: 研究型大学既应保护文凭，也应保护好奇心。

examples.en: New technology can unleash economic change before law is prepared.
examples.zh: 新技术可能在法律准备好之前引发经济变革。

examples.en: A broken dam can unleash a dangerous flood downstream.
examples.zh: 破裂的大坝会向下游释放危险洪水。

phrases.zh: 以 unlikely 方式呈现的重要证据

examples.en: The unlucky farmer lost his crop just before harvest.
examples.zh: 这个倒霉农民在收获前失去了庄稼。

cards.head: unmanaged
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/手；处理/做；驱动/形容词

senses.zh: 无人管理的；未受控制的

examples.en: Unmanaged growth damaged the wetland around the town.
examples.zh: 无人管理的增长破坏了城镇周围的湿地。

cards.head: unmistakable
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/错误；误认/能够；可

examples.en: The smell of smoke was unmistakable in the stairwell.
examples.zh: 楼梯间里的烟味非常明显，不会认错。

cards.head: unofficial
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/朝向；反对/做，制作/形容词

cards.head: unorthodox
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/正确；正直/意见；信念

examples.en: Unorthodox ideas can become valuable when old methods stop working.
examples.zh: 当旧方法失效时，非常规想法可能变得有价值。

cards.head: unparalleled
cards.cutMeaning: 无/平行/形容词；过去分词

examples.en: The storm caused unparalleled damage along the coast.
examples.zh: 风暴在海岸造成空前损害。

examples.en: Her knowledge of local plants was unparalleled.
examples.zh: 她对当地植物的知识无与伦比。

examples.en: The unpleasant smell warned workers that gas might be leaking.
examples.zh: 难闻气味警告工人可能有气体泄漏。

examples.en: The unpopular tax was removed after months of protest.
examples.zh: 经过数月抗议，这项不受欢迎的税被取消了。

cards.head: unprecedented
cards.cutMeaning: 不/先例/形容词；过去分词

examples.en: An unprecedented policy change may be beneficial if it reduces inequality without creating new administrative burdens.
examples.zh: 如果一项前所未有的政策变化能减少不平等而不制造新的行政负担，它可能是有益的。

examples.en: The cafe felt unpretentious, with plain tables and honest food.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆感觉朴素，没有花哨桌椅，食物也实在。

cards.head: unprocessed
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/向前；支持/走；让步/坐

cards.head: unproductive
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/向前；支持/引导，带来/形容词

examples.en: The meeting was unproductive because nobody had authority to decide.
examples.zh: 会议毫无成效，因为没人有权作决定。

examples.en: The route became unprofitable when passenger numbers fell.
examples.zh: 乘客数量下降后，这条线路变得无利可图。

cards.head: unprovable
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/测试，证明/能够；可

phrases.zh: 法庭上无法证明的指控

examples.en: Researchers tried to unravel why the ancient settlement was abandoned.
examples.zh: 研究者试图弄清这个古代聚落为何被废弃。

cards.head: unrelated
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/回；再次/携带；关系/形容词

examples.en: Two fires on the same day were unrelated, according to investigators.
examples.zh: 调查人员称，同一天发生的两场火灾并无关联。

cards.head: unremarkable
cards.cutMeaning: 不/再次；加强/标记；注意/值得；形容词

examples.en: An unremarkable detail can become important when the pattern is finally visible.
examples.zh: 当模式终于可见时，普通细节会变得重要。

examples.en: A live performance can feel unrepeatable because the audience changes it.
examples.zh: 现场表演会因观众影响而显得不可重复。

phrases.zh: 与反季节的相关的证据

cards.head: unsolicited
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/恳求；请求/形容词

senses.zh: 主动提供的；未经请求的

examples.en: Unsolicited advice can feel helpful to the speaker and intrusive to the listener.
examples.zh: 未经请求的建议，对说的人可能像帮助，对听的人却可能像打扰。

examples.en: The unspeaking witness changed the mood of the room simply by standing there.
examples.zh: 那位沉默的目击者只是站在那里，就改变了房间里的气氛。

senses.zh: 未说出口的；心照不宣的

examples.en: An unspoken agreement kept the neighbours from arguing about the fence.
examples.zh: 心照不宣的协议让邻居们没有为围栏争吵。

examples.en: The article repeated unsubstantiated claims about the scientist.
examples.zh: 这篇文章重复了关于这位科学家的未经证实的说法。

cards.head: unsuccessful
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/在下；随后/行走，前进/充满

examples.en: The first attempt was unsuccessful, but it revealed the main weakness.
examples.zh: 第一次尝试不成功，但暴露了主要弱点。

examples.en: The untamed river changed course after every flood.
examples.zh: 这条难以驯服的河每次洪水后都会改道。

examples.en: The region has untapped wind power that could support nearby towns.
examples.zh: 该地区有未开发的风能，可支持附近城镇。

phrases.en: until the end of the trial

phrases.zh: 灾难后难以言说的悲伤
创伤难以言说的复杂性

cards.head: unverifiable
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/真实/使成为/能够；可

examples.en: An unverifiable claim should not guide public health policy.
examples.zh: 无法核实的主张不应指导公共卫生政策。

examples.en: The announcement brought unwelcome news to families waiting for repairs.
examples.zh: 这则公告给等待维修的家庭带来了不受欢迎的消息。

cards.head: unwieldy
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/使用；掌握/形容词

examples.en: An unwieldy system can delay medical reimbursement and frustrate older patients repeatedly.
examples.zh: 笨重系统会反复延误医疗报销，并让老年患者沮丧。

cards.head: unwittingly
cards.cutMeaning: 不；相反/知道；意识/形容词/副词

examples.en: Tourists may unwittingly carry seeds on their shoes between islands.
examples.zh: 游客可能无意中通过鞋子在岛屿之间携带种子。

phrases.zh: 不值得采信的科学证据

examples.en: Unwritten rules can shape behaviour more strongly than official signs.
examples.zh: 不成文规则对行为的影响可能比官方标志更强。

examples.en: Social upheaval can break old rules before new ones are ready.
examples.zh: 社会剧变会在新规则准备好之前打破旧规则。

examples.en: Rapid automation may create social upheaval if workers receive no support.
examples.zh: 如果劳动者得不到支持，快速自动化可能造成社会剧变。

examples.en: Safety was uppermost in her mind during the rescue.
examples.zh: 救援期间，安全是她心中最重要的事。

examples.en: Walking upright changed how early humans used hands, tools, and vision.
examples.zh: 直立行走改变了早期人类使用双手、工具和视觉的方式。

senses.zh: 心烦意乱的 [ʌpˈset] v. 颠覆，推翻

examples.en: The upset child refused to speak after the accident.
examples.zh: 心烦意乱的孩子事故后拒绝说话。

examples.en: The delay upset the whole schedule.
examples.zh: 延误扰乱了整个日程。

examples.en: Coastal upwelling brings nutrients upward, which can increase phytoplankton growth and support fish populations.
examples.zh: 沿岸上升流把营养物带到上层，从而增加浮游植物生长并支持鱼类种群。

examples.en: Uranium can produce energy, but its waste requires careful storage.
examples.zh: 铀可以产生能源，但其废料需要谨慎储存。

examples.en: A skyscraper can transform an urban skyline, but it may also increase pressure on transport, energy, and public space.
examples.zh: 摩天大楼可以改变城市天际线，但也可能增加交通、能源和公共空间压力。

examples.en: Urban planning affects health, mobility, and social contact.
examples.zh: 城市规划影响健康、流动性和社会接触。

examples.en: Urban-planning decisions affect transport, housing, and green space.
examples.zh: 城市规划决策影响交通、住房和绿地。

examples.en: Urban-sprawl increased car dependence and reduced farmland.
examples.zh: 城市蔓延增加了汽车依赖，并减少了农田。

senses.zh: 城市主义；城市生活方式

examples.en: Rapid urbanization can create jobs, but weak social integration may leave migrants isolated in expanding cities.
examples.zh: 快速城市化可以创造工作，但薄弱社会融合可能让移民在扩张城市中被孤立。

phrases.zh: 社会学中的城市丛林隐喻

examples.en: Doctors urged residents to boil drinking water.
examples.zh: 医生力劝居民把饮用水煮沸。

examples.en: The urge to return home grew stronger after winter.
examples.zh: 冬天后，回家的迫切要求更强了。

examples.en: Air pollution is an urgent problem for children in crowded industrial cities.
examples.zh: 空气污染是拥挤工业城市中儿童面临的紧急问题。

examples.en: The compressed file was usable only after the missing standard was restored.
examples.zh: 缺失标准恢复后，压缩文件才可使用。

examples.en: Rain usually arrives in the afternoon during the summer months.
examples.zh: 夏季月份降雨通常在下午到来。

examples.en: Each cooking utensil was cleaned before the lesson began.
examples.zh: 课程开始前，每件烹饪用具都被清洗干净。

examples.en: High capacity utilisation can look efficient while making a system fragile.
examples.zh: 高产能利用率看似高效，却可能让系统变脆弱。

examples.en: Schools should utilise technology to deepen learning, not merely decorate lessons.
examples.zh: 学校应利用技术深化学习，而不是只装饰课堂。

examples.en: Schools can utilise digital tools without abandoning face-to-face discussion.
examples.zh: 学校可以利用数字工具，而不放弃面对面讨论。

cards.head: utilitarian
cards.cutMeaning: 有用；使用/名词/人；形容词

examples.en: In ethics, a utilitarian argument may defend a policy because it maximises overall welfare.
examples.zh: 在伦理学中，功利主义论证可能因为一项政策最大化总体福利而为其辩护。

examples.en: Utilitarian ethics judges actions by their consequences for overall welfare.
examples.zh: 功利主义伦理根据行为对整体福利的后果来判断行为。

cards.head: utilitarianism
cards.cutMeaning: 有用；使用/名词/人；形容词/主义

examples.en: utilitarianism evaluates actions by consequences, while virtue ethics asks what kind of person an action helps create.
examples.zh: 功利主义根据后果评价行动，而美德伦理追问行动帮助塑造什么样的人。

examples.en: Utilitarianism judges action by consequences, especially overall welfare.
examples.zh: 功利主义根据后果判断行动，尤其关注总体福利。

phrases.zh: 道德哲学中的功利主义

examples.en: A tool has practical utility only when it solves a real task.
examples.zh: 工具只有在解决真实任务时才有实用价值。

examples.en: Efficient data transmission improves resource utilization because managers can see waste as soon as it occurs.
examples.zh: 高效数据传输会改善资源利用，因为管理者能在浪费发生时立即看见它。

examples.en: Farmers can utilize rainfall data to choose a safer planting date.
examples.zh: 农民可以利用降雨数据选择更安全的播种日期。

examples.en: Schools can utilize technology to support students in remote rural areas effectively.
examples.zh: 学校可以有效利用技术支持偏远农村地区的学生。

examples.en: The hospital treated the private records with the utmost care.
examples.zh: 医院以最大谨慎处理私人记录。

examples.en: A technological utopia may ignore inequality, labour, and environmental costs.
examples.zh: 技术乌托邦可能忽视不平等、劳动和环境成本。

phrases.zh: 城市设计中的乌托邦主义
乌托邦主义与社会改革
乌托邦主义者的平等愿景
乌托邦主义者对资本主义的批评
思辨小说中的乌托邦地理描写
理想城市的乌托邦地理描写

examples.en: The witness uttered only a few words.
examples.zh: 证人只说了几个字。

examples.en: The plan ended in utter failure.
examples.zh: 计划以完全失败告终。

examples.en: A claim can sound confident and still be utterly wrong.
examples.zh: 一个主张听起来再自信，也可能完全错误。

examples.en: The hotel had one vacancy after a cancellation.
examples.zh: 有人取消后，酒店有一个空余住处。

examples.en: The school announced a vacancy for a science teacher.
examples.zh: 学校宣布有一个科学教师空缺。

examples.en: A look of vacancy crossed his face after the shock.
examples.zh: 震惊后，他脸上掠过头脑空虚的神情。

examples.en: A vacant room was used for storage.
examples.zh: 一间空房被用作储藏室。

examples.en: The vacant shop stood unused for years.
examples.zh: 这家闲置商店多年未用。

examples.en: Residents must vacate the building before repairs begin.
examples.zh: 维修开始前，居民必须腾出这栋楼。

examples.en: A short vacation helped the family recover after a stressful year.
examples.zh: 短暂假期帮助这家人在压力很大的一年后恢复。

cards.head: vaccination
cards.cutMeaning: 接种疫苗/动词；使成为/名词

examples.en: Mass vaccination can increase population immunity before a dangerous disease spreads widely.
examples.zh: 大规模疫苗接种可以在危险疾病广泛传播前提高群体免疫力。

examples.en: An information vacuum allows rumours to become authority.
examples.zh: 信息真空会让谣言变成权威。

examples.en: A political vacuum can appear when old institutions collapse before new ones are ready.
examples.zh: 当旧机构崩溃而新机构尚未准备好时，可能会出现政治真空。

examples.en: A political vacuum can appear when old institutions collapse before new ones are ready.
examples.zh: 当旧机构崩溃而新机构尚未准备好时，可能会出现政治真空。

examples.en: A vacuum chamber removes air before the experiment begins.
examples.zh: 真空室在实验开始前移除空气。

examples.en: Vague language can soften responsibility without solving problems.
examples.zh: 模糊语言可以淡化责任，却不能解决问题。

examples.en: Valid evidence should guide policy more than rumours or political pressure today.
examples.zh: 如今有效证据应比谣言或政治压力更能指导政策。

examples.en: Independent research can validate the results before governments use them to justify spending.
examples.zh: 独立研究可以在政府用结果证明支出合理之前验证结果。

cards.head: validation
cards.cutMeaning: 使有效/动词；使成为/名词

examples.en: A weak methodology may reduce research validity, especially when qualitative and quantitative evidence are combined without clear rules.
examples.zh: 薄弱方法论可能降低研究有效性，尤其当定性和定量证据没有明确规则就被结合时。

examples.en: Statistical validity depends on design, sampling, and interpretation.
examples.zh: 统计有效性取决于设计、抽样和解释。

examples.en: Content monetization can raise company valuation if user attention becomes a stable revenue source.
examples.zh: 如果用户注意力成为稳定收入来源，内容变现可以提高公司估值。

examples.en: The value of clean water becomes obvious when a city faces a long drought.
examples.zh: 当城市面临长期干旱时，清洁水的价值会变得明显。

examples.en: Each factory added one step to the global value-chain.
examples.zh: 每家工厂都为全球价值链增加一个环节。

examples.en: A shared value-system helped the group settle disputes peacefully.
examples.zh: 共同价值体系帮助这个群体和平解决争端。

examples.en: Public attention can vanish before a problem is actually solved.
examples.zh: 公众注意力可能在问题真正解决前就消失。

examples.en: Languages can vanish when younger generations stop using them in daily life.
examples.zh: 当年轻一代不再日常使用某种语言时，它可能消失。

examples.en: A vanity project can consume resources while producing little public value.
examples.zh: 虚荣工程可能消耗资源，却几乎不产生公共价值。

senses.zh: 空头软件；迟迟不发布的产品

phrases.zh: 科技市场中的空头产品

examples.en: An algorithm may adjust a variable repeatedly until a model produces reliable predictions.
examples.zh: 算法可能反复调整变量，直到模型产生可靠预测。

examples.en: A variable must be defined clearly before it can be measured.
examples.zh: 变量必须先被清楚定义，才能被测量。

examples.en: High variance means data points spread widely, so a regression model may predict outcomes less reliably.
examples.zh: 高方差意味着数据点分散很广，因此回归模型可能不那么可靠地预测结果。

examples.en: High variance can make an average look more stable than reality.
examples.zh: 高方差会让平均值看起来比现实更稳定。

cards.head: varied
cards.cutMeaning: 不同的/形容词；过去分词

examples.en: A varied diet provides nutrients from many different foods.
examples.zh: 多样化饮食从许多不同食物中提供营养。

examples.en: A variety of crops can protect farmers from one failed harvest.
examples.zh: 多种作物能保护农民免受单一歉收影响。

examples.en: The carpenter applied varnish to protect the wooden table.
examples.zh: 木匠涂上清漆保护木桌。

examples.en: Healthcare access may vary widely between urban centres and remote rural villages.
examples.zh: 城市中心和偏远农村村庄之间的医疗可及性可能差异很大。

examples.en: Vascular tissue carries water and nutrients through the plant.
examples.zh: 维管组织在植物体内输送水分和养分。

examples.en: The desert covered a vast area beyond the mountains.
examples.zh: 沙漠覆盖了群山之外的巨大区域。

examples.en: The empire controlled a vast network of roads.
examples.zh: 帝国控制着范围广阔的道路网络。

examples.en: The new bridge vastly reduced travel time between the two towns.
examples.zh: 新桥大幅缩短了两个城镇之间的出行时间。

examples.en: The stone vault kept the room cool even in summer.
examples.zh: 石拱顶让房间即使在夏天也保持凉爽。

examples.en: A vector has both size and direction in geometry.
examples.zh: 在几何中，向量同时具有大小和方向。

examples.en: Vegetable production depends on water, soil, labour, and transport.
examples.zh: 蔬菜生产依赖水、土壤、劳动和运输。

examples.en: Fresh vegetables are essential for public health and food security.
examples.zh: 新鲜蔬菜对公共健康和粮食安全至关重要。

examples.en: A vegetarian diet can still provide enough protein when it is planned well.
examples.zh: 素食饮食如果规划得当，仍能提供足够蛋白质。

senses.zh: 无所作为；像植物般生长

phrases.zh: 在制度惯例中无所作为

cards.head: vegetation
cards.cutMeaning: 无所作为/动词；使成为/名词

examples.en: Healthy vegetation depends on photosynthesis, because plants must convert light into energy before growth can continue.
examples.zh: 健康植被依赖光合作用，因为植物必须先把光转化为能量，生长才能继续。

cards.head: vegetative
cards.cutMeaning: 无所作为/动词；使成为/形容词

examples.en: A slogan can become a vehicle for ideas far beyond its original purpose.
examples.zh: 一个口号可以成为远超其原始目的的思想载体。

examples.en: Fog veiled the mountain before dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明前，雾遮蔽了山。

phrases.zh: 光学数据中的遮蔽效应

examples.en: The bride wore a white veil.
examples.zh: 新娘戴着白面纱。

examples.en: Blood returned to the heart through a large vein.
examples.zh: 血液通过一条大静脉回到心脏。

examples.en: The leaf's central vein carried water and nutrients.
examples.zh: 叶子的中央叶脉输送水分和养分。

phrases.zh: 交通史中的早期脚踏车

examples.en: A car's velocity changes when acceleration increases, which allows it to move faster within a shorter time.
examples.zh: 当加速度增加时，汽车速度会改变，使它能在更短时间内移动得更快。

examples.en: Snake venom can damage blood, nerves, or tissue depending on the species.
examples.zh: 蛇毒会根据物种不同损害血液、神经或组织。

examples.en: A roof vent released hot air from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 屋顶通风口排出厨房热气。

examples.en: Steam escaped through a vent beside the machine.
examples.zh: 蒸汽从机器旁的排出口逸出。

examples.en: Old buildings need windows or fans to ventilate a room properly.
examples.zh: 老建筑需要窗户或风扇，才能给房间适当通风。

examples.en: A well-designed dwelling uses natural ventilation to reduce heat, moisture, and indoor air pollution.
examples.zh: 设计良好的住宅利用自然通风来减少热量、湿气和室内空气污染。

examples.en: Poor ventilation can turn an indoor space into a health risk.
examples.zh: 通风不良会把室内空间变成健康风险。

examples.en: The fishing venture failed after the boat was damaged.
examples.zh: 船受损后，这次冒险投机失败了。

examples.en: Few travellers ventured across the desert alone.
examples.zh: 很少有旅行者独自冒险穿越沙漠。

examples.en: A speaker may send verbal messages through words and nonverbal signals through gesture, posture, or eye contact.
examples.zh: 说话者可以通过词语发送语言信息，并通过手势、姿势或眼神发送非语言信号。

phrases.zh: 政策报告中过多的冗词

examples.en: Witness testimony may influence the final verdict, especially when physical evidence is limited or disputed.
examples.zh: 证人证词可能影响最终裁决，尤其当物证有限或存在争议时。

cards.head: verifiable
cards.cutMeaning: 真实/使成为/能够；形容词

examples.en: Public claims should rely on verifiable evidence rather than emotional slogans.
examples.zh: 公共主张应依赖可验证证据，而不是情绪口号。

examples.en: A robust finding becomes more convincing after independent verification shows that the result does not depend on one dataset.
examples.zh: 当独立验证显示结果不依赖单一数据集时，稳健发现会更有说服力。

examples.en: Citizens need ways to verify information when false claims spread quickly.
examples.zh: 当虚假主张快速传播时，公民需要核实信息的方式。

examples.en: The court cared less about rumour than about verity supported by evidence.
examples.zh: 法庭更重视由证据支持的真实，而不是传闻。

examples.en: Poor storage attracts vermin that can ruin grain supplies.
examples.zh: 储存不当会吸引害虫，毁掉粮食供应。

examples.en: Vernacular speech often carries social identity more strongly than formal language.
examples.zh: 日常口语往往比正式语言更强烈地承载社会身份。

phrases.zh: 与本土化；俗语化相关的证据

examples.en: Versatile technology can support online education, remote work, and public healthcare together.
examples.zh: 多功能技术可以同时支持线上教育、远程办公和公共医疗。

examples.en: The old verse was sung at harvest time.
examples.zh: 这首旧诗歌在收获季被吟唱。

examples.en: Children learned simple verse before writing prose.
examples.zh: 孩子们先学习简单韵文，再写散文。

examples.en: An official version of events may omit details that weaken authority.
examples.zh: 事件的官方说法可能省略削弱权威的细节。

examples.en: An official version of history may omit uncomfortable evidence.
examples.zh: 官方历史说法可能省略令人不安的证据。

examples.en: The case was presented as public health versus private profit.
examples.zh: 这个案例被呈现为公共健康与私人利润之间的对立。

examples.en: The fossil included one vertebra from a large marine animal.
examples.zh: 这块化石包含一块大型海洋动物的椎骨。

examples.en: Several vertebrae showed that the animal had a flexible spine.
examples.zh: 几块椎骨显示这种动物有灵活的脊柱。

examples.en: The vertebral column protects the spinal cord.
examples.zh: 脊柱保护脊髓。

examples.en: Fish, birds, and mammals are vertebrates.
examples.zh: 鱼类、鸟类和哺乳动物都是脊椎动物。

examples.en: A vertebrate skeleton includes a backbone.
examples.zh: 有脊柱动物的骨骼包括脊柱。

examples.en: Vertical farming may reduce land pressure in crowded cities with limited farmland.
examples.zh: 垂直农业可能减少耕地有限的拥挤城市中的土地压力。

examples.en: A large vessel carrying refrigerated cargo may wait outside a port when customs checks delay unloading.
examples.zh: 当海关检查延误卸货时，载有冷藏货物的大型船只可能在港口外等待。

examples.en: A cargo vessel can connect distant markets but also spread invasive species.
examples.zh: 货船可以连接遥远市场，但也可能传播入侵物种。

examples.en: A cargo vessel can connect distant markets but also spread invasive species.
examples.zh: 货船可以连接遥远市场，但也可能传播入侵物种。

examples.en: A blocked blood vessel can damage the brain.
examples.zh: 血管堵塞会损害大脑。

examples.en: The president used a veto to stop the bill.
examples.zh: 总统用否决权阻止了法案。

examples.en: The council vetoed the plan to close the clinic.
examples.zh: 委员会否决了关闭诊所的计划。

examples.en: Service privatization may threaten project viability if profit targets reduce access for poorer communities.
examples.zh: 如果利润目标减少贫困社区的使用机会，服务私有化可能威胁项目可行性。

examples.en: Remote work is a viable option when commuting costs become too high.
examples.zh: 当通勤成本变得过高时，远程办公是可行选择。

examples.en: The floor began to vibrate when the heavy train passed nearby.
examples.zh: 重型列车从附近经过时，地板开始振动。

examples.en: Mechanical vibration can signal hidden instability before failure appears.
examples.zh: 机械振动可以在故障显现前提示隐藏的不稳定。

cards.head: vibrational
cards.cutMeaning: 振动/动词；使成为/名词/形容词；名词

phrases.zh: 副市长在紧急事务中的角色

examples.en: Residents in the vicinity of the factory reported a chemical smell.
examples.zh: 工厂附近的居民报告闻到化学气味。

examples.en: Victims of war need protection, justice, and long-term support.
examples.zh: 战争受害者需要保护、正义和长期支持。

phrases.zh: 冲突后的集体受害者身份
无直接受害者的监管违规
刑事司法中的受害者学

examples.en: A military victory does not automatically create a stable peace.
examples.zh: 军事胜利并不会自动创造稳定和平。

examples.en: A decisive victory can reshape political power for decades.
examples.zh: 一场决定性胜利可以重塑数十年的政治权力。

examples.en: From the historian's view, the invention changed work more than leisure.
examples.zh: 从历史学家的观点看，这项发明对工作的改变大于对休闲的改变。

examples.en: A candlelight vigil can turn grief into public memory.
examples.zh: 烛光守夜可以把悲伤转化为公共记忆。

examples.en: A vigorous debate can expose weak evidence before a policy is approved.
examples.zh: 激烈辩论可以在政策通过前暴露薄弱证据。

examples.en: Each villager helped repair the road after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水后，每位村民都帮忙修路。

examples.en: A vindictive leader may punish critics instead of answering them.
examples.zh: 报复心强的领导者可能惩罚批评者，而不是回应他们。

examples.en: Companies violate personal privacy when they sell user data without clear permission.
examples.zh: 公司未经明确许可出售用户数据时，会侵犯个人隐私。

cards.head: violative
cards.cutMeaning: 侵犯/动词；使成为/形容词

examples.en: Violent storms can tear roofs from houses near the coast.
examples.zh: 猛烈风暴会掀掉沿海房屋的屋顶。

cards.head: violently
cards.cutMeaning: 暴力的/形容词；名词/副词

phrases.zh: 以 violently 方式呈现的重要证据

examples.en: The violin carried the main melody while the cello played softly below.
examples.zh: 小提琴奏出主旋律，大提琴在低声伴奏。

examples.en: A viral infection can spread quickly in a crowded school.
examples.zh: 病毒感染会在拥挤学校中迅速传播。

examples.en: A virtual training environment may use simulation to let engineers test dangerous situations safely.
examples.zh: 虚拟训练环境可以使用模拟，让工程师安全测试危险情境。

examples.en: Cloud virtualization can improve system scalability because servers can be created or removed as demand changes.
examples.zh: 云虚拟化可以提高系统可扩展性，因为服务器能随需求变化被创建或移除。

examples.en: utilitarianism evaluates actions by consequences, while virtue ethics asks what kind of person an action helps create.
examples.zh: 功利主义根据后果评价行动，而美德伦理追问行动帮助塑造什么样的人。

examples.en: Technical virtuosity becomes meaningful only when it serves expression.
examples.zh: 技术炫技只有在服务表达时才有意义。

senses.zh: 有道德的，品性好的，品德高的

examples.en: High viral virulence can overwhelm healthcare systems during an outbreak.
examples.zh: 病毒毒性强时，医疗系统可能在疫情中被压垮。

examples.en: The virus spread quickly through the school before symptoms appeared.
examples.zh: 症状出现前，病毒已在学校迅速传播。

phrases.zh: 与内脏的；本能的相关的证据

cards.head: viscosity
cards.cutMeaning: 看/共同；一起/名词；形容词

examples.en: Engineers measure viscosity before pumping a liquid, and monitor oxidation when metals react with oxygen.
examples.zh: 工程师在泵送液体前测量黏度，并在金属与氧反应时监测氧化。

examples.en: The damage was visible from the road after the fire.
examples.zh: 火灾后，从路上就能看见损坏。

cards.head: visionary
cards.cutMeaning: 看/动作；状态；名词/形容词

examples.en: A visionary project still needs ordinary systems to survive.
examples.zh: 有远见的项目仍需要普通系统来存续。

examples.en: A visionary project still needs practical funding and public accountability.
examples.zh: 有远见的项目仍然需要实际资金和公共问责。

examples.en: Visual memory helps artists recall shapes and shadows.
examples.zh: 视觉记忆帮助艺术家回想形状和阴影。

examples.en: The damage was visual even from across the street.
examples.zh: 即使隔着街也能看见损坏。

examples.en: Students can visualize the structure more easily after seeing a model.
examples.zh: 学生看过模型后能更容易把结构形象化。

examples.en: The chart explains the trend visually through colour and size.
examples.zh: 图表通过颜色和大小直观解释趋势。

examples.en: The wound was vital and required immediate care.
examples.zh: 伤口可能致命，需要立即护理。

examples.en: Clean water is vital after a flood.
examples.zh: 洪水后，清洁水至关重要。

cards.head: vitalism
cards.cutMeaning: 生命/形容词；名词/主义；学说

examples.en: Vitamin deficiency can affect growth, vision, and immunity.
examples.zh: 维生素缺乏会影响生长、视力和免疫力。

examples.en: The painter used vivid colours to show the market at night.
examples.zh: 画家用鲜明色彩表现夜晚市场。

examples.en: Her vivid description made the old city feel alive.
examples.zh: 她生动描述让旧城显得鲜活。

cards.head: vocabulary
cards.cutMeaning: 声音；召唤/相关/集合；名词

examples.en: Academic vocabulary helps students understand complex reading passages more efficiently.
examples.zh: 学术词汇帮助学生更高效地理解复杂阅读文章。

examples.en: Local parents were vocal in their opposition to closing the school.
examples.zh: 当地家长公开强烈反对关闭学校。

examples.en: Teaching became her vocation after years of volunteer work.
examples.zh: 多年志愿工作后，教学成了她的职业使命。

examples.en: The court declared the contract void because one signature was false.
examples.zh: 法院宣布合同无效，因为其中一个签名是假的。

examples.en: A volatile market can make food imports risky for poorer countries.
examples.zh: 波动市场会让贫困国家的食品进口变得有风险。

examples.en: Volatile chemicals must be stored away from heat.
examples.zh: 挥发性化学品必须远离热源储存。

examples.en: Volcanic ash can affect air travel, agriculture, and health.
examples.zh: 火山灰会影响航空旅行、农业和健康。

examples.en: Volcanism can create land while also destroying settlements.
examples.zh: 火山活动可以创造土地，同时也摧毁定居点。

examples.en: Intense volcanism can alter the atmosphere and trigger mass extinction.
examples.zh: 强烈火山活动可以改变大气并引发大灭绝。

examples.en: A volcano often forms near tectonic boundaries because moving plates create pathways for magma.
examples.zh: 火山常形成于构造边界附近，因为移动板块为岩浆创造通道。

examples.en: The library kept the rare volume behind glass.
examples.zh: 图书馆把这本稀有卷册保存在玻璃后。

examples.en: The tank's volume was measured before the experiment.
examples.zh: 实验前测量了水箱体积。

examples.en: The reservoir has enough volume to supply two towns.
examples.zh: 水库容量足以供应两个城镇。

examples.en: The teacher lowered the volume during quiet reading.
examples.zh: 安静阅读时，老师调低了音量。

cards.head: voluntarism
cards.cutMeaning: 意志，意愿/人；物/主义；学说

phrases.zh: 社会福利中的志愿主义

examples.en: Voluntary participation is essential when researchers collect personal data.
examples.zh: 研究者收集个人数据时，自愿参与至关重要。

examples.en: Volunteers carried food to the shelter.
examples.zh: 志愿者把食物送到庇护所。

examples.en: She volunteered to teach reading on weekends.
examples.zh: 她自愿周末教阅读。

phrases.zh: 社区健康中的志愿服务

examples.en: The voracious animal swallowed the fish whole.
examples.zh: 这只狼吞虎咽的动物把鱼整个吞下。

examples.en: A voracious demand for land pushed prices higher.
examples.zh: 对土地的贪婪需求推高了价格。

examples.en: The voyage across the ocean took six weeks.
examples.zh: 横渡海洋的旅行花了六周。

examples.en: The ship's final voyage ended at a northern port.
examples.zh: 这艘船的最后航程结束于北方港口。

examples.en: An early voyager often carried trade, myth, and violence together.
examples.zh: 早期航行者往往同时携带贸易、神话与暴力。

examples.en: Social vulnerability explains why the same disaster harms groups differently.
examples.zh: 社会脆弱性解释了为什么同一灾害对不同群体造成不同伤害。

examples.en: Vulnerable groups need stronger protection when healthcare becomes expensive or inaccessible nationwide.
examples.zh: 当全国医疗变得昂贵或不可及时，弱势群体需要更强保护。

examples.en: Vulnerable groups need protection when prices rise faster than wages.
examples.zh: 当物价上涨快于工资时，弱势群体需要保护。

examples.en: Vulnerable groups need protection when prices rise faster than wages.
examples.zh: 当物价上涨快于工资时，弱势群体需要保护。

examples.en: A vulture helps clean the environment by feeding on dead animals.
examples.zh: 秃鹫以死动物为食，帮助清理环境。

phrases.zh: 危机经济中的贪婪行为

examples.en: Readers often have to wade through detail before finding the key point.
examples.zh: 读者往往得先费力穿过细节，才能找到关键点。

examples.en: Minimum wage policy reveals what a society considers fair work.
examples.zh: 最低工资政策揭示一个社会认为什么是公平劳动。

phrases.zh: 种族工资差距持续存在

examples.en: A wooden wagon carried grain from the farm to the mill.
examples.zh: 木制四轮马车把谷物从农场运到磨坊。

examples.en: The freight wagon was loaded with coal.
examples.zh: 货车装满了煤。

examples.en: Urban design affects whether residents walk for daily errands.
examples.zh: 城市设计会影响居民是否步行办理日常事务。

examples.en: A walker noticed cracks in the old bridge.
examples.zh: 一名步行者注意到旧桥上的裂缝。

examples.en: A defensive wall can protect a city but also limit contact with outsiders.
examples.zh: 防御墙可以保护城市，但也可能限制与外界接触。

phrases.zh: 活动中的局促旁观行为

examples.en: Walnut wood is valued for its dark colour and strength.
examples.zh: 胡桃木因颜色深、强度高而受重视。

examples.en: Visitors often wander through the old streets without a fixed plan.
examples.zh: 游客常在老街中无固定计划地闲逛。

examples.en: Public interest began to wane after the first dramatic reports.
examples.zh: 最初的戏剧性报道之后，公众兴趣开始减退。

examples.en: In informal speech, wanna often replaces want to.
examples.zh: 在非正式口语中，wanna 常替代 want to。

examples.en: The market sold painted ware from nearby villages.
examples.zh: 市场出售附近村庄制作的彩绘器皿。

examples.en: The warehouse stored grain before it was shipped to the coast.
examples.zh: 仓库存放粮食，之后再运往海岸。

phrases.zh: 军阀对贸易路线的控制

examples.en: The warm air rising from the street made the evening feel unreal.
examples.zh: 从街道升起的暖空气让这个夜晚显得不真实。

examples.en: Experts may warn of danger long before the public notices it.
examples.zh: 专家可能在公众察觉前很久就警告危险。

examples.en: A clear warning on the dormitory door directed students to another exit.
examples.zh: 宿舍门上清楚的警告把学生引向另一个出口。

examples.en: Pressure can warp judgment by making urgency feel like truth.
examples.zh: 压力会扭曲判断，让紧迫感看起来像真理。

examples.en: Low feasibility does not warrant immediate rejection if a pilot study can reduce technical uncertainty.
examples.zh: 如果试点研究能降低技术不确定性，低可行性并不必然使立即否决有必要。

cards.head: warrantless
cards.cutMeaning: 使有必要/形容词；名词/无；缺少

cards.head: warrantor
cards.cutMeaning: 使有必要/形容词；名词/人；物

examples.en: The warrior carried a shield painted with family symbols.
examples.zh: 武士携带一面画有家族符号的盾牌。

examples.en: Farmers became wary after several false promises.
examples.zh: 几次虚假承诺后，农民变得小心翼翼。

examples.en: A wary guard noticed the open window.
examples.zh: 机警警卫注意到开着的窗户。

examples.en: A wasp built its nest under the wooden roof.
examples.zh: 黄蜂在木屋顶下筑巢。

examples.en: A leaking pipe wastes water every hour.
examples.zh: 漏水管道每小时都浪费水。

examples.en: Waste plastic collected along the riverbank.
examples.zh: 废弃塑料聚集在河岸边。

examples.en: Waste land near the mine slowly returned to grass.
examples.zh: 矿区附近荒芜土地慢慢恢复成草地。

examples.en: Food waste increased during the festival.
examples.zh: 节日期间食物浪费增加了。

examples.en: Clean water is essential for health, farming, and industry.
examples.zh: 清洁水对健康、农业和工业都至关重要。

examples.en: A permeable surface allows rain to enter soil, which may help restore a falling water-table.
examples.zh: 可渗透表面允许雨水进入土壤，这可能帮助恢复下降的地下水位。

examples.en: The old watercourse dried up after the river was diverted.
examples.zh: 河流改道后，旧水道干涸了。

phrases.zh: 传统水上交通工具设计

examples.en: Sediment from a large watershed may settle in a river basin and gradually build a fertile delta.
examples.zh: 来自大型流域的沉积物可能沉积在河流盆地中，并逐渐形成肥沃三角洲。

examples.en: A falling water table can threaten farming even when rivers still appear full.
examples.zh: 即使河流看起来仍充盈，地下水位下降也会威胁农业。

examples.en: A large wave carried sand over the low wall.
examples.zh: 一个大浪把沙子卷过低墙。

examples.en: A short wavelength corresponds to higher energy within the electromagnetic spectrum.
examples.zh: 在电磁光谱中，较短波长对应较高能量。

examples.en: Public support may waver if transport reforms raise costs before benefits appear.
examples.zh: 如果交通改革在收益出现前提高成本，公众支持可能动摇。

examples.en: The candle was made of beeswax.
examples.zh: 蜡烛由蜂蜡制成。

examples.en: A wax-like layer protected the leaf.
examples.zh: 蜡状物层保护着叶子。

examples.en: A way of thinking can limit what solutions appear possible.
examples.zh: 思维方式会限制哪些解决方案看起来可能。

phrases.zh: 小说中的弱者刻板印象

examples.en: Repeated drought can weaken trees until insects attack them.
examples.zh: 反复干旱会削弱树木，使昆虫趁机侵害。

phrases.zh: 军事研究中的武器专家角色

examples.en: Rumours can be weaponised to damage public trust.
examples.zh: 谣言可能被武器化，用来破坏公众信任。

examples.en: Workers wear masks when dust levels become dangerous.
examples.zh: 粉尘水平变得危险时，工人会戴口罩。

examples.en: Weather affects harvests, travel plans, and energy demand.
examples.zh: 天气影响收成、出行计划和能源需求。

examples.en: Weathering slowly breaks rock into smaller particles.
examples.zh: 风化会慢慢把岩石分解成更小颗粒。

examples.en: Historians weave fragments of evidence into a coherent account.
examples.zh: 历史学家把证据碎片编织成连贯叙述。

examples.en: Women wove baskets from reeds gathered near the river.
examples.zh: 妇女用河边采集的芦苇编织篮子。

examples.en: The author wove personal memory into the history of the town.
examples.zh: 作者把个人记忆组合进城镇历史中。

examples.en: The wedge-shaped tool split the log with little effort.
examples.zh: 楔形工具轻松劈开了木头。

examples.en: Weeds compete with crops for water, light, and nutrients.
examples.zh: 杂草与庄稼争夺水、光和养分。

examples.en: Governments should weigh benefits and costs before hosting expensive international events publicly.
examples.zh: 政府在公开举办昂贵国际赛事之前，应权衡利弊。

examples.en: Evidence carries more weight when it survives serious challenge.
examples.zh: 证据在经受严肃挑战后更有分量。

examples.en: A weird noise came from the engine whenever the car turned left.
examples.zh: 汽车左转时，发动机会发出怪异声音。

examples.en: A welcoming entrance made the clinic less frightening to new patients.
examples.zh: 热情的入口让新病人觉得诊所没那么可怕。

examples.en: A generous welfare system may still fail if bureaucracy makes benefits difficult for ordinary citizens to access.
examples.zh: 慷慨的福利体系如果因官僚程序导致普通市民难以获得福利，仍可能失败。

examples.en: Public welfare should guide decisions about housing, healthcare, and education.
examples.zh: 公共福祉应指导住房、医疗和教育决策。

phrases.zh: 政策设计中的福利主义

senses.zh: 福利主义的；福利主义者

examples.en: After several weeks of rest, the patient was well enough to travel.
examples.zh: 休息几周后，病人健康到足以旅行。

examples.en: Children's well-being depends on safety, education, family stability, and emotional support.
examples.zh: 儿童福祉取决于安全、教育、家庭稳定和情感支持。

phrases.zh: 恐怖小说中的狼人叙事

examples.en: The western border followed the river for several kilometres.
examples.zh: 西部边界沿河延伸了数公里。

examples.en: Settlers moved westward when farmland became scarce near the coast.
examples.zh: 海岸附近农田变少时，定居者向西迁移。

examples.en: Wet soil holds the footprint longer than dry sand.
examples.zh: 湿土比干沙能更久地保留脚印。

examples.en: Whatever the cause, the damage must be repaired before winter.
examples.zh: 无论原因是什么，损坏都必须在冬天前修复。

examples.en: The claim had no evidence whatsoever to support it.
examples.zh: 这个主张没有任何证据支持。

examples.en: Whenever the river rises, the lower road closes first.
examples.zh: 每当河水上涨，低处道路总是先关闭。

examples.en: The treaty created a process whereby disputes could be settled peacefully.
examples.zh: 条约建立了一套程序，使争端能和平解决。

senses.zh: 其中；在那里；在那种情况下

examples.en: A system wherein rewards are hidden can still shape behaviour strongly.
examples.zh: 一个奖励机制被隐藏的系统仍能强烈塑造行为。

examples.en: A system wherein data is hidden from users can intensify platform dependence.
examples.zh: 一个数据对用户隐藏的系统可能加剧平台依赖。

phrases.en: a system wherein power is concentrated

examples.en: Researchers asked whether the treatment worked equally well for children.
examples.zh: 研究者询问这种治疗对儿童是否同样有效。

examples.en: Whichever route they choose, the team must cross the river.
examples.zh: 无论选择哪条路线，团队都必须过河。

senses.zh: 异想天开的；古怪有趣的

examples.en: A whimsical design can feel light without becoming empty.
examples.zh: 异想天开的设计可以显得轻盈，而不至于空洞。

phrases.zh: 与异想天地；随意地相关的证据
文学风格中的奇思妙想
与奇思妙想相关的证据

examples.en: Students began to whisper when the results appeared on the screen.
examples.zh: 当结果出现在屏幕上时，学生们开始低声议论。

examples.en: Whoever finds the document should bring it to the archive office.
examples.zh: 无论谁找到这份文件，都应把它带到档案办公室。

examples.en: The whole society benefits when public transport becomes cheaper, cleaner, and safer.
examples.zh: 当公共交通更便宜、更清洁且更安全时，整个社会都会受益。

examples.en: A wholistic approach considers diet, sleep, work, and stress together.
examples.zh: 整体方法会把饮食、睡眠、工作和压力一起考虑。

examples.en: The candle went out when the wick became wet.
examples.zh: 灯芯变湿后，蜡烛熄灭了。

examples.en: The method is widely used because it is cheap and reliable.
examples.zh: 这种方法被广泛使用，因为它便宜且可靠。

examples.en: Local officials wield power over land permits and building rules.
examples.zh: 地方官员掌握土地许可和建筑规则的权力。

examples.en: Protecting wilderness can preserve biodiversity and water resources.
examples.zh: 保护荒野可以保存生物多样性和水资源。

phrases.zh: 与极其；失控地相关的证据

examples.en: The judge treated the damage as willful rather than accidental.
examples.zh: 法官认为这次破坏是故意的，而非意外。

examples.en: Volunteers were willing to work late because the shelter was full.
examples.zh: 由于收容所已满，志愿者愿意工作到很晚。

examples.en: Willingness to listen can prevent a small dispute from becoming serious.
examples.zh: 愿意倾听可以防止小争端变得严重。

examples.en: A willow grew beside the river.
examples.zh: 一棵柳树长在河边。

examples.en: The basket was made from willow.
examples.zh: 篮子由柳木制品编成。

examples.en: Strong wind pushed sand across the road all afternoon.
examples.zh: 强风整个下午把沙子吹过道路。

examples.en: A windmill converts wind into useful mechanical energy.
examples.zh: 风车把风转化为有用的机械能。

examples.en: A simple windmill can provide electricity when public infrastructure is absent.
examples.zh: 公共基础设施缺失时，一个简单风车可以提供电力。

examples.en: The window faced south, so the room stayed bright in winter.
examples.zh: 窗户朝南，所以房间在冬天仍很明亮。

examples.en: In winter, the river froze and trade moved onto the ice.
examples.zh: 冬天河流结冰，贸易转移到冰面上。

examples.en: Nurses wipe each surface before the next patient enters.
examples.zh: 下一位病人进入前，护士会擦拭每个表面。

examples.en: Practical wisdom often comes from judging context rather than following rules blindly.
examples.zh: 实践智慧往往来自判断情境，而不是盲目遵守规则。

examples.en: Wispy clouds drifted above the lake at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时，纤细的云飘过湖面上方。

examples.en: Her wit made difficult conversations lighter without hiding the truth.
examples.zh: 她的机智让艰难谈话变得轻松，却不掩盖事实。

phrases.en: accuse someone of being a witch

examples.en: Investors may withdraw support when political risks become too high.
examples.zh: 当政治风险变得过高时，投资者可能撤回支持。

examples.en: Patients could withdraw from the trial at any time.
examples.zh: 病人可以随时退出试验。

examples.en: She withdrew cash before travelling to the rural clinic.
examples.zh: 她去乡村诊所前取了现金。

examples.en: The withdrawal-term allowed patients to leave the study at any time.
examples.zh: 退出条款允许病人随时离开研究。

examples.en: The leaves withered after three weeks without rain.
examples.zh: 三周无雨后，叶子枯萎了。

examples.en: Public support withered when the policy raised food prices.
examples.zh: 政策推高食品价格后，公众支持衰退了。

examples.en: The witness chose to withhold one detail until a lawyer arrived.
examples.zh: 证人选择隐瞒一个细节，直到律师到场。

cards.head: withholding
cards.cutMeaning: 向后；离开/握住；保留/名词

examples.en: Withholding evidence made the investigation slower and less fair.
examples.zh: 隐瞒证据使调查更慢，也更不公正。

examples.en: Public services must withstand pressure during economic crises, floods, and natural disasters.
examples.zh: 公共服务必须在经济危机、洪水和自然灾害中承受压力。

examples.en: An expert witness can translate specialised knowledge for a court.
examples.zh: 专家证人可以为法庭转译专业知识。

examples.en: A key witness can change the outcome of a legal trial.
examples.zh: 关键证人可以改变一场审判的结果。

phrases.zh: 牧业生活中的猎狼犬角色

examples.en: The child stared in wonder at the eclipse.
examples.zh: 孩子惊奇地盯着日食。

examples.en: The ancient bridge was a wonder of engineering.
examples.zh: 古桥是工程奇迹。

examples.en: Visitors wondered at the size of the glacier.
examples.zh: 访客对冰川的大小感到诧异。

examples.en: She wondered whether the old map was accurate.
examples.zh: 她纳闷这张旧地图是否准确。

examples.en: Wool keeps heat better than many plant fibres when it is dry.
examples.zh: 干燥时，羊毛比许多植物纤维更保暖。

senses.zh: 工作日；一天的工作时间

examples.en: Each worker recorded the temperature before entering the tunnel.
examples.zh: 每名工人在进入隧道前记录温度。

examples.en: A skilled workforce is essential when economies shift toward advanced technology.
examples.zh: 当经济转向先进技术时，熟练劳动力至关重要。

examples.en: Working-memory limits make long instructions hard to follow.
examples.zh: 工作记忆限制会使长指令难以遵循。

examples.en: A writing workshop can turn private drafts into shared learning.
examples.zh: 写作工作坊可以把私人草稿变成共同学习。

examples.en: The ancient map showed a world much smaller than the one sailors later discovered.
examples.zh: 这张古地图显示的世界比后来水手发现的世界小得多。

phrases.zh: 相互冲突的世界观假设

examples.en: 当地方发现改变重大理论时，它能引起全球关注。
examples.zh: 当地方发现改变重大理论时，它能引起全球关注。

examples.en: Religious worship can shape architecture, music, and community life.
examples.zh: 宗教崇拜可以塑造建筑、音乐和社区生活。

examples.en: Each worshipper left flowers at the entrance of the temple.
examples.zh: 每位礼拜者都在寺庙入口留下鲜花。

examples.en: The painting's worth increased after the exhibition.
examples.zh: 展览后，这幅画的价值上升。

examples.en: The old bridge is worth repairing.
examples.zh: 这座旧桥值得修理。

examples.en: The wound healed slowly because the patient lacked clean water.
examples.zh: 由于病人缺少清洁水源，伤口愈合缓慢。

phrases.zh: 组织中的伤口愈合反应
没有伤亡的象征性胜利

examples.en: She wrapped the fragile cup in paper.
examples.zh: 她用纸包装易碎杯子。

examples.en: The nurse wrapped the wound with clean cloth.
examples.zh: 护士用干净布裹住伤口。

examples.en: The storm wrecked fishing boats along the harbour wall.
examples.zh: 风暴摧毁了港墙边的渔船。

examples.en: A wrinkle appeared on the old map.
examples.zh: 旧地图上出现一道皱纹。

examples.en: The wet paper wrinkled as it dried.
examples.zh: 湿纸晾干时起皱。

examples.en: He wrinkled his forehead while reading the bill.
examples.zh: 他读账单时皱起额头。

examples.en: Students write better essays when they revise one argument at a time.
examples.zh: 学生一次修改一个论点时，文章会写得更好。

examples.en: The writer explained a difficult theory with a simple image.
examples.zh: 作者用一个简单图像解释了困难理论。

examples.en: Academic writing requires evidence, structure, and careful wording.
examples.zh: 学术写作需要证据、结构和谨慎措辞。

senses.zh: 错误的；不公正的；非法的

examples.en: A wrongful conviction reveals how fragile justice becomes under pressure.
examples.zh: 错误定罪揭示了正义在压力下会变得多么脆弱。

examples.en: A chest x-ray can reveal damage that ordinary observation misses.
examples.zh: 胸部X光可以揭示普通观察遗漏的损伤。

examples.en: Economic insecurity may turn public hostility into xenophobia when outsiders are blamed for local decline.
examples.zh: 当外来者被归咎于地方衰退时，经济不安全感可能把公众敌意转化为排外心理。

examples.en: The sweater was made from thick blue yarn.
examples.zh: 这件毛衣是用粗蓝纱线织成的。

examples.en: The poem expresses a yearning for home after years of migration.
examples.zh: 这首诗表达了多年迁徙后对家园的渴望。

examples.en: Yeast makes bread rise by producing gas during fermentation.
examples.zh: 酵母在发酵时产生气体，使面包膨起。

examples.en: Investment in public transport can yield benefits for workers and local businesses.
examples.zh: 公共交通投资可以为劳动者和本地企业产生收益。

examples.en: The new seed produced a higher yield in dry soil.
examples.zh: 这种新种子在干土中产生了更高产量。

senses.gloss: able to bend or give way

examples.en: High-yielding varieties improved food security in the region.
examples.zh: 高产品种改善了该地区的粮食安全。

examples.en: Yogurt contains bacteria that help milk ferment.
examples.zh: 酸奶含有帮助牛奶发酵的细菌。

examples.en: Reform zeal faded when the policy produced unexpected costs.
examples.zh: 当政策产生意外成本时，改革热情减弱了。

examples.en: The zealous volunteer arrived early and stayed after everyone left.
examples.zh: 这位热心志愿者早早到达，并在所有人离开后仍留下来。

examples.en: The empire reached its zenith before trade routes shifted east.
examples.zh: 贸易路线东移前，这个帝国达到鼎盛。

examples.en: Zinc coating protects iron from rust.
examples.zh: 锌涂层保护铁不生锈。

examples.en: Strict zoning can protect housing in a growing metropolis, but it may also raise prices by limiting supply.
examples.zh: 严格分区规划能保护成长中大都市的住房，但也可能因限制供应而推高价格。

examples.en: Zoning rules kept factories away from residential streets.
examples.zh: 分区规则让工厂远离住宅街道。

动物园管理员动物福利职责

cards.head: zoological
cards.cutMeaning: 动物/学科/形容词/形容词

examples.en: Zoology helps scientists understand animal behaviour, evolution, and habitats.
examples.zh: 动物学帮助科学家理解动物行为、进化和栖息地。

examples.en: Small zooplankton feed many fish, while a healthy coral reef provides shelter for young marine species.
examples.zh: 小型浮游动物供许多鱼类取食，而健康珊瑚礁为幼年海洋物种提供庇护。
